prs.title: test(managed-agent): resume both Session streams across a held Hook (FG13e)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the FG13e stream-gap gate for Hosted Hooks. A `PreToolUse` command Hook is held inside the Runtime worker while two clients read one Session's public and WebShell streams, and the test releases it only after both clients are cut. The deny lands while neither is connected; each reconnects with its own cursor (`Last-Event-ID` on the public route, `afterSequence` on the WebShell route). Each resumed view must equal the committed ledger byte for byte — no gap, no duplicate — carry exactly one turn completion, and the model must see exactly one tool result carrying the denial reason while the tool never runs. The tool-call start frame is emitted only after the call leaves the Hook, so the cut deliberately happens before it: the frames written during the hold are exactly the ones a cut client misses.

## Why it's needed

FG13e is the remaining stream arm of the Hosted Hook fault-gate round on #14449. MCP stream resume is already pinned by the FG12f class, and cursor replay by the managed event replay suite, but nothing pins a disconnect while a Hook decision is in flight — the window where the frames that land are the deny and the Turn's end. Without this cell, a resumed client losing or replaying those frames would pass.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the `hosted-harness-mysql` lane; the new class performs one cold boot (budgeted at 150 s). Expected: the resumed public and WebShell views are contiguous `1..n` and equal the ledger prefix; each view carries one failed terminal for `call_FG13E_HOLD` past its cut cursor, plus one `turn.completed`; the fixture records one `hook.call` and one `hook.deny`; the final model request contains exactly one tool result for the emitted call carrying `FG13_DENIED`, and never the proof file's contents.

`managed-agent-gate.yml` selects the `fast` tier on `pull_request`; the full Hosted suite runs on the first maintainer approval of the head commit. A skipped lane is not a passing gate. Locally I could only compile and run checkstyle on macOS, because the cell requires Linux, MySQL 8.4 and a delegated cgroup v2 root.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change; no user-visible output.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS: `mvn -o test-compile checkstyle:check` with JDK 21, plus the CI-budget meta test. Linux is the `hosted-harness-mysql` lane, run on the first maintainer approval.

### Environment (optional)

`mvn -o test-compile checkstyle:check` with `JAVA_HOME` on JDK 21; `npx vitest run scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the cell is verified by CI only; the local macOS host cannot run the Linux/cgroup lane.
- Not validated / out of scope: no local run of the Hosted lane; Stop and `MessageDisplay` suppression in a replay stay with FG13f `message-display-reload`, and store acknowledgements with FG13a, both still on #14449.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. This cell adds 150 s; with main's FG12f delivery entry (+20 s) and the FG11d retire-at-intent cell (+18 s), the merged ledger is healthy 9668 s, fork 10268 s, Verify 182 minutes, job 285 minutes.

Design documents: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/test/14449-fg13e-hook-stream-gap/docs/design/2026-10-20-hosted-hook-stream-gap-gates-e.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/test/14449-fg13e-hook-stream-gap/docs/design/2026-10-20-hosted-hook-stream-gap-gates-e.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Part of #14449. Closes nothing.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

为 Hosted Hook 增加 FG13e 事件流断流门禁。一个 `PreToolUse` 命令 Hook 在 Runtime worker 里保持持有，直到测试在两个客户端断流后显式释放；期间两个客户端同时读同一个 Session 的公共流与 WebShell 流。拒绝在两个客户端都不在线时落地；随后各自带游标重连（公共路由用 `Last-Event-ID`，WebShell 路由用 `afterSequence`）。每个续读视图必须与已提交台账逐字节一致——无空洞、无重复——恰好携带一个回合完成帧；模型必须只收到一条携带拒绝原因的工具结果，且工具从未执行。工具调用的起始帧只在调用离开 Hook 之后才发射，所以断流刻意发生在它之前：持有期间写入的帧，正是被切断客户端会漏掉的那些。

## 为什么需要

FG13e 是 #14449 上 Hosted Hook 故障门禁回合剩余的流臂。MCP 的流续读已由 FG12f 类钉住，游标重放由 managed event replay 套件钉住，但没有任何用例钉住「Hook 决策在飞时断流」——这个窗口里落账的帧正是拒绝与回合结束。缺了这一格，续读客户端丢掉或重放这些帧也会通过。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

运行 `hosted-harness-mysql` 车道；新类只冷启一次（预算 150 秒）。期望：续读后的公共与 WebShell 视图都是连续的 `1..n` 且等于台账前缀；每个视图在断流游标之后携带一个 `call_FG13E_HOLD` 的 `failed` 终态，以及一个 `turn.completed`；夹具记录一次 `hook.call` 与一次 `hook.deny`；最后一次模型请求里只有一条对应本次调用的工具结果携带 `FG13_DENIED`，且从不包含证明文件的内容。

`managed-agent-gate.yml` 在 `pull_request` 上只选 `fast` 档；完整 Hosted 套件由维护者对 head 提交的首次批准触发。被跳过的车道不算通过。本机 macOS 只能编译并跑 checkstyle，因为该用例需要 Linux、MySQL 8.4 与委派的 cgroup v2 根。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A——纯测试改动，无用户可见输出。

### 测试环境

|     OS     |  状态  |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS：JDK 21 下 `mvn -o test-compile checkstyle:check`，以及 CI 预算元测试。Linux 由 `hosted-harness-mysql` 车道承担，在维护者对 head 的首次批准时运行。

### 环境（可选）

`JAVA_HOME` 指向 JDK 21 的 `mvn -o test-compile checkstyle:check`；`npx vitest run scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：该用例只能由 CI 验证；本机 macOS 跑不了 Linux/cgroup 车道。
- 未验证/超出范围：未在本地跑 Hosted 车道；Stop 与 `MessageDisplay` 的抑制文本重放归 FG13f 的 `message-display-reload`，store 确认归 FG13a，二者仍留在 #14449。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。本格增加 150 秒；叠加 main 的 FG12f 投递格（+20 秒）与 FG11d retire-at-intent（+18 秒）后，合并台账为 healthy 9668 秒、fork 10268 秒、Verify 182 分钟、job 285 分钟。

## 关联 Issue

属于 #14449，不关闭任何 issue。

</details>

auto_merge.commit_title: test(managed-agent): resume both Session streams across a held Hook (FG13e) (#14917)
auto_merge.commit_message:
* test(managed-agent): resume both Session streams across a held Hook (FG13e)

A PreToolUse command Hook holds inside the Runtime worker while the public
and WebShell clients read the Session stream. Both clients are then cut,
the deny lands while neither is connected, and each resumes with its own
cursor (Last-Event-ID on the public route, afterSequence on the WebShell
route). Each resumed view must equal the committed ledger byte for byte
with no gap and no duplicate, carry exactly one completion, and the model
must see exactly one tool result carrying the denial reason while the tool
never runs.

The tool-call start frame is only emitted after the call leaves the Hook,
so the cut deliberately happens before it: the frames written during the
hold are exactly the ones a cut client misses. Adds the bilingual design
note. One cell adds 150 s to the shared fork: healthy 9630 s, fork
10230 s, Verify 181 minutes.

* test(managed-agent): read the cut cursors after the readers stop

The resume cursor was sampled before abort(), so a frame the reader
thread appended in that window would be served again on resume and redden
the union as a duplicate. Take the cursors after abort(), matching the
FG12f class.

* test(managed-agent): release the held Hook after both streams are cut

The fixture now offers a hook-release mode that waits for <evidence>.release
instead of sleeping for a fixed 20 s, and the test writes that file only
after both readers abort. The deny therefore cannot land before the cut, so
the gap the cell claims to test is the one it actually creates.

assertResumedView now names what the Hook-held turn put on the ledger: one
failed terminal for call_FG13E_HOLD, past the cut cursor, and one
completion. Transport fidelity to a ledger that lost or duplicated the deny
no longer passes.

fg13-cases joins the Hosted artifact upload and the meta test pins it. Both
design docs correct the CI trigger: pull_request selects the fast tier, and
the full suite runs on the first maintainer approval of the head.

* test(managed-agent): correct the FG13e witness and raise the stall bound

Mutation witness #2 said a live-only resume reddens on the gap assertion.
continueFrom runs after the turn completed, so that client never reaches the
ledger tail: its 90 s wait exhausts and the case reddens on that timeout.
Both design docs now say so, and the Non-goals point the duplicated-helper
extraction at #14921.

The method's stall bound is raised to 480 s, above the 420 s of inner await
budgets, so a hung wait reports its own description instead of the outer
timeout. The Hosted lane trigger sentence was already corrected in
1eb67df537.

* docs(managed-agent): describe the FG13e hold as an explicit release

The step table still said the Hook holds for 20 s, which the explicit-release
fixture replaced. Both design docs now say it is held until the test
releases it, matching the code and the PR body.

* test(managed-agent): keep the digits in the FG13e fixture's call id

The prompt capture used [^A-Z_], which stops at the 1 in FG13E_HOLD, so
the fixture minted call_FG while both deny assertions look for
call_FG13E_HOLD. Add 0-9 to the class; the capture now keeps the whole
marker.

The design docs also carry the merged ledger: this cell adds 150 s, and
with main's FG12f (+20 s) and FG11d retire-at-intent (+18 s) the totals
are healthy 9668 s, fork 10268 s, Verify 182 minutes.

* test(managed-agent): close the FG13e review follow-ups

- Raise the stall bound to 600 s and the Hook command timeout to 240 s so
  a slow stream cannot trip the outer timeout or fail-closed before the
  release.
- Sweep the cgroup subtree in stop() and pin the rule over every Hosted IT
  that exports QWEN_MANAGED_HOOK_CGROUP_ROOT.
- Restore the workflow ledger's FG11d cancel entry so the chain sums from
  9915 to 10268.
- Copy processes.jsonl and the harness log into the evidence bundle, and
  pin the writer side of the fg13-cases path.
- Enumerate the deferred shared machinery in both design docs; #14921 now
  carries the measured 635/810-line scope.

---------

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): import enabled skills at session creation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Managed Workspace Sessions can import enabled Skills from the existing Skills manager when they are created. Public and WebShell creation requests accept optional Skill additions, merge them with the pinned AgentDefinition catalog, and freeze the effective instructions and invocation flags for the Session. The composer exposes the same catalog through `+ → Skills` and `/`, with filtering and completion before the first message.

The saved catalog follows reconnects, child Sessions and cold recovery. Large instruction catalogs use bounded resources, and Skill tool results are saved within the model output budget so later Turns cannot restore discarded text.

## Why it's needed

Users should be able to manage Skills in one place and use them in a new Managed conversation without publishing a separate AgentDefinition. Existing conversations must remain reproducible when the source configuration changes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Enable a harmless instruction-only Skill in the existing manager. Start a Managed Workspace conversation and confirm that both `+ → Skills` and typing `/` show enabled user-invocable entries, including manual-only Skills. Disabled and user-hidden entries should be absent.
2. Type a Skill-name prefix, move with the arrow keys, and choose it with Tab, Enter or a click. Each action should insert `/<name> ` without sending the message or creating a Session. Escape should close the list and preserve the draft.
3. Explicitly send the harmless Skill invocation. Confirm its instructions are available on the first Turn. Change or disable the source afterward: a new conversation should use the new configuration, while the original conversation and its reconnect retain the saved catalog.
4. Retry an uncertain creation after reload. Its saved Skill bodies and idempotency key should stay identical. Duplicate names, combined-size overflow, unauthorized access and an incompatible Harness should fail explicitly without partial admission.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Behavior | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Enabled source catalog | Available only to ordinary daemon sessions or a published definition | Automatically imported when starting a Managed Workspace Session |
| New composer Skills entry | Unavailable despite 42 enabled source entries | 42 enabled entries in both the plus menu and cold `/` completion |
| Existing conversation after source edits | Definition-pinned catalog only | Its effective 43-entry verification catalog remains fixed |
| Selection | No direct Skill candidates from `/` | Prefix filtering, arrows, Escape and Tab/Enter/click completion pass without automatic submission |

Local validation includes root build/typecheck/bundle, 335 focused WebShell tests, affected SDK/Core/Hosted tests, disposable MySQL/Hosted checks, 18 applicable process groups and real-provider browser acceptance. One unchanged heartbeat timing test failed in the full Java run; the method and its complete 38-test class passed focused retries, including Checkstyle and SpotBugs. The full run is retained as a failure. A separate E2E report comment records exact results and limits.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Local Managed stack, browser, real provider, Java/MySQL and targeted TypeScript checks |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Native Workspace Runtime acceptance not run locally |

### Environment (optional)

Local Java control plane, Hosted Harness, MySQL 8.4 and WebShell; disposable databases and isolated ports for process tests; Kimi for the real-provider browser flow.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: this crosses creation, immutable resources and recovery. The Session catalog is bounded to 256 unique entries, 512 KiB per body and 2 MiB total, gated by `session-skills/2`. Original AgentDefinition limits and generic inline-resource limits remain in force.
- Not validated / out of scope: direct discovery by the Managed execution Runtime, copying source scripts/assets, transferring frontmatter permissions or Hooks, and editing an admitted Session catalog. Interrupted multi-Skill store recovery has unit coverage; the process script does not inject that fault. Remote SSH/Kubernetes and other model providers were not accepted end to end.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: additions are optional; omitted or empty arrays preserve existing behavior. An existing creation receipt stores the immutable catalog, so no SQL schema migration is required. Unknown or unavailable source Workspaces do not fall back to a primary daemon.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-20-managed-session-creation-skills.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-managed-session-creation-skills.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

None.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的内容

Managed Workspace Session 可以在创建时导入已有 Skills 管理页中的启用项。公开 API 与 WebShell 创建请求支持可选 Skill 追加，与固定的 AgentDefinition 目录合并，并为 Session 保存不可变的最终指令和调用标记。输入框通过 `+ → Skills` 和 `/` 展示同一目录，首条消息发送前即可筛选和补全。

保存的目录跟随重连、子会话和冷恢复。较大的指令目录使用有界资源，Skill 工具结果按模型输出预算保存，防止后续 Turn 恢复已裁掉的文本。

## 为什么需要

用户应能在同一个位置管理 Skills，并在新建 Managed 对话时直接使用，无须单独发布 AgentDefinition。来源配置变化后，已有对话仍应保持可复现。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在已有管理页启用一个无副作用的纯指令 Skill。新建 Managed Workspace 对话，确认 `+ → Skills` 与输入 `/` 均列出已启用且允许用户调用的条目，包括仅手动调用的 Skills；停用项和用户不可调用项不应出现。
2. 输入 Skill 名称前缀，用方向键移动，再分别用 Tab、Enter 或点击选择。每次只插入 `/<名称> `，不发送消息、不创建 Session。Escape 应关闭列表并保留草稿。
3. 明确发送该无副作用 Skill 的调用，确认首个 Turn 就能获得指令。随后修改或停用来源：新对话应使用新配置，原对话及其重连仍保留已保存的目录。
4. 页面重载后重试一次未确认的创建请求，其完整 Skill 正文与幂等键应保持一致。同名、合计超限、未授权访问和不兼容 Harness 应明确拒绝，不产生部分准入。

### 变更前后证据

本地验证包括根 build/typecheck/bundle、335 项 WebShell 定向测试、受影响的 SDK/Core/Hosted 测试、一次性 MySQL/Hosted 检查、18 组适用进程测试及真实模型浏览器验收。完整 Java 运行有一项未修改的心跳计时测试失败；该方法及整个 38 项测试类定向复跑通过，包括 Checkstyle 和 SpotBugs。原完整运行保留为失败。另附独立 E2E 报告评论，记录准确结果与限制。

本地 Java 控制面、Hosted Harness、MySQL 8.4 和 WebShell；进程测试使用一次性数据库与隔离端口；真实模型浏览器流程使用 Kimi。

- 主要风险或取舍：涉及创建、不可变资源及恢复。Session 目录限制为 256 个唯一条目、单正文 512 KiB、合计 2 MiB，并由 `session-skills/2` 控制。原 AgentDefinition 上限和普通行内资源上限保持有效。

prs.title: fix(cli): preserve runtime boundaries during standalone updates
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Standalone updates preserve the installed Node or Bun runtime flavor through download, validation, activation and rollback. Node retains its npm transport and inherited registry, proxy, CA and authentication configuration. Bun standalone checks release tags without requiring external Node/npm, using the supported builtin, global, user and environment registry/authentication settings while excluding implicit project configuration.

Before activation, both runtime flavors verify the downloaded package identity, interpreter identity, actual CLI version and ability of the production launcher to load the CLI. Prepared updates recheck the installation identity; rejected updates preserve the current installation and rollback backup. Registry lookup now expands environment variables in keys as well as values, trims environment fields, and supports longest-match credentials at slash-terminated paths, slashless paths and the bare host. Unreadable configuration deliberately fails closed instead of silently selecting another registry.

This is the consolidated standalone-update boundary from #14134, #14139, #14142, #14187 and #14210, including the earlier CI cancellation-test cleanup: 11 files, +3218/-133. It does not change the TUI or complete the separate interpreter call-site migration.

## Why it's needed

The existing updater selected classic Node archives without preserving a Bun installation's runtime. A launcher's metadata-only version response also does not prove that its CLI can load. Independent reproduction additionally showed that a corrupt Node launcher could be activated, and that templated npmrc keys, whitespace-bearing configuration paths and valid slashless authentication keys selected the wrong registry or credentials. This update rejects the broken launcher before replacement and closes those seven observed npm configuration mismatches.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Check and apply an update from separate Node and Bun standalone installations. The selected archive and activated runtime should match the original flavor; a valid update and rollback should preserve the expected installation identity.
2. Try an archive with the wrong package identity, runtime, target or version, a missing/invalid CLI, or a broken launcher. Both direct and prepared activation must reject before replacing the live installation or its backup. Change the installed identity between preparation and activation and confirm it is rechecked.
3. Configure a scoped registry and authentication using environment placeholders, whitespace around environment config paths/tokens, and both slash-terminated and slashless credential keys. The correct trusted configuration tier and longest matching credential should win. A sibling path, another host and implicit project configuration must not supply the credential.
4. Exercise absent/relative home, malformed metadata, unreadable configuration and cross-origin registry redirects. The documented failure/legacy behavior should remain visible, rejected updates should preserve the installation, and cross-origin redirects must drop authorization. A whitespace-only credential must not restore the overridden credential from the same lower-priority key.

### Evidence (Before & After)

At `d41362f`, independent reproduction accepted a Node archive with a syntactically broken launcher and found seven npm registry/authentication mismatches. Those original failures remain preserved. At `356890b`, the repaired production source passed build/typecheck/bundle, 215 focused unit tests, two independent launcher cases, six npm controls and all seven failing comparisons. Three empty-value cases remain observations, not passes: empty/whitespace config paths fail closed while npm records EISDIR and continues; an empty prefix retains cwd-relative semantics.

The [Ubuntu runtime gate at `356890b`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39533506749/job/119004842831) then failed because the real Node launcher's help path created a compiler cache in the fixture's temporary directory. The launcher is byte-identical to main. The earlier local runtime run supplied a separate cache directory outside the official script; CI did not. Independent controls reproduced the default help-path residue and showed the same help command passing with an owned cache directory while caching remained enabled. The original CI failure and failed control are preserved.

Current head `127455a069bad15591262b1326c4e7eed8a0e6f9` changes only that test isolation: 18 added lines, no production changes. Fresh build, typecheck, lint, formatting and the complete official runtime matrix all passed without an outer runner-provided cache setting. Node 24.19.0 and Bun 1.3.14 each exercised both archive flavors, valid update/rollback and rejection controls; all eight broken-launcher cases rejected the update. The official fixture now proves cache files are created while retaining every strict empty-temporary-directory, installation and backup assertion. Both hosts exited 0, all 469 captured process identities were gone, and owned temporary roots were removed without cleanup signals.

The 215 unit cases, independent npm comparisons and bundle evidence above remain attributed to `356890b`; their production and test sources are unchanged by the current test-only delta. New Linux CI and current-head review are pending. Earlier approvals belong to the preceding commits. The [review disposition](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14934#issuecomment-6306637980) and [unset-variable follow-up](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14934#issuecomment-6307099460) retain deferred Suggestions and policy decisions rather than claiming they were all fixed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ arm64: current build/typecheck/lint/format and both runtime hosts passed; unchanged-source unit/comparison/bundle evidence is attributed above |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Current candidate not tested natively; POSIX fixtures and parameterized paths do not establish Windows acceptance |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ New-head CI pending; the preceding runtime-gate failure is documented above |

### Environment (optional)

Isolated managed worktree; Node 24.19.0, Bun 1.3.14 and real npm 11.17.0 configuration/authentication modules. Fixtures used owned homes, system/default settings, npm configuration, working directories, temporary roots, a local HTTPS server and synthetic archives/tokens. The independent npm comparison made no external registry requests. The Node update-query transport fixture delegates to an injected npm executor; it is not corporate proxy/CA or live npm network acceptance.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: stricter validation rejects unusable updates before activation. Bun native fetch covers the stated registry/authentication configuration, not every npm transport option; unreadable non-missing configuration intentionally fails closed rather than adopting npm's log-and-continue policy. Error-diagnostic improvements remain tracked separately.
- Maintainer decision: runtime provisioning remains ahead of the scripts suite and release gate. It requires exact Node 24.19.0/Bun 1.3.14, network access unless pre-provisioned, and POSIX tools. Provisioning failure fails the gate and prevents the later scripts suite from starting. Gate placement, release-version pin alignment, mirror/TLS trust and timeout headroom remain explicit review items; local passing runs do not resolve those policy or infrastructure concerns.
- Not validated / out of scope: native Windows/all five release targets, official signed releases, ordinary-command launcher child-spawn behavior, complete release startup after rollback, Bun corporate proxy/CA behavior and production mirror provenance. Synthetic checksum archives do not establish signature acceptance. Bun's unavailable raw-probe observer does not prove zero probes or zero allocations. The existing release/runtime pins and outer CI timeout were not changed by this repair.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: a missing runtime in legacy object metadata retains the Node interpretation; unknown runtime or malformed metadata fails closed. Preserve the current installation and backup, restore matching known-good metadata or reinstall the same flavor in a new directory. Deleting only the manifest is not a recovery procedure. This is not completion of the overall Ink/OpenTUI migration.

The [English design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/127455a069bad15591262b1326c4e7eed8a0e6f9/docs/design/bun-runtime-boundary.md#standalone-update-integration-r1) and [Chinese design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/127455a069bad15591262b1326c4e7eed8a0e6f9/docs/design/bun-runtime-boundary.zh-CN.md) contain the synchronized runtime boundary, failure semantics, acceptance criteria and remaining limitations.

## Linked Issues

Related to #11607; runtime migration context #14046. Integrated source stack: #14134, #14139, #14142, #14187 and #14210. No automatic closure of the overall migration issue.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

Standalone 更新在下载、验证、激活和回滚过程中保留已安装的 Node 或 Bun runtime 类型。Node 保留 npm 传输以及继承的 registry、代理、CA 和鉴权配置。Bun standalone 查询发布标签不依赖外部 Node/npm，使用受支持的 builtin、global、user 和环境 registry/鉴权配置，同时排除隐式项目配置。

激活前，两种 runtime 都验证下载包身份、解释器身份、实际 CLI 版本以及生产启动器加载 CLI 的能力。预下载更新重新核对安装身份；拒绝更新时保留当前安装和回滚备份。Registry 查询现在同时展开键和值中的环境变量，修剪环境字段，并按最长匹配支持带尾斜杠路径、不带尾斜杠路径和裸 host 的凭据。读取非缺失配置失败时明确拒绝，而不静默选择另一个 registry。

这是整合 #14134、#14139、#14142、#14187、#14210 的完整 standalone 更新边界，包含先前 CI 取消测试的清理修正：11 个文件，+3218/-133。本批不修改 TUI，也不代表独立解释器调用点迁移已完成。

## 为什么需要

原更新器选择传统 Node 归档，无法保留 Bun 安装的 runtime。启动器只返回元数据版本，也不能证明 CLI 可以加载。独立复现进一步发现：损坏的 Node 启动器可能被激活；带环境模板的 npmrc 键、包含空白的配置路径和有效的不带尾斜杠鉴权键会选错 registry 或凭据。本次更新在替换前拒绝损坏启动器，并闭合实际观察到的七项 npm 配置差异。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 分别从 Node 和 Bun standalone 安装检查并应用更新。选择的归档及激活的 runtime 应保留原类型；有效更新及回滚应保留预期安装身份。
2. 使用包身份、runtime、target 或版本错误、CLI 缺失或损坏、启动器损坏的归档。直接和预下载激活都应在替换当前安装及备份前拒绝。预下载后改变安装身份，应在激活时重新核对。
3. 使用环境占位符、环境配置路径/token 两侧空白，以及带尾斜杠和不带尾斜杠鉴权键设置 scoped registry 和凭据。应选择正确的可信配置层及最长匹配凭据；兄弟路径、其他 host 和隐式项目配置不能提供该凭据。
4. 验证 HOME 缺失或相对路径、损坏元数据、不可读配置及跨 origin registry 重定向。应保留已说明的失败/兼容行为；拒绝更新时保留安装，跨 origin 重定向丢弃鉴权头。纯空白凭据不能恢复同名低优先级键中已被覆盖的凭据。

### 证据（修改前后）

在 `d41362f` 上，独立复现确认含语法损坏 Node 启动器的归档被接受，并发现七项 npm registry/鉴权差异；原始失败均保留。在 `356890b` 上，修复后的生产源码通过 build/typecheck/bundle、215 个定向单元测试、两个独立 launcher 案例、六个 npm 正控及原七项差异对照。三个空值案例仅记录观察，不计为通过：空/纯空白配置路径 fail closed，而 npm 记录 EISDIR 后继续；空 prefix 保留相对 cwd 的语义。

随后，[`356890b` 的 Ubuntu runtime 门禁](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39533506749/job/119004842831)失败：真实 Node 启动器的 help 路径在夹具临时目录中生成编译缓存。该启动器与 main 字节一致。此前本地运行在正式脚本外额外提供了独立缓存目录，CI 没有这层配置。独立正反控复现了默认 help 路径的残留，并确认同一 help 命令在自有缓存目录下通过，缓存仍实际启用。原 CI 失败和失败对照均保留。

当前 head `127455a069bad15591262b1326c4e7eed8a0e6f9` 只修复这处测试隔离，新增18行，无生产改动。重新执行的 build、typecheck、lint、格式检查及完整正式 runtime 矩阵均通过，外层 runner 不再提供缓存配置。Node 24.19.0 和 Bun 1.3.14 两种宿主都覆盖两种归档、有效更新/回滚和拒绝控制，八个损坏启动器案例全部拒绝更新。正式夹具现在验证缓存文件确实生成，同时保留全部严格临时目录为空、安装及备份断言。两个宿主均以0退出，捕获的469个进程身份全部消失，自有临时根已清理，未使用清理信号。

上述215个单元案例、独立 npm 对照和 bundle 证据仍归属于 `356890b`；此次仅改测试隔离，相关生产和单元测试源码未变。新的 Linux CI 和当前 head 审查仍待完成，旧批准属于先前提交。[review 处置](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14934#issuecomment-6306637980)及[缺失变量补充](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14934#issuecomment-6307099460)明确保留延期 Suggestions 和策略决策，不声称已全部修复。

### 已测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ arm64：当前 build/typecheck/lint/format 及双 runtime 宿主通过；未变源码的单元/对照/bundle 证据按上述提交归属 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 当前候选未做原生测试；POSIX 夹具和参数化路径不能证明 Windows 验收 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 新 head CI 待完成；前一提交的 runtime 门禁失败已在上文说明 |

### 环境（可选）

隔离 managed worktree；Node 24.19.0、Bun 1.3.14 和真实 npm 11.17.0 配置/鉴权模块。夹具使用自有 HOME、system/default settings、npm 配置、cwd、临时根、本地 HTTPS 服务以及合成归档/token。独立 npm 对照不访问外部 registry。Node 更新查询的传输夹具委托注入的 npm 执行器，不代表企业代理/CA 或实际 npm 网络验收。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：更严格的验证会在激活前拒绝不可用更新。Bun 原生 fetch 覆盖已说明的 registry/鉴权配置，而非全部 npm 传输选项；非缺失配置不可读时刻意 fail closed，不采用 npm 记录后继续的策略。错误诊断改进另行跟踪。
- 维护者决策：runtime provisioning 仍位于 scripts 套件和发布门禁之前，要求精确 Node 24.19.0/Bun 1.3.14、未预置时的网络访问及 POSIX 工具。Provisioning 失败会使门禁失败，后续 scripts 套件不会启动。门禁放置、发布版本钉对齐、镜像/TLS 信任和超时余量仍是明确的 review 项；本地绿灯不能解决这些策略或基础设施问题。
- 未验证或范围外：原生 Windows/全部五种发布 target、正式签名制品、启动器普通命令的子进程路径、回滚后完整正式版本启动、Bun 企业代理/CA 和生产镜像来源。合成 checksum 归档不能证明签名验收。Bun raw-probe observer 不可用不能证明零 probe 或零 allocation。本次修复未改变现有发布/runtime 版本钉及外层 CI 超时。
- 兼容/迁移说明：旧 object 元数据缺失 runtime 时保留 Node 解释；未知 runtime 或损坏元数据 fail closed。保留当前安装和备份，恢复匹配的正常元数据，或把同类型安装到新目录；只删除 manifest 不是恢复办法。本批不代表整体 Ink/OpenTUI 迁移完成。

[英文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/127455a069bad15591262b1326c4e7eed8a0e6f9/docs/design/bun-runtime-boundary.md#standalone-update-integration-r1)和[中文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/127455a069bad15591262b1326c4e7eed8a0e6f9/docs/design/bun-runtime-boundary.zh-CN.md)同步包含 runtime 边界、失败语义、验收标准及剩余限制。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #11607；runtime 迁移背景 #14046。整合来源 #14134、#14139、#14142、#14187、#14210。不自动关闭整体迁移 issue。

</details>

prs.title: feat(cua): streamline computer use and port native reliability fixes
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Computer Use exposes a compact native contract through direct MCP and a preloaded JavaScript runtime. Observations, element IDs, target ownership and input dispatch share the driver; JavaScript keeps persistent application handles and automatically displays observations. The existing browser SDK is integrated with its browser behavior preserved.

The native driver, Computer Use SDK, browser SDK and Node REPL are prepared together as version 0.26.0. The three npm packages are excluded from CLI version bumps and publication, and their dedicated release validates version pins and verified artifacts before publishing Browser SDK, CUA SDK and Node REPL in dependency order. Applicable upstream reliability fixes are adapted to the retained architecture. Linux supports X11; native Wayland support is removed. Runtime documentation replaces the two bundled Computer Use skills.

## Why it's needed

Repeated initialization, large observations and unconditional application activation add work to interactive tasks. This change reduces setup and observation overhead, checks the exact target before input, and addresses input delivery, capture, lifecycle and installation defects found during acceptance. A possibly delivered action remains explicitly unconfirmed and is never automatically replayed.

The upstream audit distinguishes retained baseline behavior, adapted fixes and deliberately excluded features. A classified upstream commit or passing unit test does not establish native application success.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Use direct MCP and the JavaScript runtime to observe and control an application. Confirm compact contracts, preloaded documentation, automatic accessibility/image output and persistent handles across cells. Reset should discard bindings and release session-owned keys.
- Observe two windows of one application. A current element ID must act only in the selected window. Stale IDs, ambiguous ownership and incomplete target facts should refuse before input.
- Exercise text, dialogs, menus and document save/rename. Confirm application callbacks or saved content independently. An unconfirmed action requires observation before another action.
- Keep another application active while exercising background input. Inspect actual modifiers, keyboard delivery, pointer, clipboard, window order and recovery separately. Transient target/menu cover is an accepted macOS limitation; incorrect target delivery or replay is not acceptable.
- On Windows/Linux, allow a foreground fallback only after an explicit pre-dispatch unsupported-background result. A sent or uncertain result must not trigger another dispatch.
- Verify private installation, replacement and owned-session cleanup while preserving unrelated installations and processes.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The acceptance record separates controlled source checks, packaged-consumer checks and native effects. Windows native callbacks/text/capture and Linux Xorg/Mutter/uinput text/key effects have independent evidence. Fresh mini Qwen canvas, popup and context-menu effects pass with recovery. Two fresh Writer instances independently confirm body focus after one App click, exact input and persisted XML after toolbar Save with the adopted repair. Official Codex fails before action at application binding, so its behavior and performance cannot be compared. Historical macOS document-save evidence retains its original candidate identity.

The initial merged candidate `3dc486a4db` includes main `5ec7d84ce6` and passes the actual default build, normal root typecheck and four focused release test files (311 passed, 24 skipped). CI follow-up `26b2d7b181` removes the unused Electron development dependency that leaked from the SDK into the root workspace, prunes its lockfile graph and fixes one formatting issue. A complete clean installation and the original desktop-isolation guard pass; that candidate also passes build, bundle, typecheck, full ESLint/Prettier and five focused script test files (157 passed, 2 skipped). The full CI static and no-AK integration jobs then passed. CI follow-up `f409e9fb34` removes obsolete tests of the retired skill documents, verifies their absence through the real bundled loader, updates the active Desktop Relay installation command to 0.26.0 and awaits asynchronous kernel disposal before existing lifecycle assertions. Independent reproduction was RED before the fixes and GREEN afterward: eight test files, 131 passed, zero skipped; the actual ten-kernel PID and directory cleanup assertions are preserved. This candidate also passes the normal build, bundle, typecheck, full formatting, targeted ESLint and all seven CUA runtime documentation/dispatch tests. The [main CI run](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39387548588) passes lint/static analysis, the full Ubuntu unit suite, no-AK integration and Web Shell E2E (335 browser smoke checks). Separate auxiliary checks are tracked in the PR checks. OSWorld evaluation will run after release by maintainer decision; no benchmark success-rate, token or latency improvement is claimed before that evaluation. Historical AP results use a different agent/protocol and are not a matched before/after measurement. The separate E2E report records exact candidate identities, negative results and observation limits.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | mini canvas/popup/context native effects pass 3/3; adopted Writer focus/input/toolbar Save passes in two fresh instances. F31 ARM/Intel release, four coherent archives and 11/11 non-GUI runtime/install groups pass. Official Codex comparison is inconclusive before action. |
| 🪟 Windows | Actual MSVC release, native GUI callbacks/text/capture, direct/production Node MCP and private installer/package lifecycle verified. Actual interactive High Administrator; no Medium-integrity, native ARM64 or signed-UIAccess claim. |
| 🐧 Linux | v24 real Xorg/Mutter/uinput CLI text/key and SDK key effects verified, plus direct/production MCP and private packages/installers. The paused-target case demonstrates unconfirmed delivery/no observed replay; only a arrived after resume, so complete-text success is not claimed. |

### Environment (optional)

Isolated worktrees and task-owned fixtures with pinned sources and artifacts. All remaining native macOS GUI and fresh Codex comparison run on mini. Local macOS work is limited to compilation, package/source checks and merge validation. Windows uses the existing interactive Administrator desktop. Linux uses an isolated X11 environment on the actual test host kernel; native Wayland and physical human concurrency are not claimed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: background input support depends on the application and platform. macOS target/menu windows may briefly cover the active application; record effects and recovery separately. Windows/Linux may require a declared foreground fallback. LibreOffice background pixel requests that cannot honor the requested point safely refuse.
- Not validated / out of scope: post-release model/OSWorld scores, native Wayland, additional upstream browser behavior and new broad script/capture/cursor features. Native-unverified cases remain individually identified in the acceptance record.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: JavaScript exposes js/js_reset with a 30-second default cell limit and preloaded cua. Direct MCP uses the compact contract; the extended native catalog is opt-in. Native and JavaScript package versions must be released together through the existing feature release workflow.

Design records are synchronized in English and Chinese: [design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/3dc486a4dbf43544a19af63b53e0f6350ce70495/docs/design/cua-upgrade-2026-10.md) / [设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/3dc486a4dbf43544a19af63b53e0f6350ce70495/docs/design/cua-upgrade-2026-10.zh-CN.md), [platform ports](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/3dc486a4dbf43544a19af63b53e0f6350ce70495/docs/design/cua-upgrade-platform-ports.md) / [平台移植](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/3dc486a4dbf43544a19af63b53e0f6350ce70495/docs/design/cua-upgrade-platform-ports.zh-CN.md), [acceptance](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/3dc486a4dbf43544a19af63b53e0f6350ce70495/docs/design/cua-upgrade-acceptance-2026-10.md) / [验收](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/3dc486a4dbf43544a19af63b53e0f6350ce70495/docs/design/cua-upgrade-acceptance-2026-10.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次改动

Computer Use 通过直接 MCP 与预载 JavaScript 运行时提供精简原生契约。观察、元素 ID、目标所有权和输入派发共用 driver；JavaScript 保留应用句柄并自动显示观察。现有浏览器 SDK 已接入，其浏览器行为保持原有实现。

原生 driver、Computer Use SDK、浏览器 SDK 和 Node REPL 统一准备为 0.26.0。三个 npm 包从 CLI 版本更新及发布中排除，由专用流程核对版本 pin 和已验证产物，再按浏览器 SDK、CUA SDK、Node REPL 的依赖顺序发布。适用的上游可靠性修复按保留架构适配。Linux 支持 X11，移除原生 Wayland。运行时文档替代两个 bundled Computer Use skill。

## 改动原因

重复初始化、庞大观察与无条件激活应用增加交互任务开销。本次降低初始化和观察负担，在输入前检查精确目标，并处理验收中发现的输入派发、截图、生命周期与安装缺陷。可能已派发的动作明确保持未确认，绝不自动重放。

上游审计区分保留的基线行为、适配的修复及主动排除的功能。完成上游提交分类或通过单元测试，不代表原生应用操作成功。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 验证方法

- 分别用直接 MCP 和 JavaScript 运行时观察、操作应用，确认精简契约、预载文档、自动 AX/图像输出及跨 cell 持久句柄。重置应丢弃绑定并释放会话持有的按键。
- 观察同一应用的两个窗口。当前元素 ID 只能操作所选窗口；过期 ID、归属歧义和不完整目标事实应在输入前拒绝。
- 操作文本、对话框、菜单及文档保存/重命名，独立核验应用回调或保存内容。动作未确认时，后续操作前必须先观察。
- 保持另一应用活动再测试后台输入，分别检查实际修饰键、键盘投递、指针、剪贴板、窗口顺序和恢复。macOS 目标/菜单短暂遮挡是接受的边界；错误目标派发或重放不可接受。
- Windows/Linux 仅在明确的派发前不支持后台结果后，允许一次前台 fallback；已发送或不确定不得触发再次派发。
- 验证私有安装、替换与会话自有资源清理，保留无关安装和进程。

### 前后证据

验收记录区分受控源码检查、打包消费者检查和原生效果。Windows 原生回调/文本/截图及 Linux Xorg/Mutter/uinput 文本/按键效果有独立证据。mini Qwen 画布、下拉与右键菜单新用例实际效果及恢复通过；已采纳修复的两个全新 Writer 实例均独立确认一次 App 点击后的正文焦点、精确输入及工具栏保存后的 XML。官方 Codex 在动作前的应用绑定阶段失败，无法比较其行为或性能。历史 macOS 文档保存证据保留原候选身份。

初始合并候选 `3dc486a4db` 已合入 main `5ec7d84ce6`，通过实际默认构建、普通 root typecheck 及四个发布相关定向测试文件（311 通过、24 跳过）。CI 修复 `26b2d7b181` 移除从 SDK 泄漏到根工作区的非必需 Electron 开发依赖，清理对应锁文件依赖图，并修复一处格式。完整全新安装及原桌面隔离门禁均通过；该候选还通过构建、bundle、typecheck、全仓 ESLint/Prettier 与五个定向脚本测试文件（157 通过、2 跳过）。随后完整 CI 静态检查和 no-AK 集成测试通过。CI 修复 `f409e9fb34` 清理针对已退役 skill 文档的旧测试，使用实际 bundled loader 验证它们不再提供，将活动桌面中继安装命令同步为 0.26.0，并在既有生命周期断言前等待异步内核清理。独立验证先复现失败、修复后通过：八个测试文件共 131 通过、零跳过；十内核实际 PID 退出和目录清理断言完整保留。该候选另通过普通构建、bundle、typecheck、全仓格式、定向 ESLint 及七项 CUA 运行时文档/派发测试。[本轮主 CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39387548588) 的静态检查、Ubuntu 整库单测、no-AK 集成和 Web Shell E2E 全部通过（浏览器冒烟 335 项通过）。独立辅助检查的状态列于 PR checks。维护者决定将 OSWorld 评测放在发布后，执行前不声称成功率、token 或耗时提升。历史 AP 使用不同 agent/协议，不是同条件前后测量。单独的 E2E 报告列出精确候选身份、负例及观察限制。

### 已测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | mini 画布/下拉/右键菜单原生效果 3/3 通过；已采纳修复的 Writer 焦点/输入/工具栏保存通过两个新实例。F31 ARM/Intel release、四一致归档及 11/11 非 GUI 运行/安装组通过。官方 Codex 对比在动作前受阻，无法比较。 |
| 🪟 Windows | 实际 MSVC release、原生 GUI 回调/文本/截图、直接/生产 Node MCP 及私有安装器/包生命周期已验证。实际为交互式 High Administrator；不声称 Medium integrity、原生 ARM64 或 signed UIAccess。 |
| 🐧 Linux | v24 真实 Xorg/Mutter/uinput 的 CLI 文本/按键和 SDK 按键效果已验证，另通过直接/生产 MCP 及私有包/安装器。暂停目标用例证明未确认投递及观察期间无重放；恢复后仅收到 a，不声称完整文字成功。 |

### 环境

使用独立 worktree、任务自有夹具及固定源码/产物。剩余 macOS 原生 GUI 和新 Codex 对比全部在 mini 执行。本地 macOS 仅做编译、包/源码检查与合并验证。Windows 使用既有交互式 Administrator 桌面。Linux 在真实测试宿主内核上的隔离 X11 环境运行；不声称原生 Wayland 或真人硬件并发。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：后台输入能力依赖应用与平台。macOS 目标/菜单窗口可能短暂遮挡活动应用，效果和恢复分别记录。Windows/Linux 可能需要已声明的前台 fallback。LibreOffice 后台像素请求无法可靠命中请求位置时安全拒绝。

- 迁移事项：JavaScript 提供 js/js_reset，默认 cell 时限 30 秒并预载 cua；直接 MCP 使用精简契约，扩展原生目录需 opt-in。原生和 JavaScript 包须在既有 feature 发布流程中一起发布。

prs.title: fix(daemon): give the ACP initialize handshake its own startup budget
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Channel startup currently spends a single `initTimeoutMs` on two different phases: spawning the ACP child and the `initialize` handshake. This PR gives each phase its own budget and keeps the pair bounded with one absolute deadline, so a slow cold spawn can no longer starve the handshake.

## Why it's needed

`qwen serve` answers the first sessions after a cold start on Windows with `504 AcpSessionBridge initialize timed out after Nms` (#14977). The reported numbers — `7400 / 4854 / 1637 / 3601 ms` instead of `10000` — are the tell: they are `initTimeoutMs` minus the spawn cost, not the configured budget.

`packages/acp-bridge/src/channel-startup.ts` takes `startupStartedAt` before the channel factory runs, gives the factory the full `initTimeoutMs`, and then hands `initialize` only `Math.max(1, initTimeoutMs - elapsed)`. The spawn phase therefore spends the handshake's budget. When the spawn takes longer than about half the budget the handshake cannot finish in what is left; when the spawn consumes the budget the handshake is left the 1 ms floor and can never succeed. Because a failed startup tears the child down, every retry pays the cold start again — the `504 / 504 / 504 → 9002 → 9884 → 502 ms` pattern in the report.

`initializeTimeoutMs` is documented as "how long to wait for the child's `initialize` reply", so the implementation is the part that disagrees with the contract.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

`cd packages/acp-bridge && npx vitest run src/channel-startup.test.ts` — 3 passed.

Red/green: with only `channel-startup.ts` reverted, the updated case fails with `expected true to be false` on the 79 ms assertion — the old code aborted the handshake at 50 ms because the factory had already spent 30 ms of the 50 ms budget. With the change it passes.

`tsc --noEmit -p packages/acp-bridge/tsconfig.json`, `eslint` and `prettier --check` are clean on the touched files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible change; this is daemon-side timeout accounting. The before/after is the assertion itself: for a factory that spends 30 ms of a 50 ms budget, the handshake timeout is reported as `20 ms` before and `50 ms` after.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local source checkout, Vitest 3.2.7 on Node 24.19 (Windows 11). The channel factory in these tests is a fake, so no child agent process is spawned.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: worst-case startup becomes `2 * initTimeoutMs` (20 s at the default) instead of `initTimeoutMs`. In the normal path both phases finish well inside one budget, so nothing changes; only "cold spawn plus slow handshake" uses the second budget, and that combination failed before this change.
- Not validated / out of scope: no end-to-end reproduction against a real `qwen serve` on a Windows cold start; the test uses the in-memory channel fake. The package test suite has 14 pre-existing failures on this Windows host from `EPERM` when tests create symlinks (no Developer Mode); none of them touch channel startup.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The configured value and its default are unchanged, and `initializeTimeoutMs` keeps its documented meaning.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14977

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

当前 channel 启动把同一个 `initTimeoutMs` 花在两个不同的阶段上：拉起 ACP 子进程和 `initialize` 握手。这个 PR 让两个阶段各有一份预算，并用一个绝对截止时间把两者总时长限住，慢的冷启动不再挤压握手的时间。

## 为什么需要

Windows 上冷启动后的头几次会话，`qwen serve` 会返回 `504 AcpSessionBridge initialize timed out after Nms`（#14977）。报告里 `7400 / 4854 / 1637 / 3601 ms` 而不是 `10000` 正是线索：这些是 `initTimeoutMs` 减去 spawn 耗时后的剩余值，不是配置的预算。

`packages/acp-bridge/src/channel-startup.ts` 在 channel factory 运行之前就记录了 `startupStartedAt`，把完整的 `initTimeoutMs` 给了 factory，然后只把 `Math.max(1, initTimeoutMs - elapsed)` 交给 `initialize`。于是 spawn 阶段花掉了握手的预算：spawn 超过预算一半时握手就来不及；spawn 吃满预算时握手只剩 1 ms 下限，永远不可能成功。而启动失败会销毁子进程，所以每次重试都要重新付一遍冷启动成本——正是报告里 `504 / 504 / 504 → 9002 → 9884 → 502 ms` 的过程。

`initializeTimeoutMs` 的文档写的是"等待子进程 `initialize` 回复的时长"，所以与契约不符的是实现。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

`cd packages/acp-bridge && npx vitest run src/channel-startup.test.ts` —— 3 个用例通过。

红/绿验证：只回退 `channel-startup.ts` 时，更新后的用例在第 79 ms 的断言处失败（`expected true to be false`）——旧代码在 50 ms 就中止了握手，因为 factory 已经花掉了 50 ms 预算里的 30 ms。应用改动后通过。

`tsc --noEmit -p packages/acp-bridge/tsconfig.json`、`eslint`、`prettier --check` 在改动文件上均通过。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A —— 无用户可见变化，只是 daemon 侧的超时记账。Before/After 就是断言本身：factory 花掉 50 ms 预算中的 30 ms 时，握手超时在改动前报 `20 ms`，改动后报 `50 ms`。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ✅  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

本地源码 + Vitest 3.2.7 / Node 24.19（Windows 11）。测试中的 channel factory 是 fake，不会真的拉起子进程。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：最坏启动时长从 `initTimeoutMs` 变成 `2 * initTimeoutMs`（默认 20 s）。正常路径下两个阶段都远小于一份预算，行为不变；只有"冷启动慢 + 握手慢"这一种组合会用到第二份预算，而这种组合在改动前是直接失败的。
- 未验证/范围外：没有对真实 `qwen serve` 的 Windows 冷启动做端到端复现，测试用的是内存 channel fake。该包测试套件在本机 Windows 上有 14 个既有失败，全部是测试创建符号链接时的 `EPERM`（未开启开发者模式），与 channel 启动无关。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。配置项及其默认值未变，`initializeTimeoutMs` 仍保持文档中的含义。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #14977

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): queue the sdk-java host lock first-come-first-serve (#14743)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Turns the sdk-java host lock from a bare `flock --wait` into a first-come-first-serve ticketed queue. A new sourced helper, `.github/scripts/sdk-java-lock.sh`, replaces the inline lock block at both acquisition sites in `.github/workflows/sdk-java.yml`: every acquirer takes the next sequence number atomically, only the oldest live ticket retries the lock, dead owners are reaped, and the lock still releases automatically at the step boundary. The head blocks in one `flock --wait` for its remaining budget, so it enters the kernel's wait queue once and keeps its arrival position instead of re-entering behind waiters that stayed resident. The pinned infrastructure-signature error text (`lock not acquired within ...`) is preserved and the timeout names the head ticket, the wait budget stays 5400 s, and the job ceilings stay 150/280 minutes. A design document in both languages is included.

## Why it's needed

`flock(2)` makes no ordering promise, and a waiter keeps its place only while it stays blocked in one call: re-entering the queue — a second acquisition in a later step, a poll, a sliced wait — puts it behind every waiter that stayed resident. That is what the pool has been doing: on 2026-10-18/19 jobs died at exactly 2400 s and 3600 s waiting budgets across at least three physical hosts (#14566), and on 2026-10-20 a full-tier main run parked for the full 5400 s budget in the same way even after #14801 raised it. A budget bounds one attempt; it cannot bound a queue whose depth is set by arrivals. Fairness is what turns the budget into an actual bound: the waiting behavior becomes position-in-line × sibling hold, measurable and attributable from the wait log lines, instead of luck.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `npx vitest run scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`. The new test exercises the helper under the same shell flags a GitHub Actions step uses (`-eo pipefail`), with `flock` stubbed on `PATH`: FIFO ordering across two waiters, reaping of a dead owner's ticket, and the timeout signature with ticket cleanup. On the pool, watch the first self-hosted Maven steps after merge: each should print `Waiting for the sdk-java host lock as queue ticket N` when queued, and a hang is then attributable to a ticket number instead of a silent flock.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CI routing change with no user-visible surface. Before: run 39361330656's MariaDB leg waited exactly 3600 s (09:24:31 → 10:24:31Z) and failed with `sdk-java host lock not acquired within 60 minutes`; the same shape recurred at 5400 s after #14801. After: the vitest behavior pins above, plus pool soak on merge.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ (flock stubbed locally; the pool is the soak) |

### Environment (optional)

macOS with both /bin/bash and the GH-fidelity flags; `flock` stubbed through `PATH`. The production command line (`flock --nonblock`) is unchanged on the runners.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a dead waiter whose PID is recycled by a long-lived process keeps its ticket until the 1800 s mtime arm reaps it, so an idle lock is unreachable for at most that long. The counter is a `flock` on an append-only counter file, so there is no aging path to clear.
- Not validated / out of scope: sharding the lock per suite, capping registrations per host, or moving suites off the shared pool. Fairness makes each follow-up measurable instead of urgent.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The error text keeps its pinned substring, the `qwen-autofix.yml` infra-rerun classifier is untouched, and `.size-baseline` records the workflow's new size.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14743
Refs #14566

prs.title: fix(web-shell): bound pending edit diffs to nearby context
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Pending and in-progress whole-file edit previews show each change with up to three surrounding lines and file-relative hunk coordinates. Common file ends are trimmed before comparing. Oversized previews explicitly report omission; LF and CRLF final-newline-only edits show a localized notice. Replacement-fragment arguments retain their headerless preview, and supplied patches and completed previews retain their existing behavior.

Diff previews visibly mark invisible characters instead of rendering them as indistinguishable source text. Both raw patches and full-content artifact views use the same visible escapes; the underlying CodeMirror document retains its original bytes. Call details apply their 4,000-character content limit after escaping. Uniform CRLF previews remain clean when their final line is unterminated, while actual ending conversions remain visible.

## What review rounds 6–9 changed

The first five rounds established the bounded preview, the visible escapes and the source-layer CRLF verdict. Three findings in rounds 6–9 were about the *price* of those fixes, and each is now paid only where it is owed.

**The merge-side escape is decided per pair, not per file.** The narrow (unified) artifact layout cannot decorate the deleted side — `@codemirror/merge` paints it from its own `originalDoc` into raw text nodes that no view extension reaches — so both sides are neutralised before they enter the merge view. That transform doubles every backslash to stay injective, which meant a regex written `/\d+/` rendered `/\\d+/`, a Windows path `C:\tmp` rendered `C:\\tmp`, and `"\n"` rendered `"\\n"` for every file containing a backslash, while the wide branch showed the raw bytes. `escapePairForMerge` now returns the pair untouched when neither side carries an invisible character and escapes both when either does. The decision is joint on purpose: a per-side test lets one side's literal `\u200b` meet the other side's escaped real U+200B and report "unchanged".

**The CRLF vote only runs where nobody decided.** Builders now stamp a negative verdict (`\diff-crlf-mixed`) alongside the affirmative one, so `parseUnifiedDiff` infers uniformity from rendered rows only for raw patches no builder produced. The inference also learned the two facts it lacked: the unterminated-final-line allowance keys on git's `\ No newline at end of file` notice rather than on row position, and a final row that kept its terminator still votes instead of being withheld as possibly truncated.

**The unbounded builder has the bounded builder's terminator gate.** An edit whose only change is the final newline now renders the localized notice in tool cards and call details too, instead of `-y` and `+y` byte-identical under a `+1/-1` badge.

## Why it's needed

A one-line edit near line 100 of a 200-line file previously rendered 201 rows. Whole-file previews now render nine rows with correct coordinates. This keeps approval readable without changing the permission protocol or tool execution.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Edit line 100 of a 200-line file: the approval dialog and pending/in-progress whole-file card should show lines 97–103 and +1/-1.
- Supply replacement fragments through the edit tool's real arguments: expect the existing headerless preview, without a claim about the fragment's file offset.
- Check a large insertion and distant edits that exceed the preview budget: expect an omitted notice rather than a fabricated whole-file rewrite.
- Add or remove only the final LF or CRLF terminator: expect the localized notice and no +1/-1 badge. Adding/removing a sole blank line and converting LF to CRLF remain real content changes.
- Review a CRLF file without a final newline: a content edit should not add terminator noise.
- Compare real invisible characters with literal escape text and mixed full-content/raw-patch artifact entries: only real characters receive a visible decoration, with matching display in both renderers. CodeMirror retains the original document.
- Expand a call whose escaped output exceeds 4,000 characters: content remains within the bound and a truncation notice appears. Embedded notice-like patch rows remain literal.
- Check supplied patches, completed previews and failed calls: preserve their existing behavior.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The five round-5 review findings were reproduced at the exact reviewed head `e6e31c40`: seven independent component witnesses failed before the fix and passed afterwards. Six deliberate fix reversions each fail their corresponding regression.

On 2026-10-13 the branch was synchronized with upstream main `6373fc4e` in signed merge commit `e1b302e4`. The only textual conflict was the transcript bundle budget; the upstream Excel preview assertions and all round-5 fixes are retained. The transcript JS remainder measures 1,332,856 UTF-16 units, below the existing PR ceiling of 1,336,000. No additional budget increase was needed.

Frozen-lockfile installation, the complete workspace build and CLI bundle, Web Shell TypeScript, related ESLint, and the normal staged-file Prettier/ESLint commit hook pass. The six focused rendering/diff suites pass 426 tests, and the build-artifact suite passes all 30 tests.

The full Web Shell unit run reports 11,520 passed, 83 failed, and three unhandled errors. Failures were confined to the session-provider suite (82) and the settings-route development-server test (one, default 5-second timeout). A separate run of those exact files at the default timeout passes all 420 session-provider tests and 20 of the 21 settings-route tests. A further settings-file run with a command-line 15-second ceiling passes all 21 tests; no repository timeout configuration was changed. The session-provider source, its tests and the settings test are identical to upstream main. An exact-main runtime failure is not claimed, and the complete default-timeout suite is not reported green. Whole-workspace tests and live daemon/model/native Desktop E2E were not run in this synchronization.

### Round 9 evidence

Each of the three findings above was reproduced at `2d1aeb5f` before being fixed, and each fix is pinned by a test that fails when it is removed:

| Revert | Test that goes red |
| :-- | :-- |
| pair gate in `escapePairForMerge` | `ArtifactPanel.test.tsx` narrow backslash case (`state.doc.toString()` gains doubled backslashes) |
| negative CRLF verdict | `unifiedDiff.test.ts` source-refused pair and context-window cases |
| notice-keyed allowance | `unifiedDiff.test.ts` unterminated-final-line case |
| builder terminator gate | `unifiedDiff.test.ts` builder pin and `DiffView.test.tsx` notice case |

`ArtifactPanel.test.tsx` did not run when this PR was opened: `@qwen-code/sdk/daemon` had no `dist/daemon/index.js`, so the file failed to collect and the narrow merge branch was described rather than covered. The declaration bundle was rebuilt for this round, and the file now runs: 149 passed, both narrow-branch cases included. Across the seven suites this PR touches: **475 passed**, and ESLint plus Prettier are clean on the eight changed files. `tsc --noEmit` reports no error in any changed file; the 63 errors it emits are pre-existing missing-module errors for `exceljs`, `ssf` and `shiki-files` in this checkout. `build-artifact.test.ts` reports the same 8 failures with and without this round's changes, all from a `dist/` built before it.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :-- |
| Windows | Actual React/CodeMirror jsdom regressions, package build and static checks; full unit result disclosed above |
| macOS | Not tested locally |
| Linux | Awaiting upstream CI |

### Environment (optional)

Windows, Node.js 24.20.0, pnpm workspace dependencies and Vitest/jsdom. The workspace CLI was built and bundled during frozen-lockfile installation. No live daemon, live model or native Desktop E2E is claimed.

## Risk & Scope

Compact whole-file previews omit distant unchanged lines; oversized input yields an explicit omitted notice. Invisible characters are represented visibly, so displayed escapes differ from the underlying bytes. Already escaped adapter text stays literal because its original character provenance is unavailable. No permission protocol, tool execution or core-package changes; no dependency changes beyond upstream main synchronization. The current-head CI requires maintainer authorization.

AI assistance: implemented and verified with AI coding assistants, including OpenAI Codex.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13766

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

整份文件的待执行／执行中编辑预览仅显示修改和前后各三行上下文，保留文件坐标；真实工具参数中的替换片段仍保持无块头的原有预览，不伪称文件位置。超预算预览明确省略，LF/CRLF 的末尾换行增删明确提示；无末尾换行的 CRLF 文件保持干净，真实行尾转换和空白行增删保持为实际差分。

不可见字符以可区分的节点显示，原始补丁和完整内容的 artifact 视图使用相同展示，CodeMirror 原文不改写。调用详情在转义后限制为 4,000 字符。精确 review head 上的七项独立复现先失败后通过，六个负向验证均能发现修复被移除。本轮同步 main 6373fc4e 后，六套定向测试 426 项、构建产物 30 项通过；锁定依赖安装、全仓库构建及 CLI 打包、包类型检查、相关静态检查和提交 hook 通过。实测 transcript JS 为 1,332,856 UTF-16 单位，沿用原 PR 的 1,336,000 上限。

本轮完整 Web Shell 单元测试为 11,520 通过／83 失败，另有 3 项未处理错误；失败集中在 session-provider 和开发服务器测试。默认期限单独复跑后，session-provider 420 项全通过，开发服务器文件 20/21 通过。仅用命令参数将后者期限放宽至 15 秒时，21 项全通过；未改仓库超时配置。相关源文件和测试与精确 main 一致，但未运行精确 main 的失败复现，不据此声称基线也失败；完整默认期限套件仍不算全绿。上游 CI 待维护者授权；未验证真实模型、live daemon 或原生 Desktop E2E。 第 6–9 轮修的是前述修复的代价：合并侧转义改为按「文本对」判定，不含不可见字符的文件不再加倍反斜杠；构建器同时写出否定的 CRLF 裁决，行投票只在无人裁决时运行，且未终止末行的例外以 git 提示为键；无界构建器补齐终止符门。四项回退各自都能让对应测试变红；本轮重建 SDK 声明产物后 ArtifactPanel 测试可运行，七套定向测试共 475 项通过。

</details>

## What this PR does

Adds the last planned FG13f cell. A `MessageDisplay` command Hook suppresses a streamed reply; the turn completes with no text on the public ledger. The Harness is then restarted so the Session is loaded from the store, and a second prompt is submitted: the next model request's history must not carry the suppressed text either.

The Hook fixture gains a `hook-suppress` mode that records the Hook input and answers `{"suppressOutput": true}`.

## Why it's needed

FG13f is the decision/output arm of the Hosted Hook fault-gate round on #14449. The in-process model tests pin `suppressOutput`; nothing pins the persistence boundary — the committed assistant message, the public ledger row and the request history rebuilt after a reload. A regression there would resurrect text the Hook suppressed, on the next turn.

### How to verify

prs.title: fix(core): recover outer XML calls with quoted call content
prs.body:
## Summary

Recover a complete outer XML tool call whose parameter value quotes other calls, while keeping the quoted markup inert. An ambiguous or malformed block is now rejected on its own and the scan resumes past it, so one bad envelope no longer costs the genuine calls beside it.

## What this changes

- Closes the reported gap in #13492: a `write_file` whose `content` contains an unfenced example call is recovered exactly once with the complete content, and the quoted call never dispatches.
- Rejects ambiguity per block instead of per turn. The whole-text opener pre-scan, the unclosed-opener veto and the fence-disagreement pass that used to return no calls for the whole turn are gone; a rejected block resumes at its own next open tag.
- Reads a depth-paired value's complete extent when the value documents a nested parameter element, instead of stopping at the flat match.
- Treats HTML comments and CommonMark indented code blocks as documentation, like fences and `<example>`. A value that quotes a call used to let a commented-out shell command dispatch while stripping its own markup from the visible turn.
- Rejects a block whose parameter names repeat, because the quote advance can otherwise pull a stray element into the block and silently overwrite an argument.
- Keeps a value that only mentions a bare closing tag on the flat path, so that block is rejected rather than dispatched with a truncated write.

## Reviewer Test Plan

Return a document write whose content quotes a harmless call, followed by an independent control-file read. Expect the write executed once with exact bytes, the quoted call inert, and the read executed.

Then vary the shape: a trailing parameter behind the quoted value, a documented parameter element inside the value, the same shape inside a fence, an `<example>`, an HTML comment and an indented block, a malformed block before an intact call, and a prose mention of `<!--` before a live call. Expect documentation to stay inert and the intact calls to recover.

## Evidence

- `packages/core`: `xml-tool-call-fallback.test.ts` 138/138, `llm-chat.test.ts` 567/567; typecheck, ESLint and Prettier clean on both changed files.
- 6000-case seeded fuzz over tag/fence/comment fragments: no exception, no hang, max 2.8 ms; `recovered: false` never changes `remainingText`.
- Cost after deleting the whole-turn pre-scan: 1000 malformed openers inside a fence ~1 ms (was ~2.2 s at the reviewed head), 64 KB example body ~13 ms (was ~420 ms).
- No CLI/tmux end-to-end run this round. The production call site is unchanged; the earlier CLI evidence covered the whole-turn decline, which this version removes.

## Risk & Scope

The contract changes from turn-wide decline to per-block rejection. That is what #13492 asks for, and it restores the three witnesses the branch had inverted. It also means a complete call inside a rejected block's unclosed value is recovered again, as on the merge base.

Known limitation: a value that only mentions a bare closing tag, without quoting a complete call, still rejects its block. Accepting it would dispatch the truncated value pinned by `preserves malformed blocks instead of dispatching partial calls`, so this keeps `Refs` rather than `Fixes`.

Performance #13787 stays open: the remaining per-value fence scans are quadratic in the number of value-quoting blocks. Windows and macOS were not run locally.

## Linked issues

Refs #13492. Follow-up to #13515.

<details><summary>中文说明</summary>

外层调用在参数值里引用其它调用（例如 `write_file` 的 content 里写了一段示例 call）时，现在只恢复一次外层调用、保留完整 content，被引用的调用保持为数据；参数、example 或围栏归属有歧义时，只拒绝出问题的那个 block 并从它自己的下一个 open tag 继续扫描，不再让整轮失败。

同时把 HTML 注释与 CommonMark 缩进代码块当作文档区（此前值里引用调用会让被注释掉的 shell 命令被执行，且标记从可见文本中消失），并拒绝参数名重复的 block（quote advance 可能把游离元素拉进 block 并覆盖前面的参数）。

验证：`xml-tool-call-fallback.test.ts` 138/138、`llm-chat.test.ts` 567/567，两个改动文件 typecheck/ESLint/Prettier 干净；6000 例种子 fuzz 无异常、无挂起；1000 个围栏内畸形 opener 约 1ms（此前约 2.2s），64KB example 约 13ms（此前约 420ms）。本轮未跑 CLI/tmux 端到端，生产调用点未变。

已知限制：值里只提及裸结束标记（没有引用完整调用）时仍拒绝该 block，因为接受它会派发被 `preserves malformed blocks instead of dispatching partial calls` 钉住的截断值，因此尾注保持 `Refs`。性能 #13787 继续跟进。

</details>

prs.title: feat(workflow): add per-turn human-origin workflow hints
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a one-turn Workflow suggestion for `ultracode` and the existing `workflow` keyword across terminal, IDE, Web and explicitly declared TypeScript SDK human submissions. The reminder enters the model request after prompt admission; it preserves the user's display text and does not activate from expanded context, automation or historical messages. Tool continuations do not add it again.

SDK streaming messages can opt in individually with `origin: { kind: 'human' }`. Missing or malformed declarations, string convenience prompts, `-p` and plain stdin keep ordinary chat behavior without keyword activation. ACP reuses the existing public original-submission declaration and its daemon ownership checks. The existing opt-out applies to live sessions, and advice respects Workflow reachability, the discovery bridge and named-workflow restrictions.

Preserves queued and cancelled draft projections, including editable large-paste bodies and placeholder collisions. Completed OpenTUI submissions retain a separate editable recall payload while the transcript keeps the original display text; recalled text remains unknown input. An eligible current human intent bypasses a completed speculative result that was generated without it, while ordinary submissions retain cache acceptance. Ink's indicator and telemetry follow actual reminder application.

## Why it's needed

Workflow keyword steering currently belongs to Ink's submit path. Other human entry points cannot request the same behavior, and moving the reminder without preserving separate user display and model projections can discard literal user text or expanded paste content. This change gives the two model loops the same narrowly scoped policy while keeping source declarations separate from Hook provenance and tool permissions.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- With workflows enabled, submit each keyword from both terminal renderers and the supported IDE/Web composers. Expect exactly one model-only reminder for an eligible new turn; the next ordinary turn receives none. Both keywords together still produce one reminder.
- In one public SDK session send unknown, declared-human and unknown messages, forcing two tool continuations during the middle turn. Only that human turn gains a reminder, with no added copies on continuations. Unattended text/json/stream-json and stdin remain ineligible.
- Verify raw text without a keyword remains ineligible when attachments or Hook context contain one. A blocking submission Hook must produce zero provider requests. Forged daemon-private metadata must not activate the reminder.
- In Ink and strict Bun/OpenTUI, inspect literal leading tags in the user row and recall. Queue a large paste, restore and edit it, then add a same-length paste. Both bodies and the appended instruction must reach the model intact. In Ink also cancel the actual pasted turn and edit its restored draft.
- Complete an OpenTUI large-paste turn, recall it with Up, edit and resubmit. The current provider request must retain the complete pasted body and edits without a placeholder; recalled input must remain unknown.
- In Ink Vim mode, fresh insert-mode typing remains eligible. Recall history, delete it into a register with `dd`, then paste with `p` and submit twice; neither register-derived turn should add a reminder. Fresh typing after clearing should work again.
- With speculation enabled, submit a matching completed suggestion containing an eligible keyword. It must enter the normal turn with its human intent; ordinary input must still accept the cached result.
- Toggle the existing opt-out through an ordinary settings save during a live session and across different daemon workspaces, including a save while a turn is busy. The next eligible turn must use its owner's current setting without an explicit reload. Hidden Workflow requires both bridge halves; named-only advice must use `{ name, args }` and omit script authoring.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The installed 0.25.2 release baseline added the existing Ink `workflow` hint but ignored `ultracode` and the SDK human-origin declaration. The comparison baseline is the installed release; the changes below are the DW-03 diff. This branch includes upstream main through `a4937a3533be05271870b99614a8ef94ed733b3d`.

Controlled real-process checks capture the reminder in provider requests while preserving submitted user text. The public SDK unknown → human with two tool continuations → unknown sequence has current-turn reminder counts `[0, 1, 1, 1, 0]`. The latest repair head is `22bf052c0cc57ff063c9a95a95d5fbc65affb814`: 22 integration cases passed, with one explicit OpenTUI Vim skip. Runtime checks used the frozen artifact from `b3d5bdede30fdbb06dcf492014e29f8a136771c2`; the final commit changes only a test mock, and all production sources and all 1,456 runtime artifact files are unchanged. Independent checks cover Vim register provenance and bounded large-input performance. The earlier report retains its original artifact identity, including browser observations; browser UI behavior was not rerun on this repair head.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Local checks and controlled E2E |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 24.14.1; Bun 1.3.13 with strict OpenTUI selection. Provider responses are controlled fixtures, with isolated homes, runtimes and dummy loopback credentials. The initial implementation report also includes a fresh Chrome session for the actual daemon-served Web UI; that browser run is prior-artifact evidence.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: this crosses the two model loops and their input producers, so source eligibility, continuation lifetime and UI draft restoration require coordinated review.
- Not validated / out of scope: a full VS Code Extension Host/UI run, a real paid-provider smoke, local Windows/Linux, persistent ultracode mode, effort/model changes and workflow permission changes. IDE producers/transports have service tests; direct ACP, daemon/private-child consumption and Web have separate runtime evidence.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the SDK declaration is optional and grants no permissions. Existing unknown input remains ordinary chat. This does not guarantee that a model chooses Workflow.

## Linked Issues

DW-03 follow-up to #14646 and #14740. Related merged baseline work: #14565.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

为终端、IDE、Web 和明确声明来源的 TypeScript SDK 人类提交增加单回合 Workflow 建议，支持 `ultracode` 和已有的 `workflow` 关键词。提醒通过 prompt admission 后才进入模型请求；用户显示文本保持原文，展开上下文、自动化和历史消息不会自动激活。工具续轮不会再次添加提醒。

SDK 流式消息可以逐条使用 `origin: { kind: 'human' }` 声明。缺失或错误声明、字符串便捷输入、`-p` 和普通 stdin 保持正常聊天，不激活关键词。ACP 复用已有公共原始提交声明及 daemon owner 检查。既有关闭设置对运行中的会话生效；提示措辞遵守 Workflow 可达性、工具发现桥接和仅命名工作流限制。

保留队列和取消草稿的投影，包括可编辑的大粘贴正文及占位符冲突处理。OpenTUI 已完成提交保留独立的可编辑召回正文，transcript 继续显示原始展示文本；召回文本仍按 unknown 输入处理。当前有效人类意图会绕过未带该意图生成的已完成推测结果，普通提交仍可接受缓存。Ink 指示器和 telemetry 跟随实际提醒注入。

## 为什么需要

目前 Workflow 关键词引导属于 Ink 的提交路径，其他人类入口无法获得同样行为。移动提醒时若不保留独立的用户显示与模型投影，还可能丢失用户字面文本或展开的粘贴正文。本次为两个模型循环提供同一项窄范围策略，同时将来源声明与 Hook provenance、工具权限分开。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

- 启用工作流，在两个终端 renderer 和支持的 IDE/Web 输入框分别提交两个关键词。符合条件的新回合应恰有一个模型侧提醒，下一普通回合没有新提醒。两词同现仍只有一个。
- 在同一公共 SDK 会话发送 unknown、declared-human、unknown，中间回合安排两次工具续轮。只有 human 回合新增提醒，续轮不增加副本。无人值守的 text/json/stream-json 和 stdin 仍无资格。
- 原文无关键词而附件或 Hook 上下文有词时，不应激活。提交 Hook 阻断时 provider 请求总数必须为零。伪造 daemon 私有 metadata 不应激活。
- 在 Ink 和严格 Bun/OpenTUI 中检查用户行与召回中的字面 leading tags。大粘贴入队后恢复并编辑，再增加同长度粘贴；两份正文和追加指令应完整进入模型。Ink 还需取消实际包含粘贴的当前回合，再编辑恢复草稿。
- 完成一次 OpenTUI 大粘贴回合，按 Up 召回、编辑并重提；当前 provider 请求必须保留完整正文和编辑，不含占位符，召回输入仍为 unknown。
- 在 Ink Vim 模式下，新 insert-mode 键入仍可触发；召回历史，用 `dd` 删入寄存器后 `p` 并提交，再次 `p` 提交，两次寄存器来源回合均不应新增提醒。清空后重新键入应恢复资格。
- 启用 speculation 后提交匹配的已完成建议，其中包含有效关键词；应携带人类意图进入正常回合，普通输入仍接受缓存结果。
- 通过普通设置保存，在运行中的会话和不同 daemon workspace 中切换既有关闭设置，包括回合忙碌时保存；无需显式 reload，下一符合条件的回合应读取其 owner 当前设置。隐藏 Workflow 需要两个桥接工具均存在；仅命名工作流的提示应使用 `{ name, args }`，不建议编写脚本。

### 证据（变更前后）

已安装的 0.25.2 release baseline 会添加 Ink 已有的 `workflow` 提醒，但忽略 `ultracode` 和 SDK human-origin 声明。上述对照使用已安装 release；本 PR 的变更范围为 DW-03 diff，分支包含 upstream main 至 `a4937a3533be05271870b99614a8ef94ed733b3d`。

受控真实进程验证在 provider 请求中捕获提醒，同时保留用户提交文本。公共 SDK 的 unknown → human（两次工具续轮）→ unknown 当前回合提醒计数为 `[0, 1, 1, 1, 0]`。最新修复 head 为 `22bf052c0cc57ff063c9a95a95d5fbc65affb814`，集成测试 22 项通过，OpenTUI 的 Vim 用例明确跳过 1 项。运行验证使用 `b3d5bdede30fdbb06dcf492014e29f8a136771c2` 的冻结产物；最后一提交只修改测试 mock，全部产品源码和 1,456 个运行产物文件均未变化。独立验证覆盖 Vim 寄存器来源和有界大输入性能。较早报告保留原产物身份和浏览器观察；本次修复 head 未重跑浏览器 UI。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 本地检查和受控 E2E |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地验证 |

### 环境

Node 24.14.1；Bun 1.3.13 严格选择 OpenTUI。Provider 响应由 fixture 控制，使用隔离 home、runtime 和 dummy loopback 凭据。初始实施报告还包含独立 Chrome 连接实际 daemon Web UI 的验证，该浏览器运行属于先前产物证据。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险与取舍：变更跨两个模型循环及输入 producer，需要联合核对来源资格、续轮生命周期和 UI 草稿恢复。
- 未验证与范围外：完整 VS Code Extension Host/UI、真实付费 provider smoke、本地 Windows/Linux、持久 ultracode 模式、effort/model 和工作流权限变更。IDE producer/transport 有服务测试，Direct ACP、daemon/private child 消费和 Web 各有运行证据。
- 兼容说明：SDK 声明可选且不授予权限；既有 unknown 输入继续正常聊天。这不保证模型一定选择 Workflow。

#14646 和 #14740 之后的 DW-03。相关的已合入基线工作还包括 #14565。

prs.title: test(managed-agent): reuse the run on a same-key retry (FG11d)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Pins the retry-reuse claim from the FG11d cancellation matrix: a second `POST /v1/agent-automations/{id}/runs` under the same idempotency key answers the run it already created. No second occurrence is recorded, and no second Turn reaches the model, so a client retrying after a lost answer cannot double the work.

The cell also corrects the scheduler record: the Slice 2 bullet that bundled retry reuse with "a parked cancel is never redelivered" now marks the reuse half delivered and leaves the redelivery half open, in both languages.

## Why it's needed

The record asserted retry reuse but nothing exercised it. The property is what makes the public `202` safe to retry: if a retry produced a fresh run, an automation could fire twice for one occurrence — the double-fire shape FG11a and FG11b pin from the other direction.

The first version of the cell red for the wrong reason: it read the occurrence and the model prompt immediately after the second `POST`, before the fire had committed, and saw zero rows. It now waits for the occurrence and for the Turn before judging what the retry did not add, which is also what makes the assertions meaningful rather than vacuous.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the cell against real MySQL 8 and confirm it passes; then check that both `POST`s answered the same run id, that `ma_schedule_occurrence` holds exactly one row for the schedule, and that the model stub received the definition's prompt once.

Removing the idempotency key from the second request makes the case red: a second run and a second Turn appear.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the record listed retry reuse as an assertion with no gate behind it.

After: `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0 -- in HostedAutomationFaultGatesIT` (5.313 s) on JDK 21 + MySQL 8.0.46; `scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` passes 72/72 with the new cell booked at 11 s (2× its measured 5.3 s), moving the fork to 10482 s while Verify stays at 185 minutes.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A  |

JDK 21 (`Zulu 21.0.11`) and MySQL 8.0.46 on `127.0.0.1:3401`, selected with `-Phosted-automation-gates`.

### Environment (optional)

N/A.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the cell pins id reuse by run id. If the product later changes the idempotency contract (for example, keying retries by occurrence instead of by request key), this case changes with it — which is the intent.
- Not validated / out of scope: "a parked cancel is never redelivered" stays open, as does the rest of the matrix (future slots, siblings, a queued input cancelled before any attempt).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — one test, two design records and the CI budget ledger.

Design records: [English](docs/design/2026-10-19-automation-lifecycle-fault-gates.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-19-automation-lifecycle-fault-gates.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Part of the FG11 tracker in #14446.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

钉住 FG11d 取消矩阵里的「重试复用」主张：以同一幂等 key 再次 `POST /v1/agent-automations/{id}/runs`，返回的是它已经创建的 run。不产生第二个 occurrence，也没有第二个 Turn 到达模型，因此客户端在丢失应答后重试不会把工作做两遍。

用例同时修正调度记录：Slice 2 里把「重试复用」与「被扣住的 cancel 绝不重投」写在一起的那一条，现在把复用半边标为已交付，重投半边仍留未覆盖，中英两版同步。

## 为什么需要

记录里断言了重试复用，但没有任何门禁执行它。这条性质正是公开 `202` 可以安全重试的前提：若重试会造出新的 run，一次 occurrence 就可能触发两次——那正是 FG11a 与 FG11b 从另一侧钉住的重复触发形态。

用例的第一版红得不是地方：它在第二次 `POST` 之后立刻读 occurrence 与模型 prompt，而 fire 尚未落库，于是读到 0 行。现在先等 occurrence 落库、等 Turn 起来，再判断重试没有新增什么——这也让断言不至于变成空断言。

## 评审验证

在真实 MySQL 8 上单跑该用例确认通过；再确认两次 `POST` 返回同一 run id、`ma_schedule_occurrence` 对该 schedule 只有一行、模型桩只收到一次该定义的 prompt。

把第二次请求的幂等 key 去掉，用例会变红：会出现第二个 run 与第二个 Turn。

## 证据

改动前：记录把重试复用列为断言，但背后没有门禁。

改动后：`Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0 -- in HostedAutomationFaultGatesIT`（5.313 s），JDK 21 + MySQL 8.0.46；`scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` 72/72，新格按 2× 实测 5.3 s 记 11 s，fork 抬到 10482 s，Verify 仍 185 分钟。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：这一格以 run id 钉住 id 复用。若产品后续改变幂等契约（例如改为按 occurrence 而非请求 key），用例必须随之修改——这正是它的意义。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：「被扣住的 cancel 绝不重投」仍未覆盖，矩阵其余部分（未来 slot、兄弟、在任何尝试之前被取消的排队 input）同理。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无——一个测试、两份设计记录与 CI 预算台账。

</details>
