prs.title: feat(web-shell): add unified recent sessions sidebar
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a collapsible **Recent sessions** section after Project and before Archived. It combines ordinary project and no-workspace conversations by recent activity, shows five previews with Show all up to twenty, and keeps pinned and archived conversations out. Existing project lists remain available.

Rows share the existing session layout and hover details, with inline pin/archive actions. A hover-revealed new-task button follows the top sidebar entry's behavior and selects the resulting conversation in Recent. Opening a conversation preserves its context and highlights only the clicked list copy. The change also prevents transient row disappearance and placeholder titles during standalone session restoration.

## Why it's needed

Resuming a conversation should not require remembering its project or expanding several groups. Recent provides one place to continue work across projects and no-workspace chats while retaining project-based organization.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. With conversations in several trusted projects and without a workspace, collapse Project. Recent should still show the newest ordinary conversations. Expand Show all, collapse Recent and reload to confirm it stays collapsed, then expand it and reload to confirm it stays expanded.
2. Alternate between Recent, project and no-workspace entries, including both copies of the same conversation. Confirm the original context, a matching header title, only the clicked copy highlighted, and no disappearing rows during restoration.
3. Hover a Recent row. Confirm the shared details card and pin/archive controls. Pin a project conversation: it should leave Recent immediately. Unpin it: it should return according to recent activity. Archived entries should stay out; current/running conversations must not be archivable.
4. Create conversations from the top, project, no-workspace and Recent new-task entries. Recent's action should inherit the same context as the top entry and highlight its new conversation in Recent after creation.
5. Check an unavailable source and retry: successful sources should remain usable.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: recent conversations were reached through their individual project or No-workspace sessions list; there was no unified Recent section.

After: the following screenshots were captured from the local running Web Shell, rather than mockups.

Recent with Project collapsed and its new-task action visible:

![Recent sessions and new-task action](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deggs7/qwen-code/codex/sidebar-recent-sessions/docs/design/images/sidebar-recent-sessions.png)

Expanded Recent with the selected conversation, matching header title, and another row's hover details and actions:

![Recent selection and session details](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deggs7/qwen-code/codex/sidebar-recent-sessions/docs/design/images/sidebar-recent-sessions-details.png)

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | ✅ Local Chrome and automated checks |
| Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| Linux | ⚠️ Not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Browser evidence: existing local daemon and Vite Web Shell, Chrome on macOS. Latest validation after merging main: the full Web Shell run covered 466 files / 12,662 tests (12,652 passed; ten localhost-listen tests were denied by the sandbox). Re-running the two affected HTTP files outside the sandbox passed all 28 tests, including those ten. All 142 cases in the previously failing sidebar file pass. Repository build/typecheck, repository ESLint, tracked-file formatting and whitespace checks passed. The collapse-persistence test also detects a deliberately disabled preference write. The full repository test suite was not rerun in this follow-up; earlier preflight notes remain in the original verification comment.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: aggregation reads the visible trusted workspaces on the focused daemon; it polls while expanded and pauses during session transitions. Partial source failures offer retry.
- Not validated / out of scope: other remote daemons, Windows/Linux runtime behavior, and standalone pinning. The latter has a disabled button with an explanation. Live, channel and child sessions are excluded. Recent is bounded to twenty conversations, and background activity can take one polling interval to appear.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no backend/SDK changes or migration. Existing project actions remain available.

prs.title: fix(ci): serve the fast tier before full-tier host-lock holds (#14962)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The self-hosted SDK Java lanes now acquire their per-host Maven lock through a ticketed queue instead of a bare `flock --wait`. The queue has two classes: the fast tier (`TIER=fast`, every pull request and main push) is served before `normal` approval, main, and MariaDB work, so a PR job waits at most the hold already running rather than a queue of full-tier holds. A normal ticket that waits past `SDK_JAVA_LOCK_PROMOTE_AFTER` (1200 s) is promoted into the fast class, so a continuous PR stream cannot starve the full tier. The lock still releases at the step boundary, the pinned `lock not acquired within` error signature is preserved, and the 5400 s budget and job ceilings are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Run 39431579628's `SDK Java (fast) / ubuntu-latest / Java 21` job waited exactly 5400 seconds in `Run Java SDK tests (self-hosted)` and failed with `sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes` before Maven started. `flock(2)` does not order wakeups, so the fast lane can lose every release to full-tier holds; raising the budget 2400 → 3600 → 5400 only moved the cliff. The fix has to stay inside the ECS pool (the hosted-runner direction in #14935 was withdrawn), and the pool-preserving queue direction is #14912; this change adds the fast class that #14962 shows is still needed so PR feedback is not queued behind approval and main work.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Inspect the two self-hosted lock sites in the SDK Java workflow: both source `.github/scripts/sdk-java-lock.sh`; the test job calls `sdk_java_lock_acquire 5400 "${TIER}"`, and the MariaDB lane calls `sdk_java_lock_acquire 5400` (normal).
2. Run `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`; expect 329 passed and 1 skipped.
3. On the first pool runs after merge, look for `Waiting for the sdk-java host lock as queue ticket N (fast)`; a fast-tier job should be the head instead of sitting behind full-tier holds. A normal ticket logs `Promoted ... to the fast class after 20 minutes` if it waits past the aging boundary.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: job 118658168882's `Run Java SDK tests (self-hosted)` ran 13:47:19Z → 15:17:19Z, exactly 5400 s, and failed with `sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes`; no test ran. After (unit and smoke): a fast ticket is ordered ahead of an older normal ticket, a normal ticket is promoted after the aging interval, a dead owner's ticket is reaped, and the timeout still emits the pinned signature and removes its ticket. The real-`flock` smoke test showed the fast waiter acquiring first and the normal waiter waiting as ticket 2.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux, Node 22, bash with `flock` stubbed on `PATH` for the unit tests; one smoke run used the real `flock` in a temporary `HOME`. The lock suite skips on Windows.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: during rollout the fleet is mixed — legacy inline `flock --wait` waiters from older branches still race the queue head, so strict ordering holds among runs that use the helper. The fast class can delay normal work by at most the 1200 s aging interval before promotion.
- Not validated / out of scope: a real-pool soak (the PR's own fast tier is the first live check); sharding the lock per suite or adding hosts.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The lock error substring, the 5400 s budget, the 150/200-minute ceilings, and the fd-9 step-boundary release are unchanged.

Design docs: [English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-host-lock-priority.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-host-lock-priority.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14962
Refs #14743
Refs #14566
Refs #14912

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

self-hosted 的 SDK Java lane 现在通过票据队列获取每台宿主机的 Maven 锁，而不是裸 `flock --wait`。队列有两个类别：fast tier（`TIER=fast`，每个 pull request 和 main push）先于 `normal` 的 approval、main 和 MariaDB 工作被服务，因此 PR job 最多只等当前正在运行的那一次持锁，而不是排在一串 full-tier 持锁任务后面。等待超过 `SDK_JAVA_LOCK_PROMOTE_AFTER`（1200 秒）的 normal 票据会被提升进 fast 类别，因此持续的 PR 流量无法饿死 full tier。锁仍然在 step 边界释放，固定的 `lock not acquired within` 错误签名保留，5400 秒预算和 job 上限不变。

## 为什么需要

Run 39431579628 的 `SDK Java (fast) / ubuntu-latest / Java 21` job 在 `Run Java SDK tests (self-hosted)` 里正好等了 5400 秒，Maven 启动前就以 `sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes` 失败。`flock(2)` 不保证唤醒顺序，fast lane 可能每次都输给 full-tier 持锁任务；把预算从 2400 提到 3600 再到 5400 只是把悬崖往后挪。修复必须留在 ECS 池内（#14935 的托管 runner 方向已撤回），保留池子的队列方向是 #14912；本改动补上了 #14962 所证明仍然需要的 fast 类别，让 PR 反馈不再排在 approval 和 main 工作后面。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 检查 SDK Java workflow 的两个 self-hosted 取锁点：两者都 source `.github/scripts/sdk-java-lock.sh`；test job 调用 `sdk_java_lock_acquire 5400 "${TIER}"`，MariaDB lane 调用 `sdk_java_lock_acquire 5400`（normal）。
2. 运行 `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`；预期 329 通过、1 跳过。
3. 合并后的第一批池上运行中，查找 `Waiting for the sdk-java host lock as queue ticket N (fast)`；fast-tier job 应该处于队首，而不是排在 full-tier 持锁任务后面。normal 票据如果等待超过 aging 边界，会打印 `Promoted ... to the fast class after 20 minutes`。

### 证据（Before & After）

Before：job 118658168882 的 `Run Java SDK tests (self-hosted)` 从 13:47:19Z 运行到 15:17:19Z，正好 5400 秒，以 `sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes` 失败；没有测试运行。After（单元与冒烟）：fast 票据排在更老的 normal 票据之前，normal 票据在 aging 间隔后被提升，死亡 owner 的票据被回收，超时仍然打印固定签名并删除自己的票据。真实 `flock` 冒烟测试显示 fast 等待者先获得锁，normal 等待者以 ticket 2 等待。

### 测试环境

|    系统    | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

Linux、Node 22，单元测试中 `flock` 通过 `PATH` stub 注入；一次冒烟测试在临时 `HOME` 下使用真实 `flock`。锁测试在 Windows 上跳过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：滚动期间舰队是混合的 —— 来自旧分支的内联 `flock --wait` 等待者仍会和队列队首竞争，因此严格顺序只在使用辅助脚本的运行之间成立。fast 类别最多让 normal 工作多等 1200 秒的 aging 间隔，之后会被提升。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：真实池上 soak（本 PR 自己的 fast tier 是第一次实机检查）；按 suite 拆分锁或增加主机。
- 破坏性改动 / 迁移说明：无。锁错误子串、5400 秒预算、150/200 分钟上限，以及 fd 9 的 step 边界释放都未改变。

prs.title: feat(web-shell): open trajectory record details as a drill-in or side panel
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Second of five PRs that redesign the Web Shell trajectory panel (design document below). It replaces the tabbed inspector at the bottom of the panel with a single details view, and changes how it opens.

- **One page instead of tabs.** Details read top to bottom: the measured facts in a two-column grid, then the content, then collapsed Identifiers and Lifecycle sections. A request shows duration, first token with a two-tone bar (waiting, then generating), tokens in / cached / out, start and model. A tool shows duration, start → end to the millisecond, and its wire name. Timing that was not recorded shows "—" with a "Not recorded" tooltip instead of the word "unrecorded" in every field; identifiers that were not recorded are left out.
- **Tool content looks like Tool Calls.** Input and output reuse the Tool Calls renderers, now shared through one module: a shell call reads as its command and output, an edit or write as its diff, JSON as a highlighted code block. Values are otherwise shown as recorded, so whitespace and an explicit `null` or empty result survive. Each section has its own copy button. The 4,000-character preview and Show more (up to 40,000) are kept.
- **Drill-in when docked.** A click on a row (or Enter) opens its details over the toolbar and list, while the summary bar and time strip stay visible. The list stays mounted underneath and is made `inert`, so Back or Escape returns to the same scroll offset, the same selection and focus on the grid.
- **Side panel when wide.** From a 960 px panel (fullscreen), details sit to the right of the list in a resizable split: 40% to start, 320 px to 60%, by pointer or keyboard. They follow the selection as the arrow keys move it.
- The header steps to the previous or next record with ↑ / ↓, and shows a status pill for failed, cancelled or running records.
- A turn header now opens the turn: step and tool counts, main model time and the prompt. Live executions open in the same view, with "Locate historical record".
- The per-row "View details" button from PR-R1 is gone; the row itself is the target.

## Why it's needed

The inspector took 38% of a docked panel, at most 320 px, and split one record over five tabs. A tool's input and output could not be seen together, and most of the space went to labelled cards saying "unrecorded". In the docked panel it left room for only 8 rows above it. The drill-in gives the content the full height of the list (more than 20 lines at 1440×900) without losing the reader's place. Fullscreen has room for both, so the split keeps the list visible.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open the trajectory panel docked on a session with a failed tool. Click the failed row. Details cover the toolbar and list, with the summary bar and strip still visible. Input and output show together, with a Failed pill in the header.
2. Press ↓ in the details header to step to the next record, then press Escape. The list is back at the same scroll offset with the stepped-to row selected, and the arrow keys work straight away.
3. Click a turn header: its counts and prompt open.
4. Switch the right panel to fullscreen. The details move beside the list. Drag the divider, or focus it and use the arrow keys, to resize it. Selecting other rows updates the details, and × closes them.
5. Copy a section and paste it: you get exactly what is shown.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Docked panel at a 1440×900 viewport, same mock-daemon session, before = upstream `main` with PR-R1:

| Before | After (drill-in) |
| --- | --- |
| ![before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/660c2538b00111d51e23b78c84c22be9f221bdf3/after-details-light-en.png) | ![after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/c6a2f597179ec09957ce2865bcaf82a5c202748b/drill-in-light-en.png) |
| ![before zh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/660c2538b00111d51e23b78c84c22be9f221bdf3/after-details-dark-zh-CN.png) | ![after zh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/c6a2f597179ec09957ce2865bcaf82a5c202748b/drill-in-dark-zh-CN.png) |

Fullscreen, side panel:

![side light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/c6a2f597179ec09957ce2865bcaf82a5c202748b/side-light-en.png)

<details>
<summary>Fullscreen, Chinese UI in the dark theme</summary>

![side dark zh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/c6a2f597179ec09957ce2865bcaf82a5c202748b/side-dark-zh-CN.png)

</details>

Local checks: web-shell typecheck, ESLint and Prettier; all 465 web-shell unit test files (12,644 tests), including the new `TrajectoryDetail` tests and updated panel tests for drill-in, inert records, focus return, side mode and stepping; all 47 Chromium tests in `web-shell.trajectory.spec.ts`, including two new ones: drill-in and back (scroll offset within one row, selection and focus kept, at least 20 lines of room), and side-panel resizing with the pointer and keyboard (start 40%, limits 320 px and 60%); `pnpm run build` for the web-shell package, including the transcript bundle.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux, Node.js 24, Chromium via Playwright against the Vite dev server with the mock daemon.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: in the docked panel the details now cover the list, so changing the search, filters or window while reading details takes a Back first. In fullscreen both stay usable together. `inert` is set as an attribute through a ref, because Web Shell still supports React 18, which does not know the prop. The panel switches presentation from its own width (a ResizeObserver at 960 px, the same tier as the container queries), so resizing across 960 px moves open details between drill-in and side panel.
- Not validated / out of scope: step content (response, thinking, tool calls), turn wall time and tokens, and file and agent links need the row model of PR-R3 and moved there; the design document now says so in both languages. No daemon, SDK, wire or settings changes. Not tested against a real daemon, and not on macOS or Windows.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for users. The test id `trajectory-inspector` is now `trajectory-detail`, with `data-presentation="drill-in" | "side"` and `data-section` on each section. The details tabs and the row's "View details" button are gone. Unused `trajectory.inspector.*` strings were removed.

Design document: [English](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-trajectory-details/docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-trajectory-redesign.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-trajectory-details/docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-trajectory-redesign.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Part of #12293. Follows #14913.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

这是 Web Shell 轨迹面板重设计五个 PR 中的第二个（设计文档见下）。它把面板底部按标签页划分的检查器换成一个统一的详情视图，并改变了详情的打开方式。

- **一页代替多个标签页。** 详情自上而下排列：两列网格中的实测事实，然后是内容，最后是默认折叠的“标识符”和“生命周期”两节。请求显示耗时、首 token（带双色条：等待，然后生成）、输入 / 缓存 / 输出 token、起点和模型。工具显示耗时、精确到毫秒的起止时间以及工具原名。未记录的时间显示为“—”，悬停提示“未记录”，不再在每个字段里写“未记录”；未记录的标识符直接省略。
- **工具内容与“工具调用”面板一致。** 输入和输出复用“工具调用”面板的渲染器，现在通过一个共享模块提供：Shell 调用显示为命令和输出，编辑和写文件显示为 diff，JSON 显示为高亮代码块。其他值按记录原样显示，因此空白字符以及显式的 `null` 或空结果都会保留。每一节都有自己的复制按钮。保留 4,000 字符预览和“展开更多”（最多 40,000 字符）。
- **停靠时下钻。** 单击某一行（或按 Enter）会在工具栏和列表之上打开它的详情，摘要栏和时间条仍然可见。列表在下面保持挂载并设为 `inert`，因此按“返回”或 Escape 后，滚动位置、选中项不变，焦点回到列表。
- **宽屏时侧栏。** 面板宽度达到 960 px（全屏）时，详情位于列表右侧的可调分栏中：初始 40%，可在 320 px 到 60% 之间用指针或键盘调整。用方向键移动选中项时，详情随之更新。
- 标题栏用 ↑ / ↓ 切换到上一条或下一条记录，并为失败、已取消或运行中的记录显示状态胶囊。
- 轮次标题现在可以打开该轮：步骤数、工具数、主模型耗时和提示词。实时执行也在同一视图中打开，并提供“定位历史记录”。
- 去掉了 PR-R1 中每行的“查看详情”按钮，行本身就是点击目标。

## 为什么需要

原检查器占停靠面板的 38%，最多 320 px，并把一条记录拆到五个标签页里。工具的输入和输出无法同时查看，大部分空间被写着“未记录”的带标签卡片占据。在停靠面板中，它上方只能放下 8 行。下钻让内容使用整个列表的高度（1440×900 下超过 20 行），同时不丢失阅读位置。全屏时空间足够，分栏让列表保持可见。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 验证方法

1. 在一个有失败工具的会话上以停靠方式打开轨迹面板，点击失败的那一行。详情覆盖工具栏和列表，摘要栏和时间条仍然可见。输入和输出同时显示，标题栏有“失败”胶囊。
2. 在详情标题栏按 ↓ 切换到下一条记录，然后按 Escape。列表回到原来的滚动位置，切换到的那一行处于选中状态，方向键可以立即使用。
3. 点击轮次标题：打开该轮的统计和提示词。
4. 把右侧面板切换为全屏，详情移到列表旁边。拖动分隔条，或聚焦分隔条后用方向键，调整宽度。选择其他行时详情随之更新，× 关闭详情。
5. 复制某一节再粘贴：得到的正是显示的内容。

### 证据（前后对比）

1440×900 视口下的停靠面板，同一个模拟 daemon 会话，改动前 = 包含 PR-R1 的上游 `main`：见上方英文部分的截图表格（浅色英文与深色中文的改动前 / 下钻对比，以及全屏侧栏截图）。

本地检查：web-shell 类型检查、ESLint 和 Prettier；web-shell 全部 465 个单元测试文件（12,644 个测试），包括新的 `TrajectoryDetail` 测试，以及更新后覆盖下钻、列表 inert、焦点返回、侧栏模式和切换记录的面板测试；`web-shell.trajectory.spec.ts` 中全部 47 个 Chromium 测试，其中新增两个：下钻后返回（滚动偏移误差不超过一行、保留选中项和焦点、至少有 20 行内容的空间），以及用指针和键盘调整侧栏宽度（初始 40%，上下限 320 px 和 60%）；web-shell 包的 `pnpm run build`，包括 transcript 包。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

Linux，Node.js 24，通过 Playwright 驱动 Chromium，连接带模拟 daemon 的 Vite 开发服务器。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：停靠面板中详情会覆盖列表，所以在阅读详情时要修改搜索、筛选或窗口，需要先按“返回”。全屏时两者可以同时使用。`inert` 通过 ref 以属性方式设置，因为 Web Shell 仍支持不认识该 prop 的 React 18。面板根据自身宽度切换呈现方式（960 px 的 ResizeObserver，与容器查询使用同一档位），因此宽度跨过 960 px 时，打开的详情会在下钻和侧栏之间切换。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：步骤内容（回复、思考、工具调用）、轮次实际历时和 token，以及文件和代理链接都依赖 PR-R3 的行模型，已移到 PR-R3；设计文档的中英文版本都已注明。没有 daemon、SDK、协议或设置的改动。未在真实 daemon 上测试，也未在 macOS 或 Windows 上测试。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：对用户没有。测试 ID `trajectory-inspector` 改为 `trajectory-detail`，带有 `data-presentation="drill-in" | "side"`，每一节带有 `data-section`。详情标签页和行上的“查看详情”按钮已移除。删除了不再使用的 `trajectory.inspector.*` 文案。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-trajectory-details/docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-trajectory-redesign.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-trajectory-details/docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-trajectory-redesign.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

属于 #12293。接续 #14913。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ui): bottom-align short VP content so blank space is at top
prs.body:
## What this PR does

In VP mode (`useTerminalBuffer`, default on), when the conversation fits within the viewport the content was top-aligned, leaving a blank gap between the last message and the composer (reported in #9300, happens in every session). This bottom-aligns short bottom-stuck content: blank space moves to the TOP and the latest message sits directly above the composer, matching standard chat TUIs.

Implementation: in `VirtualizedList`, when `isStickingToBottom` and content fits (`maxScroll === 0`), compute `bottomAlignGap = scrollableContainerHeight - totalHeight`, render it as a leading spacer, and keep the root at full `containerHeight` so there is room. Overflow (`maxScroll > 0`) and scrolled-away cases are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

#9300: default-on VP mode showed a large blank area between the last message and the composer in every session (short conversations and collapsed thinking blocks). High-frequency, default-on visual regression on the primary surface — worth a quick fix.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/components/shared/VirtualizedList.test.tsx` — 32 tests pass, including the 3 updated to the new bottom-aligned layout.
2. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/components/MainContent.test.tsx packages/cli/src/ui/components/shared/ScrollableList.test.tsx` — 36 pass (no layout regression).
3. Manual (iTerm2, VP mode): start a short session — content should sit at the bottom above the composer with blank at top; collapse a thinking block (Ctrl+O) — released space appears at top, not between content and composer.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: content top-aligned, blank gap between last message and composer. After: content bottom-aligned, blank at top. (Needs a live terminal to visually confirm; unit tests pin the new frame layout.)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️ needs manual confirm (reported on iTerm2) |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ (unit tests) |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: changes the short-content layout from top-aligned/collapsed to bottom-aligned; three tests that pinned the old collapse behavior were updated to the new expectation. Scrolling/overflow math is untouched (`scrollableContainerHeight` unchanged).
- Not validated / out of scope: live iTerm2 visual confirmation (reporter's environment); height-overestimation cases where `totalHeight >= containerHeight` (those already bottom-show via `clampedScrollTop = maxScroll`).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #9300

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

VP 模式（默认开启）下，当会话内容高度小于视口时，内容顶部对齐，导致最后一条消息与输入框之间出现大片空白（#9300，每个 session 都出现）。本 PR 将短的、贴底的内容改为底部对齐：空白移到顶部，最新消息紧贴输入框上方，与主流 chat TUI 一致。

实现：`VirtualizedList` 中当 `isStickingToBottom` 且内容放得下（`maxScroll === 0`）时，计算 `bottomAlignGap = scrollableContainerHeight - totalHeight` 作为顶部占位，并保持 root 为满 `containerHeight`。溢出或已上滚的场景不变。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：短内容布局从顶部对齐/折叠改为底部对齐，3 个固定旧行为的测试已更新；滚动数学未动。
- 未验证：iTerm2 真机视觉确认；`totalHeight >= containerHeight` 的高度高估场景（该场景本就通过 `clampedScrollTop = maxScroll` 底部显示）。
- 破坏性变更：无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): widen the agent workspace lock retry budget (#14028)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Raises the cross-process workspace lock's acquisition retry budget from 10 retries (5–100ms randomized exponential backoff, ~0.65–1.3s worst case) to 30 retries (~5s worst case), matching the budget the Agent Board lock already uses for the same two-tier locking pattern. Everything else about the lock is unchanged: the in-process mutex still serializes same-process writers, and stale-lock breaking (`stale: 10_000`) still recovers a dead holder's lock after 10 seconds.

## Why it's needed

`main` CI failed on `agent workspace lock > loses no roster update when two processes write at once` (#14028). The test spawns two child processes that each perform 8 read-modify-write roster updates under the store's file lock. On an oversubscribed CI host, one holder's critical section — an fsync-bound atomic JSON write — can outlast the ~1s retry budget, so the competing process exhausted its retries, exited with `ELOCKED: Lock file is already being held`, and failed the test. CI's `--retry=2` does not help because every attempt on a badly placed host hits the same contention. I reproduced this locally: pinned to 2 CPUs with CPU and fsync competitors, the pre-fix code failed 6 of 30 rounds with ELOCKED; with this change, 30 of 30 rounds passed. A longer wait is strictly safer here: the lock guards a low-frequency roster/registry store, so waiting a few seconds for a slow live holder is always preferable to erroring.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm the change is confined to the workspace store's lock options and that the concurrency test passes: run `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/agents/workspace-agents/workspace-lock.test.ts` and expect 1 passed test. To observe the original failure mode, revert the one-line change (`retries: 30` back to `10`) and run the same test on a heavily loaded machine (or pinned to few CPUs with competing load): the worker processes intermittently exit 1 with `ELOCKED: Lock file is already being held`. With the fix, the waiters simply wait out the slow holder instead of erroring.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no user-visible behavior change; the observable difference is CI stability under host contention: before, 6/30 contended probe rounds failed with ELOCKED; after, 0/30 failed).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests under `packages/core` (vitest), plus a local contention harness pinning the test scenario to 2 CPUs with busy CPU/fsync competitors.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a waiter now holds on for up to ~5s (was ~1s) before failing lock acquisition when a live holder is slow; a dead holder's lock is still broken after 10s via the unchanged stale detection, so crash recovery latency is unaffected.
- Not validated / out-of-scope: macOS and Windows lanes (left to CI; the change is a platform-independent timing budget). A deeper hardening — aborting a transaction whose lock is compromised mid-flight instead of only warning — is deliberately out of scope for this flake fix.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14028

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

将跨进程 workspace 锁的获取重试预算从 10 次(5–100ms 随机指数退避,最坏约 0.65–1.3 秒)提高到 30 次(最坏约 5 秒),与 Agent Board 锁在相同双层锁模式下已有的预算一致。锁的其他行为完全不变:进程内互斥锁仍然串行化同进程写入者,过期锁打破机制(`stale: 10_000`)仍然会在 10 秒后回收已崩溃持锁者留下的锁。

## 为什么需要

`main` 分支 CI 在 `agent workspace lock > loses no roster update when two processes write at once` 上失败(#14028)。该测试派生两个子进程,各自在存储的文件锁下执行 8 次 roster 读-改-写更新。在超额订阅的 CI 主机上,持锁者的一次临界区——带 fsync 的原子 JSON 写入——可能超过约 1 秒的重试预算,导致竞争进程重试耗尽后以 `ELOCKED: Lock file is already being held` 退出,测试失败。CI 的 `--retry=2` 帮不上忙,因为在被调度到繁忙主机时,每次尝试都会遇到同样的争用。我已在本地复现:固定到 2 个 CPU 并加入 CPU 与 fsync 竞争负载时,修复前的代码在 30 轮中有 6 轮以 ELOCKED 失败;应用本改动后,30 轮全部通过。此处更长的等待严格更安全:该锁守护的是低频的 roster/注册表存储,为一个缓慢的活跃持锁者多等几秒永远优于直接报错。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

确认改动仅限于 workspace 存储的锁参数,且并发测试通过:运行 `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/agents/workspace-agents/workspace-lock.test.ts`,预期 1 个测试通过。若要观察原始失败模式,可将这一行改动回退(`retries: 30` 改回 `10`),并在负载较重的机器上(或绑定到少量 CPU 并施加竞争负载)运行同一测试:worker 进程会间歇性地以退出码 1 失败,报 `ELOCKED: Lock file is already being held`。应用修复后,等待者会等待缓慢的持锁者完成,而不是报错。

### 前后对照证据

N/A(无用户可见的行为变化;可观察的差异是主机争用下的 CI 稳定性:修复前,30 轮带载探测有 6 轮以 ELOCKED 失败;修复后,30 轮无一失败)。

### 已测试平台

|     系统    |  状态  |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境(可选)

`packages/core` 下的单元测试(vitest),以及一个将测试场景固定到 2 个 CPU 并施加 CPU/fsync 竞争负载的本地争用 harness。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍:当活跃持锁者较慢时,等待者现在最多坚持约 5 秒(原来约 1 秒)才会放弃锁获取;已崩溃持锁者的锁仍会通过未改动的过期检测在 10 秒后被打破,因此崩溃恢复延迟不受影响。
- 未验证 / 超出范围:macOS 与 Windows 通道(交由 CI 覆盖;本改动是平台无关的计时预算)。更深一层的加固——在锁中途被夺时中止事务而不是仅告警——刻意不纳入本次抖动修复的范围。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明:无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #14028

</details>

prs.title: feat(cli): paste clipboard text with Ctrl+V on Linux
prs.body:
## What this PR does

On Linux, `Ctrl+V` now reads the clipboard's **text** when the clipboard holds no image. Previously the only clipboard reader in the TUI was the image path, so pressing `Ctrl+V` with text or a link on the clipboard either printed "未找到受支持的剪贴板工具" (no supported clipboard tool found) or did nothing at all, and users had to fall back to their terminal's own paste binding.

Reads are driven by what the clipboard itself reports. `wl-paste --list-types` (Wayland) and the `TARGETS` atom (X11) are enumerated, and each reported name is classified from the standards rather than from a list of types this code has heard of: ICCCM's text atoms (`TEXT`, `STRING`, `UTF8_STRING`) plus `text/plain` are the preferred read, any other `text/*` the source lists is the fallback, and ICCCM's selection bookkeeping properties (`TARGETS`, `MULTIPLE`, `SAVE_TARGETS`, `DELETE`, `INCR`, `TIMESTAMP`, `VERSION`) are never requested. Each read asks for the exact name the tool reported, so `text/plain;charset=utf-8` is requested under that name rather than a guessed one.

A paste too large for the input buffer is still collapsed into a `[Pasted Content N chars]` placeholder, but on both collapse routes — `Ctrl+V` read through the clipboard tool, and a large bracketed paste from the terminal — its expanded form is now described to the model: attributed to the clipboard, given the standing of a file the user asked to open rather than a message from them, and closed from outside so a forged end marker inside the pasted data cannot promote what follows it. Shell mode is the exception, because there the expanded placeholder is the command that gets recorded and run. Selections are normalised to LF line endings, which a `text/uri-list` never has on its own. Anything the clipboard tool cannot answer — no display server, tool missing, spawn failure, timeout, empty or whitespace-only selection — resolves to "nothing to paste" instead of an error. macOS and Windows behavior is untouched.

## Why it's needed

Reported in our user group: on Ubuntu, pasting text into the input box was impossible via `Ctrl+V` — the client only tried to read an image, and when none was found it told the user to install `wl-clipboard`, which does not help with text at all. The same gesture already handles images and file paths, so text is the missing branch of an existing feature rather than a new surface.

## Review round 1

The first cut read the clipboard from inside the image branch with hardcoded per-tool type names, and its tests only proved that a stubbed spawn returned its stub. Addressed as follows:

- **Structure**: `Ctrl+V` is one dispatcher (`handleClipboardPaste`) that resolves an image into an attachment and everything else into text; the insert path is its own callback. This also fixed a real defect in the first cut, which read `buffer` and `nextLargePastePlaceholder` without declaring them as dependencies.
- **Type handling**: the per-tool candidate lists are gone. Enumeration and a single type table decide what is readable, and each read asks for the exact name the tool reported (so `text/plain;charset=utf-8` is requested under that name, not a guessed one).
- **Provenance**: a collapsed paste is submitted inside `<clipboard-paste>` markers with a trailing line stating it came from the clipboard and must be treated as untrusted data — on both collapse routes, since a large bracketed paste from the terminal is no more the user's own writing than a selection read back through `wl-paste`. Shell mode is the deliberate exception: there the expanded placeholder is the command that gets recorded to history and executed, so it stays raw, and the existing shell-history case pins that carve-out. The markers are provenance for the model, not a sandbox — content can contain a closing marker, which is why the note says "treat as data" rather than claiming containment.
- **Tests**: the clipboard is now simulated as a tool that lists its types and answers reads per type, and each case asserts both the result and the exact sequence of types requested. Coverage is one table: a charset-parameterised text offer, text preferred over a co-offered URI list, a CRLF URI list, X11 atoms mapped to text without `TARGETS` ever being read back as content, fallthrough to the next atom when the first is empty, an image-only clipboard requesting nothing, unknown types requesting nothing, and a whitespace-only selection. The simulator is withdrawn after each case because the file's `beforeEach` clears call history but not implementations.

## Review round 2

- **Was the hand-written type table sound?** No, and it is gone. It carried rows no standard defines — `UNICODE` (an XFT-era atom) and a bare `uri-list` — and it named `text/uri-list` explicitly when the enumeration already says what is offered. Classification now comes from the names the standards define: ICCCM's three text atoms plus `text/plain` are the preferred tier, any other `text/*` is the fallback tier, and ICCCM's bookkeeping properties are excluded by name. Nothing is requested that the clipboard did not list.
- **Verified against a real clipboard?** Not possible from this environment, and I am not going to imply otherwise: the authoring machine is macOS arm64 with no `wl-paste`, `xclip`, `xsel`, `xvfb-run` or container runtime available, and the reader is Linux-only by design, so no live Wayland/X11 enumeration can be produced here. What I could check locally is that no other part of this repository maintains a clipboard type list to borrow (it does not — `getWlPasteImageTypes`'s `image/png`/`image/bmp` pair was the only one, and it is kept as-is). A real `wl-paste --list-types` and `xclip -t TARGETS -o` dump from an Ubuntu session would be worth attaching to this PR; the tier rule is written so that any such dump is accepted without code changes.
- **Why `text/uri-list` at all?** It is no longer a case in the code — it falls out of the `text/*` fallback tier, which is the general rule rather than a named exception. The reason a fallback tier exists is that a source may list nothing but a non-plain `text/*` type, and without the tier `Ctrl+V` would silently do nothing there. The visible trade-off is that a selection offered only as `text/html` now pastes markup instead of nothing; that is stated in a test case rather than hidden.
- **The description was too thin.** Rewritten along injection-defence lines: it attributes the block to the clipboard and says the user may not have read it; it gives the content the standing of a file the user asked to open rather than a message from them; it keeps telling the model to act on pasted material that matches the user's actual request, because refusing pasted content would defeat the feature; it names the shapes it must not swallow (a system message, a permission or policy change, a confirmation the user gave); and it closes the block from outside, so a forged `</clipboard-paste>` inside the data cannot promote whatever follows it. One case pins those properties.

## Final diff

- `packages/cli/src/ui/utils/clipboardUtils.ts`: `readStdout()` (buffered stdout, timeout kill, empty string for anything that is not a successful read), `classifyClipboardType()` over the ICCCM text and bookkeeping sets, `listClipboardTypes()` on top of the Wayland/X11 enumeration, and `readClipboardText()` which requests only listed types — plain tier first — and normalises line endings. The wl-paste enumeration the image path already had is generalised into `listWlPasteTypes()` with one cache, and the image filter reads from that same list, so a single `Ctrl+V` costs one enumeration.
- `packages/cli/src/ui/components/InputPrompt.tsx`: `handleClipboardImage` becomes `handleClipboardPaste` — image resolves to an attachment, anything else to text — with the insert path split into `insertClipboardText`. `describeClipboardPaste()` frames a collapsed paste for the model and is applied on both collapse routes, skipped in shell mode.
- Tests: 9 table cases driving a clipboard that lists its types and answers reads per type, plus 4 component cases (text paste, collapsed paste described on submit, image wins over text, and the description's own properties).

## Evidence

<details>
<summary>Verification</summary>

Verified by unit tests rather than a live screenshot — this change needs a Wayland/X11 session, which the authoring environment does not have:

```
npx vitest run src/ui/utils/clipboardUtils.test.ts        → 70 passed
npx vitest run src/ui/components/InputPrompt.test.tsx     → 230 passed, 1 skipped
npx eslint <4 changed files>                              → clean
npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json (packages/cli)          → 172 errors, identical to
                                                             the same count on the
                                                             pre-change tree; none in
                                                             the changed files
```

</details>

## Contribution & Risk

- **Type**: Contribution Type 3 — optimization / user-facing feature
- **Scope**: Only `packages/cli/src/ui` (TUI input handling). No core, auth, provider, config, tools, or service modules; no daemon or channel code.
- **Linked Issues**: N/A — reported directly by users in the group chat; no GitHub issue filed.
- [x] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md), the code of conduct, and the PR instructions.
- [x] I have searched open PRs for a similar change and confirmed none exists.
- [ ] Not applicable — this PR does not change or add any UI component.

prs.title: feat: add hybrid code mode
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Codex-aligned `tools.mode` enum with `direct`, `code_mode`, and `code_mode_only`. `code_mode` keeps ordinary tools directly callable while also exposing the isolated `exec` JavaScript tool; each visible ordinary tool carries its nested JavaScript declaration, while `exec` retains compact `ALL_TOOLS` metadata. `code_mode_only` preserves the strict exec-only ordinary-tool surface, and `direct` remains the default.

Updates filtered subagent tool surfaces so direct declarations and nested exec bindings honor the same allowlists, exposes the enum in Settings as Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only, regenerates the settings JSON schema, and removes the former `tools.codeModeOnly` boolean setting entirely.

Adds synchronized [English](docs/design/code-mode.md) and [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md) design documents, and brings the existing CodeModeOnly design up to the repository's bilingual documentation standard ([English](docs/design/code-mode-only.md), [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)).

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code previously offered only the default direct tool surface or the strict CodeModeOnly surface. Models could not combine direct calls for simple operations with `exec` orchestration for multi-tool workflows. A three-value enum matches Codex's `ToolMode` naming and gives users one explicit setting for all supported exposure modes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Leave `tools.mode` unset or set it to `direct`, restart Qwen Code, and confirm ordinary tools remain available while `exec` is absent.
2. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode`, restart, and confirm both ordinary tools and `exec` are available. Confirm ordinary tool descriptions include their `tools.<name>(args)` declaration and deferred tools remain discoverable through `tool_search`.
3. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode_only`, restart, and confirm ordinary tools are available through `exec` rather than as top-level calls, while direct control tools remain available.
4. Open Settings and confirm Tool Mode cycles among Default, Code Mode, and Code Mode Only. Confirm `tools.codeModeOnly` is no longer present in the settings schema.
5. Start with `--safe-mode` or `--bare` while either code mode is configured and confirm the effective mode is `direct`.

Automated verification completed: focused Core tests (121 tests), focused CLI tests (585 tests), a repeated settings-schema regression run (60 tests), full build, full typecheck, full lint, and both installed and branch-built CLI version smoke checks.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: Settings exposed `Code Mode Only (Experimental)` as a boolean with `false` / `true`.

After: Settings exposes `Tool Mode (Experimental)` as an enum displaying Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only. Updated TUI snapshots cover the default display.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node.js v24.18.0; local source build and package-level Vitest suites.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Hybrid mode adds a short nested-call declaration to each ordinary tool description, increasing prompt size slightly; complete schemas are not duplicated in the `exec` description.
- Not validated / out of scope: Live-provider interactive runs and Windows/Linux local execution were not tested; CI covers supported platforms.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: `tools.codeModeOnly` is removed. Replace `{ "tools": { "codeModeOnly": true } }` with `{ "tools": { "mode": "code_mode_only" } }`.

## Linked Issues

Related to #10377.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增与 Codex 对齐的 `tools.mode` 枚举，支持 `direct`、`code_mode` 和 `code_mode_only`。`code_mode` 在保留普通工具直接调用能力的同时提供隔离的 `exec` JavaScript 工具；每个可见普通工具会携带自己的嵌套 JavaScript 声明，而 `exec` 保留精简的 `ALL_TOOLS` 元数据。`code_mode_only` 保持严格的普通工具仅经 `exec` 调用模式，`direct` 仍为默认值。

更新经过过滤的子智能体工具面，使直接声明和 `exec` 嵌套 binding 遵守同一组 allowlist；在设置界面中将该枚举显示为 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only；重新生成 settings JSON schema；并彻底移除原来的 `tools.codeModeOnly` 布尔设置。

新增同步的[英文](docs/design/code-mode.md)和[中文](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md)设计文档，并将现有 CodeModeOnly 设计补齐为仓库要求的双语文档（[英文](docs/design/code-mode-only.md)、[中文](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)）。

## 为什么需要

Qwen Code 此前只提供默认的直接工具面或严格的 CodeModeOnly 工具面。模型无法在简单操作中使用直接调用，同时在多工具工作流中使用 `exec` 编排。三值枚举与 Codex 的 `ToolMode` 命名一致，并为所有支持的暴露模式提供一个明确的统一设置项。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 不设置 `tools.mode` 或将其设为 `direct`，重启 Qwen Code，确认普通工具仍可用且不存在 `exec`。
2. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode` 并重启，确认普通工具和 `exec` 同时可用；确认普通工具描述包含各自的 `tools.<name>(args)` 声明，延迟工具仍可通过 `tool_search` 发现。
3. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode_only` 并重启，确认普通工具通过 `exec` 而不是顶层调用使用，同时直接控制工具仍然可用。
4. 打开设置界面，确认 Tool Mode 可在 Default、Code Mode 和 Code Mode Only 之间切换，并确认 settings schema 中不再存在 `tools.codeModeOnly`。
5. 配置任一 code mode 后用 `--safe-mode` 或 `--bare` 启动，确认有效模式为 `direct`。

已完成自动化验证：Core 相关测试（121 个）、CLI 相关测试（585 个）、再次运行的 settings schema 回归测试（60 个）、完整 build、完整 typecheck、完整 lint，以及已安装版本和分支构建版本的 CLI 版本 smoke 检查。

### 前后对比证据

之前：设置界面以 `false` / `true` 布尔值展示 `Code Mode Only (Experimental)`。

之后：设置界面以枚举展示 `Tool Mode (Experimental)`，可选 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only。更新后的 TUI snapshot 覆盖默认显示。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

macOS、Node.js v24.18.0；本地源码构建和 package 级 Vitest 测试套件。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：混合模式会在每个普通工具描述中增加一段简短的嵌套调用声明，使 prompt 略微增大；完整 schema 不会在 `exec` 描述中重复。
- 未验证 / 范围外：未进行真实 provider 的交互式运行，也未在 Windows/Linux 本地执行；支持平台由 CI 覆盖。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：`tools.codeModeOnly` 已移除。请将 `{ "tools": { "codeModeOnly": true } }` 替换为 `{ "tools": { "mode": "code_mode_only" } }`。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #10377。

</details>

prs.title: feat(serve): add persisted workspace artifact library
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds workspace-qualified artifact library endpoints for reading and unregistering artifacts from live, unloaded and archived sessions. Cold reads use persisted records without loading an agent. Removal persists an explicit tombstone, preserves the archive state and leaves physical files intact.

The daemon advertises `session_artifact_library` only when artifact persistence is available. Management removal requires the existing strict mutation guard and an explicitly resolved workspace runtime. The original client-owned artifact endpoints retain their authorization contract.

## Why it's needed

A workspace artifact browser needs access to outputs after their conversations close or are archived. The existing artifact endpoints require a loaded session, and mutations require a session-bound client. Loading every historical conversation merely to browse outputs would allocate agents and alter runtime state; impersonating the original client would also give the wrong ownership semantics.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Register restorable artifacts in sessions belonging to two workspaces. Keep one session live, close another and archive another. The library should return each session's artifacts under its owning workspace without attaching a client, loading a cold session or unarchiving it.
2. Remove registrations from live, cold and archived sessions. Repeat a removal to confirm idempotence. Restart the daemon and restore a session with a completed conversation turn: removed registrations should stay absent, remaining registrations should survive and physical files should remain unchanged.
3. Try a wrong workspace and an unknown session. Neither should fall back to the primary workspace. Confirm that the original mutation endpoint still rejects missing or forged client identities.
4. Disable recording through system settings. The library capability should be absent and library requests should return 409. Corrupt or oversized transcripts, conflicting writers and cold managed-execution mutations should fail without changing storage.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the installed baseline could list a persisted session, but its original artifact endpoint returned 404 after the live session closed. The workspace artifact library route and capability were absent.

After: real-daemon HTTP verification passed 63 live/cold/archived checks plus 3 persistence-disabled checks. Focused package verification passed 409 core tests, 220 artifact bridge tests, 168 CLI capability/archive/workspace tests and 113 focused CLI server tests. Full build and typecheck passed; after the final core changes, core build/typecheck and the final bundle passed again. A separate E2E report comment records the behavior and limitations. UI/TUI screenshots are not applicable to this daemon API change.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.23.2, local bundled CLI, authenticated loopback daemon and dedicated temporary workspaces. No model calls were made. The restore fixture used native recording APIs and a writer lease to record a completed conversation turn.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: owner-level removal crosses the existing client-ownership boundary deliberately, so it is exposed through a separate guarded management route. Cold operations coordinate with session lifecycle changes and writer leases; individual transcript reads are limited to 64 MiB.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows and Linux execution, product UI, physical-file deletion and cold managed-execution mutation. The existing loader's loss of the live artifact view for API-only sessions without conversation turns also reproduces on the installed baseline and is outside this change. The broad four-file CLI run was unstable (1,548/1,551 on this tree; 1,550/1,551 with a different failure on unchanged HEAD); all previously failing test names passed in the focused rerun, but the broad suite is not claimed fully green.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: additive endpoints and capability; no migration or transcript rewrite. Clients must check the capability before using the library.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/e48beb89ed307f1c9cee0c545228ef795ef0d113/docs/design/session-artifact-library.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/e48beb89ed307f1c9cee0c545228ef795ef0d113/docs/design/session-artifact-library.zh-CN.md). Both versions cover the same decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria and remaining limitations.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

新增工作目录作用域的产物管理接口，可读取和移除运行中、未加载及已归档会话的产物登记。冷会话直接读取持久化记录，不加载 agent。移除操作持久化显式 tombstone，保持归档状态，保留磁盘文件。

仅在产物持久化可用时，daemon 才声明 `session_artifact_library` 能力。管理删除接口经过既有严格写入校验，并要求显式解析所属工作目录 runtime。原有客户端产物接口的权限合同保持不变。

## 为什么需要

工作目录产物浏览器需要在对话关闭或归档后继续访问产物。现有产物接口要求会话已经加载，写入还要求绑定的客户端。仅为浏览输出而加载全部历史对话会分配 agent 并改变运行状态；伪造原客户端身份也不符合所有权语义。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在两个工作目录的会话中登记可恢复产物，分别保持一个会话运行、关闭另一个、归档另一个。管理接口应在各自所属工作目录下返回对应产物，不绑定客户端、不加载冷会话、不取消归档。
2. 分别移除运行中、冷会话及归档会话的产物登记，重复移除以确认幂等性。重启 daemon，并恢复含已完成对话轮次的会话：已移除登记应保持消失，其余登记继续存在，磁盘文件保持不变。
3. 使用错误工作目录和不存在的会话请求接口，两者都不能回退到主工作目录。确认原有写入接口仍然拒绝缺失或伪造的客户端身份。
4. 通过系统设置关闭记录功能，产物管理能力应不再声明，管理请求应返回 409。损坏或超大记录、writer 冲突及冷 managed execution 写入应失败，且不改变存储。

### 证据（改动前后）

改动前：全局安装的基线版本可以列出持久化会话，但关闭运行中会话后，原产物接口返回 404。工作目录产物管理路由和能力均不存在。

改动后：真实 daemon HTTP 验证通过 63 项运行中/冷会话/归档检查，以及 3 项关闭持久化的检查。专项 package 验证通过 core 409 项、产物 bridge 220 项、CLI 能力/归档/工作目录 168 项及 CLI server 专项 113 项。完整 build 和 typecheck 通过；最后一次 core 修改后，再次通过 core build/typecheck 和最终 bundle。独立 E2E 报告评论记录了行为与限制。本次为 daemon API 改动，UI/TUI 截图不适用。

### 已测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Node.js 22.23.2、本地打包 CLI、经过认证的 loopback daemon 及独立临时工作目录。没有调用模型。恢复用例通过原生记录 API 和 writer lease 写入已完成的对话轮次。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：所有者管理删除明确跨越原有客户端所有权边界，因此由独立且受保护的管理路由提供。冷会话操作通过生命周期协调及 writer lease 避免并发冲突；单份对话记录读取上限为 64 MiB。
- 未验证或不在范围内：Windows/Linux 运行、产品 UI、磁盘文件删除及冷 managed execution 写入。既有 loader 对没有对话轮次、仅由 API 登记产物的会话，恢复后可能丢失运行中产物视图；全局安装的基线版本也已复现，本次不处理。四文件 CLI 大组存在波动（当前修改 1,548/1,551；未修改 HEAD 为 1,550/1,551，失败项不同）；此前失败项在专项重跑中全部通过，但不声称大组全绿。
- 破坏性改动或迁移说明：仅新增接口和能力，无需迁移，不重写对话记录。客户端必须先检查能力声明，再使用产物管理接口。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/e48beb89ed307f1c9cee0c545228ef795ef0d113/docs/design/session-artifact-library.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/e48beb89ed307f1c9cee0c545228ef795ef0d113/docs/design/session-artifact-library.zh-CN.md)。两版完整同步设计决策、约束、验收标准及剩余限制。

## 关联 Issue

无。

</details>

prs.title: test(managed-agent): gate a pre-dispatch MCP operation cancel (FG12d)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the FG12d gate cell for cancelling a raw MCP operation before it is dispatched. The Broker proxy in `HostedMcpRestartFaultGatesIT` parks the owner acquire that `invoke()` issues after committing the operation at `intent` and before committing `dispatch_started`. While it is parked, the case cancels the operation through the supported Harness route and proves the cancel settles as `not_started_proven` with no effect and no MCP control on the wire.

## Why it's needed

#14880 item 2 left this FG12d cell open, recording that the pre-dispatch window could not be reached without a row-seeding helper because the public route starts the dispatch. The window is reachable without seeding: `invoke()` commits `intent`, acquires the owner, and only then commits `dispatch_started`; the cancel route is not blocked by an in-flight invoke, and the pre-dispatch cancel branch never contacts the Broker. Parking that acquire keeps every record write inside the Harness, which is the code under test, instead of bypassing the record writer and revision chain with a synthetic row.

The case asserts:

- the cancel answers `settled` with `managed_mcp_cancelled` while the invoke is still parked, and the record is `cancelled` / `not_started_proven`, `cancelRequested: true`, with no `resultRef`;
- after the acquire is released, the original invoke, a same-id retry and a status read all answer the same view;
- no MCP control (`mcp-invoke`, `mcp-cancel`, `mcp-status`) reaches the Broker after the parked acquire, the fixture records no effect, and no second server starts.

The FG12d design doc gains a follow-up section with the cell, its two decisions, the mutation witnesses and the budget, in both languages.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
JAVA_HOME=<jdk21> mvn test-compile failsafe:integration-test failsafe:verify \
  -Dit.test='HostedMcpRestartFaultGatesIT#cancelBeforeDispatchIsNotStartedProvenOnMySql' \
  -Dfailsafe.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false \
  -Dmysql.url='jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:<port>/hosted_harness_test?allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false' \
  -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password=<password> \
  -Dnode.executable="$(command -v node)" -Dqwen.cli.entry=<repo>/dist/cli.js
```

Expected: one test, zero failures. `target/fg12-cases/fg12d/<tenant>/proxy.json` shows the `refresh()` acquire and `mcp-discover` forwarded, then the parked acquire (status 200 after release) as the last call, with no MCP control after it.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI. Mutation witnesses, each rebuilt into `dist/cli.js` (esbuild bundles the TypeScript source) and run against the single case:

| Mutant (`hosted-mcp-session.ts`) | Result |
| --- | --- |
| M1: `cancel()` skips its `intent` branch | Red: the cancel acquires, sends a native `mcp-cancel` the Runtime never registered, and answers `outcome_unknown` instead of `settled`. |
| M2: `invoke()` does not re-read the record after the owner acquire | Red: the stale `dispatch_started` commit over the cancelled record is refused; the resumed invoke answers 503. |
| M3: `invoke()` re-reads the record but ignores the local proof | Red only through the wire assertion: the resumed invoke still answers `managed_mcp_cancelled`, but an `mcp-status` follows the parked acquire. |
| Control: unmutated source rebuilt afterwards | Green. |

M3 is the case the round's brief warns about: a lookup that re-reads the record masks the dropped guard, so only the wire sequence can catch it.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

- Linux aarch64, JDK 21, MySQL 8.4.6, `dist/cli.js` built from this base: the new case passes alone (20.5 s cold) and the whole class passes 8/8 in 94.5 s, with the new case at 9.1 s.
- `mvn -DskipTests test-compile checkstyle:check checkstyle:check@runtime-broker-checkstyle` is clean on JDK 21.
- `scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js`: 69/69.
- After merging `main` at `8cb67de793` (budget conflicts with #14875 and #14931, resolved by stacking this cell on their numbers) and rebuilding `dist/cli.js`: the class passes 8/8 again in 94.9 s (new case 8.6 s), the meta test passes 70/70, and Prettier and both Checkstyle executions are clean.
- After merging `main` again at `f8c3388470` (budget conflicts with #14917, resolved the same way): the class passes 8/8 in 97.2 s (new case 9.3 s), the meta test passes 72/72, and Prettier and both Checkstyle executions are clean.
- Review fix `c159662297` (teardown releases the parked acquire; the park assertion prints the last broken record read): the case stays green (20.7 s), and M1 now reports red on the same assertion in 18.2 s instead of 46 s.

auto_merge.commit_message:
Cover #14880 item 2 without seeding a row. invoke() commits the
mcp_operation at intent, acquires the owner and only then commits
dispatch_started, and the cancel route is not gated by an in-flight
invoke. The Broker proxy parks the first tool-session acquire that
arrives while the durable record is still intent, and the case cancels
through the supported Harness route inside that window.

The cancel settles managed_mcp_cancelled with the record at
cancelled/not_started_proven; the resumed invoke, a same-id retry and a
status read answer the same view, and no MCP control reaches the Broker
after the parked acquire. Three bundle mutants (cancel skips its intent
branch, invoke skips the post-acquire re-read, invoke ignores the local
proof) each turn the case red; the last only through the wire assertion.

Budget the cell at 18 s (2x its measured 9.1 s): healthy 9518 -> 9536,
fork 10118 -> 10136, Verify stays 179 minutes.

prs.title: feat(core): add a real PTY backend for the Bun runtime
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Enables a POSIX PTY backend for Bun so shell tools and Web Terminal sessions can receive terminal output, resize and observe exits instead of falling back to ordinary child processes. It reads the existing pinned native addon's master descriptor directly, keeps reading while delivery is paused, and bounds the retained output and pending writes. Resource failures become explicit shell errors or WebSocket error frames, rather than successful command exits. Terminal error subscriptions are detached according to their actual return contract so releasing an EventEmitter-backed terminal does not crash the server.

## Why it's needed

With the existing wrapper under Bun, an idle nonblocking read can surface `EAGAIN` as a stream error and close the master descriptor: output stops and resize can fail although the child is still running. The previous runtime gate therefore disabled PTYs under Bun. Direct descriptor reads avoid that wrapper path. Keeping the read pump active during pause requires bounded storage: once the paused hold is full the reads park and the child blocks on write, as behind the wrapper's paused socket, instead of silently dropping output or retaining unlimited memory. An overflowing write queue fails the affected session visibly. This implements the backend and resource-error integration, not a complete runtime migration or a proof of safe cleanup for every process tree.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Review head `49e785315a2eb6ae106c7d0874def0baf7279a97` against `main` (the prerequisite #14036 merged on 2026-10-16). Under Bun 1.3.14 on POSIX, confirm a shell produces Unicode output, responds to a real terminal resize, exits naturally and allows the host to exit naturally. Repeat with Node 24.19.0 as the compatibility control. Bun on Windows should return a load error, not select this backend.
2. Pause/resume and XOFF/XON around a finite flood. Below the cap, compare the entire output byte-for-byte, including default terminal line processing. Verify natural exit and cancellation while paused. Past the paused-hold cap, expect the reads to park with no error and the child alive and blocked, and XON/resume to deliver the rest byte-exact. Above the write budget, expect one structured failure, no fabricated success/exit code, released accounting and no impact on a healthy sibling session. Check admission beyond eight active terminals.
3. Through a real shell execution and `qwen serve` WebSocket connection, check release4004, natural exit4000, and backend-limit error4001 with the same failure on reconnect; the server must remain usable. Route-level input backpressure closes with1013 and must be distinguished from backend4001: a route-level1013 is not proof that the backend4001 path ran.
4. Check all owned child/descendant lifecycles and total FD/thread/accounting return, including TERM-resistant descendants and delayed native exit. A closed master or disappeared root PID is insufficient. Record actual commands, versions, exit codes, skips, raw output and cleanup snapshots; do not subtract known KQUEUE growth.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the author reported the wrapper's `EAGAIN`/closed-master failure under Bun1.3.14/1.4.0 with a working Node control. The earlier d7 head also crashed the real serve process when releasing the Bun terminal because an EventEmitter return value was treated as a disposable. This head includes the subscription-contract fix and tests; the resource-failure contract is implemented in both shell and WebSocket consumers.

Paused-hold cap (R1-33), Linux x64 under Bun 1.3.14 with the shell tool's spawn shape: at `c686aa3972` one XOFF during a ~5.3 MB flood terminated the tree with `QWEN_PTY_OUTPUT_LIMIT` (child dead, no exit event); at `2aabb403eb` the reads park at 4,194,304 held bytes with the child alive and no error, and XON delivers all 5,288,890 bytes byte-exact. The backend gives the same result under Node 22. macOS was not re-run for this change.

Foreground jobs on a limit termination: at `0e12984593` an interactive shell's TERM/HUP-ignoring job in its own process group survived a write-queue termination (reparented to init) on Linux x64 and macOS 10.15 x64; at `49e785315a` the SIGKILL pass reaps it on both.

Remaining failures are material: independent macOS arm64 testing of d7 completed the 30-minute and eight-PTY/two-hour windows but both runtime legs exited1 on FD checks, with eight additional KQUEUE descriptors per leg in the long window. The native addon is not patched by this diff. Paused-flood strict byte checks also failed (including an extra-CR sample); later successful reruns do not close that failure or establish an OS-only cause. Those predecessor observations require closure on the selected candidate, not an exemption. Later local candidates and native fixes are not code in this PR's current head.

The focused suites are reproducible after normal dependency setup; these are commands to run, not a claim that this edit ran them:

```sh
cd packages/core
BUN_TEST_BIN=/absolute/path/to/bun-1.3.14 NODE_TEST_BIN=/absolute/path/to/node-24.19.0 corepack pnpm exec vitest run src/utils/bun-pty.test.ts src/utils/getPty.test.ts src/utils/bun-pty.node-bun.test.ts src/utils/runtime-boundary.node-bun.test.ts src/services/shellExecutionService.test.ts src/services/web-terminal-registry.test.ts
cd ../cli
corepack pnpm exec vitest run src/serve/routes/terminal.test.ts
cd ../..
npm run preflight
```

The unit suites include mocked consumers; their pass counts do not establish real product lifecycle or native resource acceptance. A current-head terminal recording/raw end-to-end report and complete cross-platform/resource evidence are still needed; this edit adds no new E2E run or visual demo.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | Author focused Node/Bun checks reported; independent predecessor FD/byte failures retained; current head not independently accepted |
| 🪟 Windows | Bun backend disabled; ConPTY not validated by this PR |
| 🐧 Linux | No complete local product/resource acceptance claimed for this head; CI jobs do not substitute for it |

### Environment (optional)

Historical macOS arm64 comparisons use Node24.19.0 and Bun1.3.14; author probes also used Bun1.4.0. The same pinned `@lydell/node-pty` addon is used, not a new native fix. No tests were run for this description-only update.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: pause stops delivery while reads continue until the hold is full; then reads park and the child blocks on write (no error, no kill). While parked, exit detection matches the wrapper: on macOS a child killed with output undrained finishes exiting only once reads resume, so the shell tool's cancel resumes before it signals. Defaults are 4MiB held per PTY, 32MiB held process-wide, 64 active PTYs and a 1MiB write queue per PTY. Exceeding the write queue terminates the affected session with a structured error; the active-PTY cap rejects admission. Termination attempts TERM then KILL after500ms; complete tree cleanup, PID-reuse safety, native resource release and finalization timing remain acceptance work, not guarantees established by this description.
- Not validated / out of scope: native KQUEUE repair, complete safe descendant cleanup, strict byte/combined-suite stability, Windows Bun PTY, the separate agent-view PTY host, original release-archive execution and full cross-platform acceptance. The apparent FIFO classification of macOS KQUEUE descriptors is not evidence of a distinct helper-pipe leak. No supervisor, owner-token protocol or later Bun Terminal replacement is implemented in this head.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no public command removal or forced npm runtime migration; Node backend selection is retained. Bun changes from unavailable PTY to a terminal backend, and budget exhaustion now visibly fails/terminates commands. Callers must handle structured failures with null exitCode/signal; WebSocket clients must handle the error frame/4001 and failed-session reconnect. Do not describe this as zero behavior change. No user action enables a new default runtime here.

This diff exceeds2,000 changed lines because the backend, bounded-storage tests, shell/WebSocket failure handling and bilingual design are reviewed together; exposing limits without their consumer error handling would misreport failures. This explains the scope, not a waiver of review, preflight or resource gates.

Design pairs: [backend English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/49e785315a2eb6ae106c7d0874def0baf7279a97/docs/design/bun-pty-backend.md) / [后端中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/49e785315a2eb6ae106c7d0874def0baf7279a97/docs/design/bun-pty-backend.zh-CN.md), and [runtime English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/49e785315a2eb6ae106c7d0874def0baf7279a97/docs/design/bun-runtime-boundary.md) / [运行时中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/49e785315a2eb6ae106c7d0874def0baf7279a97/docs/design/bun-runtime-boundary.zh-CN.md). Both language pairs are in the diff; historical claims must be read with the failure qualifications above, not as full acceptance.

## Linked Issues

Builds on #14036 (`feat/bun-runtime-boundary`), merged on 2026-10-16. Related: #11607 and #11881. No issue is auto-closed. This PR remains subject to requested changes and is not ready merely because it is open.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

为 Bun 启用 POSIX PTY 后端，使 shell 工具与 Web Terminal 会话能够接收终端输出、调整尺寸和观察退出，而非回退普通子进程。后端直接读取现有锁定 addon 的 master fd，暂停投递时持续读取，并限制保持输出及待写入数据。资源失败转换为明确 shell 错误或 WebSocket 错误帧，不伪装成功退出。终端错误订阅按真实返回契约解绑，避免释放 EventEmitter 后端时崩溃服务。

## 为什么需要

Bun 下原包装层可能把非阻塞空闲读取的 EAGAIN 当流错误并关闭 master，导致子进程仍运行但输出停止、resize失败。因此此前禁用 Bun PTY。直接读取描述符避开这条包装路径；暂停时持续读取则必须限制存储：暂停保持区满后停读，子进程阻塞在写上（与 wrapper 暂停 socket 相同），而不是静默丢字节或无限占用内存；写队列超限则明确失败。本 PR 实现后端与资源错误接线，不代表整体迁移完成或所有进程树均已安全回收。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 对照 `main` 审阅 head `49e785315a2eb6ae106c7d0874def0baf7279a97`（前置 #14036 已于 2026-10-16 合入）。POSIX下用Bun1.3.14确认shell输出Unicode、真实resize、自然退出及宿主自然退出；用Node24.19.0作兼容对照。Windows Bun应返回加载错误，不选该后端。
2. 在有限洪流中pause/resume及XOFF/XON。上限内逐字节比较全部输出，保留默认行规程；验证暂停自然退出及取消。超过暂停保持上限应停读、无错误、子进程存活并阻塞，XON/resume 后逐字节交付其余输出；超过写预算应仅一次结构化失败，无伪造成功或退出码，账本释放，不影响健康会话；验证第九个终端准入拒绝。
3. 经真实shell执行及qwen serve WebSocket检查release4004、自然退出4000、后端超限错误4001与重连同错误，服务仍可用。区分registry输入背压与后端：路由1013不证明后端4001已执行。
4. 检查自有child/全部子孙、总FD/线程/账本回收，覆盖抵抗TERM的后代与迟到native exit。master关闭或root PID消失不足以通过。保存真实命令、版本、退出码、skip、输出和清理快照，不扣除已知KQUEUE增长。

### 证据（Before & After）

修复前，作者报告Bun1.3.14/1.4.0包装层EAGAIN/master关闭，Node对照正常；早期d7在释放真实Bun终端时因将EventEmitter返回值当disposable而崩溃服务。当前head含订阅契约修复与测试，并在shell/WS消费方实现资源错误合同。

暂停保持上限（R1-33），Linux x64、Bun 1.3.14、shell 工具的 spawn 形状：`c686aa3972` 上约 5.3 MB 洪流中一个 XOFF 就以 `QWEN_PTY_OUTPUT_LIMIT` 终止进程树（子进程死亡、无退出事件）；`2aabb403eb` 上在保持 4,194,304 字节处停读，子进程存活、无错误，XON 后全部 5,288,890 字节逐字节交付。后端在 Node 22 下结果相同。此改动未在 macOS 上复跑。

限额终止时的前台作业：`0e12984593` 上，交互式 shell 在独立进程组中运行、忽略 TERM/HUP 的作业在写队列终止后存活（被 init 收养），Linux x64 与 macOS 10.15 x64 均如此；`49e785315a` 上两者都由 SIGKILL 轮回收。

重要失败仍保留：独立macOS arm64的d7测试完成30分钟及8PTY两小时窗口，但两运行时均因FD检查exit1，长窗各增加8个KQUEUE。当前diff未修补native addon。paused-flood严格字节检查也失败（含额外CR保全样本）；后来重跑成功不能关闭失败或证明仅为OS原因。须在选定候选关闭这些前序观察，不作豁免。后续本地候选与native修复并非当前PR head中的代码。

正常安装依赖后可复现以下定向检查；它们是待运行命令，不代表本次已执行：

```sh
cd packages/core
BUN_TEST_BIN=/absolute/path/to/bun-1.3.14 NODE_TEST_BIN=/absolute/path/to/node-24.19.0 corepack pnpm exec vitest run src/utils/bun-pty.test.ts src/utils/getPty.test.ts src/utils/bun-pty.node-bun.test.ts src/utils/runtime-boundary.node-bun.test.ts src/services/shellExecutionService.test.ts src/services/web-terminal-registry.test.ts
cd ../cli
corepack pnpm exec vitest run src/serve/routes/terminal.test.ts
cd ../..
npm run preflight
```

单测含mock消费方，计数不代表真实产品生命周期或native资源验收。仍需当前head的终端录像/原始端到端报告及完整跨平台、资源证据；本次未新跑E2E或补视觉演示。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :--- | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | 作者报告定向Node/Bun检查；独立前序FD/字节失败保留，当前head未独立验收 |
| 🪟 Windows | Bun后端禁用，本PR未验证ConPTY |
| 🐧 Linux | 不声称当前head本机完整产品/资源通过，CI job不替代 |

### 环境（可选）

历史macOS arm64对照使用Node24.19.0/Bun1.3.14，作者另用Bun1.4.0；仍为同一锁定@lydell/node-pty addon，不是新native修复。本次描述更新未运行测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：pause停止投递而持续读取，直到保持区满；之后停读，子进程阻塞在写上（无错误、不杀进程）。停读期间退出检测与 wrapper 相同：macOS 上带着未排空输出被杀的子进程要等读取恢复才完成退出，因此 shell 工具取消时先 resume 再发信号。默认每PTY保持4MiB、进程总保持32MiB、64个活动PTY、每PTY写队列1MiB；写队列超限会结构化失败并终止该会话，活动PTY上限拒绝准入。终止尝试TERM后500ms升级KILL；完整树清理、PID复用安全、native资源及最终化时限仍待验收，不是本描述确立的保证。
- 未验证/范围外：native KQUEUE修复、完整安全树、严格字节/组合稳定、Windows Bun PTY、独立agent-view PTY host、原样发布归档执行及完整跨平台验收。macOS KQUEUE被粗分类为FIFO不证明另有helper管道泄漏。当前head未实现supervisor、owner-token协议或后来的Bun Terminal替代。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：不删除公开命令、不强制npm迁移，保留Node后端选择。Bun从不可用PTY变为终端后端，预算超限现在会明确失败/终止命令。调用方须处理exitCode/signal为null的结构化失败；WS客户端须处理错误帧/4001与失败重连。不能称为零行为变化；本PR不启用新默认运行时。

diff超过2000变更行，是将后端、有界存储测试、shell/WS失败接线与双语设计共同审阅；只有上限而没有消费方错误处理会误报失败。这仅解释范围，不豁免review、preflight或资源门槛。

设计文档：[backend English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/49e785315a2eb6ae106c7d0874def0baf7279a97/docs/design/bun-pty-backend.md) / [后端中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/49e785315a2eb6ae106c7d0874def0baf7279a97/docs/design/bun-pty-backend.zh-CN.md)，以及[runtime English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/49e785315a2eb6ae106c7d0874def0baf7279a97/docs/design/bun-runtime-boundary.md) / [运行时中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/49e785315a2eb6ae106c7d0874def0baf7279a97/docs/design/bun-runtime-boundary.zh-CN.md)。两组语言版本均在diff内；历史主张须结合上述失败限定阅读，不代表完整验收。

## 关联 Issue

基于#14036（feat/bun-runtime-boundary），已于2026-10-16合入。相关#11607与#11881，不自动关闭issue。当前仍需处理请求修改，OPEN不代表可合并。

prs.title: feat(serve): add daemon restart
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `qwen daemon restart`. It stops exactly one registered daemon through `qwen daemon stop` and starts it again through `qwen daemon start --wait` on the recorded port and hostname. It replays the recorded startup workspaces, Web Shell mode, and `--require-auth` setting, and keeps the daemon's bearer credential. `--web`/`--no-web` and `--require-auth`/`--no-require-auth` override the record. To make the replay faithful, `qwen serve` now writes three optional discovery-record fields: `startupWorkspaces` (explicit startup workspaces, without the registrations restored at boot), `web`, and `requireAuth`.

Every refusal that can be decided while the daemon is still running happens before the stop leg. Restart refuses an HTTPS daemon, an older record whose workspaces may include restored registrations, a missing or rejected bearer token, a startup workspace that no longer validates, and a run from inside a process the daemon hosts, such as its Web Shell terminal. After the stop leg, restart reports spawn errors, continues when the daemon already exited on its own, and exits non-zero when the daemon came back on a different port.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-21-daemon-restart.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-21-daemon-restart.zh-CN.md). User guide: `docs/users/qwen-serve.md` ("Inspect and control a local daemon").

## Why it's needed

Restarting a daemon currently means remembering its port, workspaces, and launch flags, then running `stop` and `start` by hand, with nothing ensuring it comes back the way it went down. `docs/design/2026-10-19-daemon-discovery-and-control.md` lists `restart` as a follow-up. Restart reuses the discovery record, the existing stop/start safety checks, and the ready wait from #14914.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `qwen daemon start --port 0 --no-web --workspace <a> --workspace <b> --json`, then `qwen daemon restart --port <port>` with no flags: same port, new PID, and the Web Shell is still off (`GET /` is 404).
2. Remove `<b>` and restart: restart refuses with `cannot restart: Invalid --workspace ...` and the PID is still alive.
3. Register a persisted workspace with `POST /workspaces {"cwd": <c>, "persist": true}`, then restart twice. `<c>` is still removable (`DELETE /workspaces/<id>` returns 200), and after another restart it does not come back.
4. Start a bearer daemon with `QWEN_SERVER_TOKEN=s1`. Restart without a token, and then with a wrong one: both are refused and the PID stays alive. With `s1`, restart succeeds and `/health` stays unauthenticated on loopback. Restart with `--require-auth` and `/health` returns 401; a plain restart after that keeps it at 401.
5. Open the daemon's Web Shell terminal and run `qwen daemon restart --port <port>` there: it refuses and the daemon keeps running.
6. Stop with `qwen daemon stop --port <port>`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Linux E2E on `b9a1a34c0b` (isolated `QWEN_HOME`/`QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR`, built CLI), all test daemons stopped afterwards:

```text
restart (recorded web:false)    -> same port 42075, pid 3912606 -> 3913004, GET / = 404
missing workspace               -> cannot restart: Invalid --workspace ".../w2": directory does not exist.  rc=1, pid alive
restored registration w3        -> startup=[w1,w2] ws=[w1,w2,w3]; DELETE w3 -> 200 removed; next restart ws=[w1,w2]
bearer, no token                -> restarting a bearer daemon requires --token or QWEN_SERVER_TOKEN; ...  rc=1, pid alive
bearer, wrong token             -> the daemon on port 33903 rejected the supplied token. ...  rc=1, pid alive
bearer, right token             -> restarted; /daemon/status 401 without and 200 with the token; /health 200
--require-auth, then plain      -> /health 401, record requireAuth:true, still 401 after a plain restart
explicit --token on auth:none   -> record auth:bearer; QWEN_SERVER_TOKEN=ambient alone keeps auth:none
recorded port taken             -> started on 44664 ... the restarted daemon is not on port 44663; ...  rc=1
```

Web Shell terminal A/B, typing restart into the daemon's own `/terminal` WebSocket:

```text
before (98b80d7f23): [ws closed 4000 Terminal exited]; t+2s daemon DEAD, no record, nothing restarted, no message
after  (b9a1a34c0b): qwen daemon: refusing to restart port 37957 from a process that daemon hosts, ...  RESTART_EXIT=1, daemon alive
```

Unit tests: `daemon.test.ts` + `daemon-discovery.test.ts` + `run-qwen-serve.test.ts` + `process-env-guard.test.ts` pass 584/584. CLI `tsc --noEmit` and eslint pass on the changed files. A mutation sweep of 26 mutants over the new restart code turns every mutant red; the record write site is pinned the same way.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

macOS restart E2E passed on the earlier `98b80d7f23` revision but has not been re-run on `b9a1a34c0b`. Windows was not tested locally.

### Environment (optional)

Built CLI (`node packages/cli/dist/index.js`) on Linux x86_64, Node 22.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: restart reproduces only the port, hostname, startup workspaces, Web Shell mode, `--require-auth`, and bearer credential. Other `qwen serve` options (`--profile`, `--http-bridge`, `--channel`, `--allow-origin`, rate limits, ...) reset to their defaults; the docs direct those daemons to `qwen serve`. A token kept only in a workspace `.env`/settings file is not read by `qwen daemon`, so it must be passed through `--token` or `QWEN_SERVER_TOKEN`. Restart never rotates a running bearer daemon's token; rotating means stop, then start.
- Not validated / out of scope: native Windows E2E (the ancestor check uses CIM there), and a structured `--json` result.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The new record fields are optional, so older CLIs still read the record and the version stays 1. An older daemon whose record lists more than one workspace is refused once; stop it and start it again.

## Linked Issues

N/A

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增 `qwen daemon restart`。它通过 `qwen daemon stop` 停止恰好一个已注册的 daemon，再通过 `qwen daemon start --wait` 在记录的 port 与 hostname 上重新启动；重放记录中的启动 workspaces、Web Shell 模式与 `--require-auth` 设置，并保留 daemon 的 bearer 凭据。`--web`/`--no-web` 与 `--require-auth`/`--no-require-auth` 可覆盖记录。为了如实重放，`qwen serve` 现在在 discovery record 中写入三个可选字段：`startupWorkspaces`（显式启动 workspaces，不含启动时恢复的注册）、`web` 与 `requireAuth`。

凡是能在 daemon 仍在运行时做出的拒绝，都在 stop 之前完成。restart 会拒绝：HTTPS daemon、workspaces 可能包含恢复注册的旧 record、缺失或被拒绝的 bearer token、不再通过校验的启动 workspace，以及在 daemon 托管的进程（例如它的 Web Shell 终端）中运行。stop 之后，restart 会报告 spawn 错误；daemon 已自行退出时继续启动；daemon 没有回到原端口时返回非零。

## 为什么需要

目前重启 daemon 需要记住端口、workspaces 与启动参数，再手动执行 `stop` 和 `start`，并且没有机制保证它恢复成原来的形态。`docs/design/2026-10-19-daemon-discovery-and-control.md` 已把 `restart` 列为后续工作。restart 复用 discovery record、现有 stop/start 安全检查，以及 #14914 的就绪等待。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. `qwen daemon start --port 0 --no-web --workspace <a> --workspace <b> --json`，再不带 flag 执行 `qwen daemon restart --port <port>`：端口不变、PID 更新，Web Shell 仍关闭（`GET /` 为 404）。
2. 删除 `<b>` 后 restart：restart 以 `cannot restart: Invalid --workspace ...` 拒绝，PID 仍存活。
3. 用 `POST /workspaces {"cwd": <c>, "persist": true}` 注册持久化 workspace，再 restart 两次。`<c>` 仍可移除（`DELETE /workspaces/<id>` 返回 200），之后再 restart 也不会复活。
4. 用 `QWEN_SERVER_TOKEN=s1` 启动 bearer daemon。不带 token、带错误 token 的 restart 都被拒绝，PID 仍存活。带 `s1` 时 restart 成功，loopback 上 `/health` 仍免认证。带 `--require-auth` restart 后 `/health` 返回 401；之后不带 flag 的 restart 仍保持 401。
5. 打开 daemon 的 Web Shell 终端，在其中执行 `qwen daemon restart --port <port>`：被拒绝，daemon 继续运行。
6. 用 `qwen daemon stop --port <port>` 停止。

### 证据（前后对比）

```text
missing workspace               -> cannot restart: Invalid --workspace ".../w2": directory does not exist.  rc=1, pid alive
restored registration w3        -> startup=[w1,w2] ws=[w1,w2,w3]; DELETE w3 -> 200 removed; next restart ws=[w1,w2]
bearer, no token                -> restarting a bearer daemon requires --token or QWEN_SERVER_TOKEN; ...  rc=1, pid alive
bearer, wrong token             -> the daemon on port 33903 rejected the supplied token. ...  rc=1, pid alive
bearer, right token             -> restarted; /daemon/status 401 without and 200 with the token; /health 200
--require-auth, then plain      -> /health 401, record requireAuth:true, still 401 after a plain restart
explicit --token on auth:none   -> record auth:bearer; QWEN_SERVER_TOKEN=ambient alone keeps auth:none

```

Web Shell 终端 A/B（通过 daemon 自身的 `/terminal` WebSocket 输入 restart）：

```text
before (98b80d7f23): [ws closed 4000 Terminal exited]; t+2s daemon DEAD, no record, nothing restarted, no message
after  (b9a1a34c0b): qwen daemon: refusing to restart port 37957 from a process that daemon hosts, ...  RESTART_EXIT=1, daemon alive
```

单测：`daemon.test.ts`、`daemon-discovery.test.ts`、`run-qwen-serve.test.ts`、`process-env-guard.test.ts` 共 584/584 通过。CLI `tsc --noEmit` 与改动文件的 eslint 通过。对新 restart 代码的 26 个变异全部被测试拦截（变红）；record 写入点也用同样方式钉住。

### 测试平台

macOS：⚠️，restart E2E 曾在较早的 `98b80d7f23` 版本通过，`b9a1a34c0b` 未重跑。Windows：⚠️，未在本地测试。Linux：✅。
