prs.title: fix(cli): accept explicitly named Local Control addresses outside RFC 1918/3927
prs.body:
## What this PR does

An explicitly passed `--local-control-address` is now treated as operator intent: Local Control accepts any non-internal, non-loopback IPv4 the host actually has — including addresses outside RFC 1918/3927 space (some enterprise intranets number their LANs from public ranges) and addresses on VPN/tunnel interfaces (phone and laptop on the same corporate VPN). Automatic advertisement stays RFC 1918/3927-only and untouched; the escape hatch opens only when the operator names the address, and out-of-private-space picks are logged with a loud warning on enable. The explicit pick is also resolved before the no-candidate failure, so a host with zero automatic candidates can still opt in.

## Why it's needed

On a host whose only non-loopback IPv4 is a public-range corporate-intranet address, Local Control was completely unusable: `qwen serve --local-control` exited with "No private IPv4 address is available", and `--local-control-address` could not help because it only disambiguated among candidates that had already passed the RFC 1918 filter. The same dead end hit hosts whose only usable address sits on a VPN/tunnel interface. Refuse-by-default remains the right posture for automatic advertising — the missing piece was a way for an operator to say "yes, this one, I mean it."

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On a host whose address is outside RFC 1918/3927 (or on a VPN/tunnel interface), run `qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <that-address>`. Expected: a WARNING that the address is outside private/link-local space, then the pairing QR/URL bound to that address; the LAN listener enforces the pairing token (401 without it, 200 with it). Naming an address the host does not have still fails with `unknown_lan_interface`; naming loopback still fails. Without the flag, behavior is unchanged: automatic selection stays RFC 1918/3927-only, and multiple candidates still surface the explicit-choice error. Unit tests cover the full selection matrix (public-range, tunnel interface, loopback, unknown address, ambiguity, no-candidate ordering).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (released 0.25.1, host's only address on a public-range corporate intranet):

```
$ qwen serve --local-control
qwen serve: No private IPv4 address is available. Local Control needs the host to be on a local network (Wi-Fi or Ethernet).
(exit code 1)
```

After (this branch, same host):

```
$ qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <public-range-address> --port 4399
qwen serve: WARNING: Local Control address <public-range-address> is outside RFC 1918 private / RFC 3927 link-local space. It was accepted only because it was named explicitly — advertise it only on a network you trust.

Local Control is on. Scan this QR code from the same network:
en0: http://<public-range-address>:4399/#token=<pairing-token>
```

LAN listener auth boundary on that address: `GET /` → 200 (Web Shell), `GET /capabilities` → 401 without the pairing token, 200 with it.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Dev CLI (`npm run dev`) on the affected host; `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, ESLint, and Prettier all pass on the change.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the explicit opt-in deliberately widens what `--local-control-address` accepts; automatic (no-flag) behavior is unchanged, and out-of-private-space picks always log a warning. Acceptance requires the address to exist on a live interface, so wildcards, multicast, and typos stay refused.
- Not validated / out of scope: adding CGNAT (100.64/10) to the default allowlist, and a Web Shell settings-card affordance for the opt-in — both deliberately deferred.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14136

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

显式传入的 `--local-control-address` 现在被视为操作员意图：只要主机真实持有该地址，Local Control 就接受任意非 internal、非 loopback 的 IPv4——包括 RFC 1918/3927 范围之外的地址（一些企业内网用公网段给内网编号），以及 VPN/隧道接口上的地址（手机与电脑同挂一个企业 VPN 的场景）。自动 advertise 路径保持 RFC 1918/3927-only 不变；逃生舱只在操作员显式点名地址时开启，且超出私有段的选取会在 enable 时打出醒目警告。显式选取还先于"无候选"报错解析，因此一个没有任何自动候选的主机也能通过显式指定完成配对。

## 为什么需要

当主机唯一的非 loopback IPv4 是企业内网的公网段地址时，Local Control 完全不可用：`qwen serve --local-control` 直接以 "No private IPv4 address is available" 退出，而 `--local-control-address` 也帮不上忙——它此前只能在已通过 RFC 1918 过滤的候选里消歧。唯一可用地址在 VPN/隧道接口上的主机同样无路可走。对自动 advertise 保持默认拒绝仍是正确姿态，缺的是一条让操作员明确表达"就要这个"的通道。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

在地址超出 RFC 1918/3927（或位于 VPN/隧道接口）的主机上运行 `qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <该地址>`。预期：先打印地址超出私有段的 WARNING，然后输出绑定该地址的配对二维码/URL；LAN listener 强制 pairing token（无 token 401，有 token 200）。指定主机没有的地址仍以 `unknown_lan_interface` 失败；指定 loopback 仍然失败。不带该 flag 时行为不变：自动选取保持 RFC 1918/3927-only，多候选仍然报"需要显式选择"。单元测试覆盖完整选取矩阵（公网段、隧道接口、loopback、未知地址、歧义、无候选顺序）。

### 证据（Before & After）

Before（已发布 0.25.1，主机唯一地址在企业内网公网段）：`qwen serve --local-control` 以 exit 1 退出，报 "No private IPv4 address is available"。After（本分支，同主机）：WARNING 之后正常打印二维码与 URL，LAN listener 鉴权边界实测通过（无 token 401 / 有 token 200）。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅；Windows / Linux ⚠️ 未测。

## 风险与范围

prs.title: fix(web-shell): preserve wrapped drafts during arrow navigation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keeps unsent Web Shell drafts intact while Up and Down move the caret through visually wrapped rows. Multiline and wrapped drafts reach their true start or end before the next arrow enters prompt history. Short unwrapped input keeps immediate history recall, and an active selection stays under editor control.

Once history browsing has started, arrows continue through entries even when those entries wrap, and moving past the newest entry restores the original draft.

## Why it's needed

A long single paragraph is one logical line but several visible rows. The previous guard treated every one-line document as a history boundary, so pressing Up inside an ordinary long question replaced the entire draft with a previous prompt.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Submit two distinct prompts to populate input history. Type a long paragraph with no explicit newlines so it wraps across several rows.
2. Press Up from a later row and Down from an earlier row. The caret should move between rows while all draft text remains unchanged.
3. On the first row, move the caret one character away from the start. Up should first move to the start; the next Up should recall history. Continue Up/Down through wrapped history entries, then past the newest entry to recover the draft.
4. Check explicit multiline input, short unwrapped input, and an active text selection. Multiline movement and short-input history should retain their behavior, while a selection should never cause the draft to be replaced by history.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The same 740-character paragraph occupied one logical line and about seven visible rows (156.7 px at 22.4 px line height).

| Action | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Up from the end of the wrapped draft | Entire draft replaced by a 40-character history prompt | All 740 characters retained; caret 740 → 630 |
| Down from the start of the wrapped draft | — | All 740 characters retained; caret 0 → 108 |
| Explicit three-line input | Text retained and caret moved up | Same behavior |
| Short single-row draft | Immediate history recall | Same behavior |

The baseline used the current-main Vite client with the repository's mock daemon. Post-fix production verification used the built CLI's actual daemon and production Web Shell assets, with no mock and no model requests.

Seven added Chrome regressions produced **3 failures / 4 passes before** and **7 passes after**, and all seven are selected by the existing PR smoke filter. A separate production-page verification passed all **4 checks**. The full Web Shell unit suite passed **12,508 tests**, including the **172 focused composer tests**. Build, bundle, repository-wide typecheck, and lint/format checks passed.

Full preflight exited nonzero in the sandbox. Unmodified suites encountered process/cache/home restrictions and resource-sensitive failures; isolated reruns resolved these except two CLI assertions. Both remaining assertions also fail on the clean base commit f1f8a94: a local-address probe and a Git temporary-directory fixture. The same two failures remain with this patch; no unrelated source was changed. The serve-startup bundle check passed separately.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Chrome, browser regressions and production-page verification |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.22.3 on macOS. Production verification ran the locally built CLI with an isolated temporary home, runtime directory and workspace. No provider credentials or model requests were needed for these keyboard interactions.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: caret boundary detection depends on the editor's rendered wrap positions. Real-browser regressions cover both directions, boundary transitions, history traversal, draft restoration and selections.
- Not validated / out of scope: Safari, Firefox, Windows/Linux, touch textarea behavior and model execution.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14879

## 风险与范围

prs.title: test(permissions): cover persistent rule removal
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds five regression cases for removal of active persistent permission rules. The tests exercise the real permission manager with Agent calls, cover allow/ask/deny decisions after removal, preserve unrelated targets and session rules, and verify that an exact raw-string/type mismatch leaves the rule active.

## Why it's needed

Item 3 of #10235 tracks missing coverage for this deletion operation. The existing UI/ACP caller tests mock the manager, so they cannot detect a deletion that reports success while leaving the permission active. Removing the actual deletion action preserves the baseline suite's 555 passing cases; these new tests expose four additional failures under the same mutation.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Verify that removing each active persistent rule changes the affected Agent permission decision to default while another target retains its original decision. Repeated or unmatched removal must return false. Removing persistent deny, ask, and allow rules in sequence must retain the other rule types until they are separately removed and must preserve a matching session allow rule. Temporarily suppressing the actual deletion should fail four new cases; treating an unmatched lookup as the first rule should also fail four new cases. Restore production code after either probe.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-facing change. Focused tests: 5 passed. Complete file before: 555 passed / 12 failed / 567 total; after: 560 passed / 12 failed / 572 total. The failure-name sets are identical; all 12 failures are Windows symlink EPERM from the baseline. With deletion suppressed, the final file has 556 passed / 16 failed, including four new failures. The independent test engineer reproduced the baseline and final counts. All temporary production mutations were restored. The initial root build passed at ad91df5. At the tested base 9e9d1c0, root typecheck passed; the root build log confirmed package completion through CLI, and the final VS Code build and settings-schema steps passed when rerun separately. The combined latest root-build exit code was not captured. Whole-repository format and lint:ci passed during preflight at ad91df5; changed-file ESLint, Prettier, and diff whitespace checks passed. The complete preflight was interrupted during build; workspace-wide test:ci and the serve fast-path bundle gate were not completed, so no overall preflight pass is claimed. Originally opened as a draft; now ready for review.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Not tested |
| Windows | Focused tests passed; complete-file limitations recorded above |
| Linux | Not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Windows, Node.js 24.19.0, npm 11.17.0, pinned pnpm 11.24.0. Unit tests against local source; no live model API call or CLI E2E acceptance is claimed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: test-only coverage of the existing in-memory removal contract; no production changes.
- Not validated / out of scope: settings-file persistence, UI/ACP E2E flows, AUTO-stashed rules, and the other items in #10235.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #10235, item 3 only. The remaining items are intentionally left open.

prs.title: fix(web-shell): align Managed Session titles, file access and the Workspace row
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Three parity fixes for Managed Sessions in the Web Shell, in the direction the two design notes set — a Managed Session reuses the standard shell, rather than growing a second management surface:

1. **A Workspace-bound create now carries a prompt-derived title.** The unbound create path already derived one; the bound path omitted the `title` field, so every bound Session listed and headed as a UUID prefix (for example `1e23d1a2`). The bound path now sends the same bounded, control-character-stripped title.
2. **A deployment that cannot serve Workspace file references no longer gets a permanent alert above the composer.** The mount-time probe's 409 `workspace_files_unsupported` is a capability, not a transient failure: the composer simply has no file-reference actions. The probe's failure is cleared instead of rendering the broker's English message as a standing `role="alert"`, while a refusal from a later read still surfaces (the same code also covers a broker that failed mid-request).
3. **The bound Workspace row is compacted.** In the home layout the 64-character workspace id and the relative directory each appeared twice. The summary line now carries the id (truncated in place, full value in the `title` attribute), the relative directory, the model and the runtime state; the body keeps only the directory switch and, when applicable, the execution-unavailable notice. The standalone embedded layout keeps its two labeled lines.

## Why it's needed

The screenshot in #14918's follow-up shows a bound Session that is already completed but still looks unlike the standard shell: a UUID instead of a title, the same opaque workspace id printed twice, and an English capability error hanging above the editor with no action attached. The shell is shared since the home integration, so these are data and presentation leftovers, not a deployment difference. Fixing the low-risk three first also makes the remaining gaps (error-channel split, request id, lifecycle row actions, header chip) easier to review separately.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Create a bound Managed Session from the composer with a prompt, then refresh. Expected: the sidebar row and the session header show the prompt-derived title. Before: the first eight characters of the Session ID.
2. On a deployment whose runtime or storage refuses Workspace file references, open a bound Session. Expected: no file-reference action in the composer and no standing message above it. Before: `Workspace file access requires an updated CLI.` above the editor. A busy/unavailable probe still reports its message — both sides are pinned in the hook test.
3. Open a bound Session in the home layout. Expected: one summary line with a truncated workspace id (the full id on hover), the relative directory, the model and the runtime state; expanding it shows the directory switch and, when applicable, the execution-unavailable notice. Before: the binding and directory lines repeated the same values. The standalone `ManagedAgentWebShell` entry keeps its two labeled lines because it has no summary element.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for browser screenshots — this checkout has no JDK 21, so the real Java stack cannot run here. The changed DOM and the create payload are pinned by focused unit tests instead:

```console
$ cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run \
    client/components/managed/java-managed-agent-provider.test.ts \
    client/components/managed/use-managed-file-references.test.tsx \
    client/components/managed/ManagedSessionsPage.test.tsx
 ✓ java-managed-agent-provider.test.ts (85 tests)
 ✓ use-managed-file-references.test.tsx (14 tests)
 ✓ ManagedSessionsPage.test.tsx (107 tests)
 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  206 passed (206)
```

`c40e7658` adds the two regression tests the review asked for: the home layout must not render the labeled lines and must carry the full id on the summary's `title`; the standalone layout must keep the labeled lines. Both were proven to fail when the corresponding source hunk is reverted. `1ec37d68` narrows the file-access suppression to the mount probe and adds a test that a later refusal still reports.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Worktree from `origin/main` at `2b5c4dea`; `npm run build` and `npm run typecheck` pass; focused vitest from `packages/web-shell`. No live Managed deployment was run (no JDK on this machine).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the title is derived from the first prompt exactly as the existing unbound path does; the server drops a title that is blank after Unicode folding instead of rejecting it, so no new 400 path. The file-access change only silences the mount probe; a later refusal and every other probe failure still surface.
- Not validated / out of scope: the real Java stack and screenshots; the error-channel split, `request_id` plumbing and per-source retry from #14918; lifecycle row actions (rename/archive/delete); moving the Workspace binding into a header chip/popover. The mount probe still cannot distinguish the broker's old-CLI refusal from the storage-kind refusal, because both use one code — that distinction belongs to the localization follow-up. The broader pass also left three advisory P3s (summary aria-label for the compact row, an empty details body for a non-interactive Session without cwdChange, and a stale pending-create replay across a title-digest change); those are follow-ups, not blockers.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14918. This does not close it: request-id plumbing, the shared `error` sink split, and the header chip remain.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

对 Web Shell 中的托管会话做三处与标准界面对齐的修正，方向来自两份设计文档——托管会话复用普通 shell，而不是再长出一套管理界面：

1. **绑定工作区的创建现在会带上由首条 prompt 推导的标题。** 非绑定的创建路径本来就会推导标题；绑定路径漏传了 `title`，所以所有绑定会话在列表和头部都显示 UUID 前缀（例如 `1e23d1a2`）。现在绑定路径发送同样的、有长度上限且去除控制字符的标题。
2. **无法提供工作区文件引用的部署，不再在输入框上方常驻一条告警。** 挂载时探测得到的 409 `workspace_files_unsupported` 是能力缺失，不是瞬时失败：输入框本来就没有文件引用入口。hook 不再保存 broker 的英文消息并渲染成常驻的 `role="alert"`；其他探测失败仍会显示。
3. **压缩绑定工作区那一行。** 在 home 布局里，64 位工作区 id 和相对目录各出现了两次。现在摘要行只保留 id（就地截断，完整值放在 `title` 属性里）、相对目录、模型和运行状态；展开后只保留切换目录，以及适用时的“不可执行”提示。独立的嵌入式布局仍保留两行带标签的信息。

## 为什么需要

#14918 follow-up 里的截图显示：一个已经完成的绑定会话，仍然不像标准 shell——标题是 UUID，同一个不透明的工作区 id 打印两遍，输入框上方还挂着一条没有可操作项的英文能力错误。自从 home 集成后 shell 已经是共用的，所以这些是数据与呈现的遗留，不是部署差异。先修这三处低风险项，也让剩下的缺口（错误通道拆分、request id、会话行操作、头部 chip）更容易单独评审。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在输入框用一条 prompt 创建一个绑定工作区的托管会话，刷新。期望：侧栏行和会话头部显示由 prompt 推导的标题；修改前显示 Session ID 的前八个字符。
2. 在一个 runtime 或存储拒绝工作区文件引用的部署上，打开一个绑定会话。期望：输入框没有文件引用入口，上方也没有常驻消息；修改前会显示 `Workspace file access requires an updated CLI.`。busy/unavailable 等其他探测失败仍会报出自己的消息，两侧都有 hook 测试钉住。
3. 在 home 布局打开一个绑定会话。期望：摘要只有一行——截断的工作区 id（悬停可见完整值）、相对目录、模型和运行状态；展开后是切换目录，以及适用时的“不可执行”提示。修改前，绑定信息和目录各重复了一次。独立的 `ManagedAgentWebShell` 入口没有 summary 元素，因此保留原来的两行。

### 证据（Before & After）

浏览器截图 N/A——当前 checkout 没有 JDK 21，真实 Java 栈跑不起来。改动的 DOM 与创建请求体由聚焦的单测钉住：

```console
$ cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run \
    client/components/managed/java-managed-agent-provider.test.ts \
    client/components/managed/use-managed-file-references.test.tsx \
    client/components/managed/ManagedSessionsPage.test.tsx
 ✓ java-managed-agent-provider.test.ts (85 tests)
 ✓ use-managed-file-references.test.tsx (14 tests)
 ✓ ManagedSessionsPage.test.tsx (107 tests)
 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  206 passed (206)
```

`c40e7658` 补上了评审要求的两条回归测试：home 布局不得渲染带标签的两行，且 summary 的 `title` 必须带完整 id；standalone 布局必须保留那两行。两条都验证过：回退对应的源码改动会让它们失败。`1ec37d68` 把文件引用抑制收窄到挂载探测，并新增一条测试证明后续读取失败仍会报出。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

基于 `origin/main` `2b5c4dea` 的 worktree；`npm run build` 与 `npm run typecheck` 通过；在 `packages/web-shell` 跑聚焦 vitest。没有运行真实托管部署（本机没有 JDK）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：标题与非绑定路径一样由首条 prompt 推导；服务端对 Unicode 折叠后为空的标题是丢弃而不是拒绝，因此不会新增 400。文件引用改动只按一个错误码抑制展示，其他探测失败不变。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：真实 Java 栈与截图；#14918 里的错误通道拆分、`request_id` 透传与按来源重试；会话行操作（重命名/归档/删除）；把工作区绑定移进头部 chip/popover。由于 broker 的旧 CLI 拒绝与存储类型拒绝共用一个 code，本次抑制无法区分二者——那属于后续本地化改动。

Refs #14918。本 PR 不关闭它：request id 透传、共享 `error` 汇聚点拆分和头部 chip 仍在后续。

prs.title: feat(serve): batch workspace session live-state snapshots
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds one read-only request for complete live-session snapshots from 1–20 explicitly selected registered workspaces. Each workspace keeps its own canonical identity, catalog version, and independent success or error result. The new request shares the existing single-workspace snapshot and catalog-cache reconciliation logic. A distinct capability and TypeScript SDK method let clients opt in with cancellation and timeout support.

## Why it's needed

Clients showing several workspaces currently make one live-state HTTP request per workspace on every refresh. The recently added batch session catalog can read persisted history, so it is not a suitable high-frequency execution-state endpoint. This API lets clients fetch the same authoritative in-memory state in one request, while preserving the existing single-workspace route and per-session SSE.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Start a local daemon with a primary workspace, register a trusted secondary workspace, then send one batch request containing both IDs and an unknown selector. Expect two full snapshots and one explicit `workspace_not_found` member in input order, with `Cache-Control: no-store`. Confirm malformed bodies fail with HTTP 400, an untrusted or transitioning workspace fails only its own member, and the capability is advertised. Change a live session between running, waiting, and idle without advancing its catalog version; every batch snapshot should still reflect the current state. Confirm the SDK makes one authenticated native REST request and preserves abort and timeout behavior. Older daemons should continue to use the single-workspace route after callers preflight capabilities.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (HTTP and SDK change; no TUI change). The local daemon returned two workspace snapshots and one explicit unknown-workspace error in a single POST.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ Build, typecheck, bundle, focused tests, and local HTTP E2E passed; the large server test file showed unrelated intermittent failures |
| 🪟 Windows | Not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ `dev` x86_64: frozen install/build/bundle, typecheck, focused tests, and daemon HTTP E2E passed |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.1 on macOS arm64 and `dev` Linux x86_64, each with an isolated daemon on a dynamically assigned loopback port. The global `qwen` binary was unavailable for the pre-change CLI dry-run; the absence of this route was confirmed in the current base source.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: A batch is not atomic across workspaces. Each successful member is capped at 512 KiB and an oversized member gets an explicit error.
- Not validated / out of scope: Web Shell still polls workspaces separately until a client migration adopts the new capability; no model-driven live session was created in the HTTP E2E. Windows was not tested locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. Clients preflight `workspace_session_live_state_batch` and retain the existing single-workspace path for older daemons.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/batch-workspace-live-state/docs/design/daemon-batch-session-live-state.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/batch-workspace-live-state/docs/design/daemon-batch-session-live-state.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Closes #12511

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

新增一个只读请求，一次获取 1–20 个显式选定、已注册 workspace 的完整会话运行状态快照。每个 workspace 独立返回规范化身份、目录版本及成功或错误结果。新请求与单 workspace 接口共用快照生成和目录缓存校准逻辑。独立 capability 和 TypeScript SDK 方法支持客户端按能力接入，并支持取消与超时。

## 为什么需要

同时展示多个 workspace 的客户端目前每次刷新都要逐 workspace 发起运行状态 HTTP 请求。近期增加的批量会话目录可能读取持久历史，不适合高频查询执行状态。新接口让客户端通过一次请求获取同样的权威内存状态，保留原单 workspace 路由和逐会话 SSE。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

### 前后证据

不适用（HTTP 与 SDK 改动，无 TUI 变化）。本地 daemon 实测一次 POST 返回两个 workspace 快照及一个未知 workspace 的明确错误。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 构建、类型检查、打包、聚焦测试和本地 HTTP E2E 通过；大型 server 测试文件出现无关的间歇性失败 |
| 🪟 Windows | 本地未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ `dev` x86_64：锁文件安装/构建/打包、类型检查、聚焦测试与 daemon HTTP E2E 均通过 |

### 环境

在 macOS arm64 和 `dev` Linux x86_64 上使用 Node 22.23.1，各自启动使用动态 loopback 端口的隔离 daemon。全局 `qwen` 命令不可用，无法进行改动前 CLI dry-run；已从当前基线源码确认该路由不存在。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：批量结果不保证跨 workspace 原子性；每个成功成员上限为 512 KiB，超限会返回明确错误。
- 未验证或范围外：Web Shell 在后续客户端迁移前仍逐 workspace 轮询；HTTP E2E 未创建由模型驱动的运行会话；未在本地运行 Windows 测试。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无。客户端预检 `workspace_session_live_state_batch`，旧 daemon 保留现有单 workspace 路径。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/batch-workspace-live-state/docs/design/daemon-batch-session-live-state.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/batch-workspace-live-state/docs/design/daemon-batch-session-live-state.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

Closes #12511

prs.title: fix(core): preserve Linux shell group ownership during cancellation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Preserve ordinary Linux Shell cancellation ownership after leader exit and settle after the owned-group cleanup attempt. Child-process and PTY execution share 200 ms TERM grace and post-KILL confirmation timer budgets, with at-most-once KILL escalation. Natural completion and background promotion are preserved. PTY cancellation retains native exit evidence arriving within its existing 200 ms output-drain timer budget; missing evidence remains null at that deadline.

Separate signaling authority from cleanup confirmation: a freshly matching recorded boot/start, group and session identity can authorize TERM/KILL despite incomplete visibility, while incomplete enumeration cannot confirm success. Without a readable unchanged recorded witness, signaling is refused; known non-proc sources also refuse signals. Both TUI processors preserve cancellation status, the cancellation marker, cleanup diagnostics and partial output in display and user-shell LLM-history text, retaining any known result status alongside a diagnostic. The PTY output-drain budget is independent of TERM grace; both remain 200 ms at current defaults.

## Why it's needed

A TERM-responsive leader can exit while a TERM-ignoring descendant remains in its group. Previously, leader exit suppressed escalation and removed ownership. A subsequent visibility guard also suppressed signals to authenticated groups; cleanup diagnostics then took precedence over cancellation in both TUI processors. Later, diagnostic branches still omitted the cancellation marker and known result status, and confirmed PTY cleanup could settle before deferred native exit status arrived.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Cancel a freshly owned Linux group containing a TERM-responsive leader and a TERM-ignoring descendant. The descendant should stop after one group KILL and the result should settle afterward. No-survivor groups need no KILL; repeated cleanup must not dispatch another destructive signal. Natural completion and promotion must preserve transferred descendants.

With restricted mount metadata modeled over real owned processes, cancellation should send one TERM and one KILL; synchronous cleanup should send one KILL. Visibility uncertainty must remain a diagnostic unless termination is otherwise confirmed. Loss of all readable unchanged recorded witnesses and explicit non-proc sources, including ambiguous proc/tmpfs mounts, must refuse destructive signals. ESRCH is terminal; permission errors do not prove termination.

Feed aborted results containing cleanup diagnostics through the actual TUI processors. Ink's final display model must be Canceled with the marker/diagnostic/output, including actual LLM-history text; OpenTUI must produce the canceled renderer status. Non-aborted errors remain Error. Known signal or exit-code text must remain alongside diagnostics, including zero exit without hiding cleanup failure. Abort handling and UI busy/queue lifecycle are unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Current verification (2026-10-21, `5eae9188`): full build, sequential repository-wide typecheck, bundle and the normal hook's staged-file ESLint/Prettier passed using retained dependencies. All 1,283 tests across nine affected suites passed (1,224 core, including 18 real owned-process cases and one modeled supervisor case; 59 actual TUI processor cases). Five independent mocked adapter controls preserved the sandbox error veto. Serialized negative controls restored the old display behavior (eight failing status cases) and re-coupled the PTY drain budget (one failing boundary case); all originals were restored byte for byte before final aggregate checks. Normal hooks preserved the tested tree, and independent review found no further correctness issue.

Before: main `69d060e2` returned on both real transports within 5–8 ms while descendants remained running beyond 400 ms and two cleanup calls. At `96c1442`, real owned fixtures with mocked restrictive metadata recorded zero TERM on cancel, and synchronous cleanup did not settle within the 2.5-second fixture timeout. Actual Ink/OpenTUI processor tests classified aborted results with diagnostics as Error.

After: all 18 real-process cases passed on both transports. Authenticated restricted-metadata cancellation sent exactly one TERM/KILL pair; synchronous cleanup sent one KILL. In the authenticated cleanup cases, actors stopped before settlement, visibility uncertainty remained visible, and missing/recycled-authority controls sent no destructive signals. Dedicated subreapers verified fixture reaping. Restrictions were mocked; this is not real hidepid mount validation.

Historical verification at `da819b8` (2026-10-05): 1,008 tests across 14 affected suites—793 core tests (including 201 service, 79 identity/race/visibility, 18 real-process cases and one modeled supervisor-verdict case) and 215 CLI tests (51 actual processor cases plus 164 existing Ink renderer cases). The Ink processor regression checks its final display model; renderer suites separately verify downstream rendering. OpenTUI checks actual event folding and renderer-status logic. Aggregate build, bundle, repository-wide typecheck, scoped lint/format and the normal pre-commit hook passed; the hook preserved the tested tree. Independent review found no remaining must-fix correctness defect within the documented identity-source assumptions.

At `08eba9a`, both processors omitted the cancellation marker from display/history when a diagnostic coexisted; selected tests failed on those exact strings. With a real owned PTY and modeled 100 ms callback delivery, the saved service observed native exit 17/0 but settled with null/null. The correction retained 17/null and final output before the existing drain deadline. The callback delay is synthetic, not measured natural backend latency. Twenty-two serialized deterministic mutations each failed the intended regression; every source/test original was restored byte for byte before final checks. Identity parser cases represent malformed inputs; same-PGID/foreign-session tables are not kernel-reachable states. Production boot-ID caching is unchanged.

Full preflight, model/CLI E2E, real hidepid and non-Linux runtime validation were not run. [Current-head CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39520812667) completed successfully on `5eae9188`: 5 jobs succeeded, including [web-shell E2E Smoke](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39520812667/job/118988140924), and 3 were skipped (CLI integration, Windows and macOS). At `8b67477f`, [hosted CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39429508539) passed lint/static, Ubuntu tests and no-AK integration, but browser smoke failed: 340 passed and one menu-hover case failed at the same assertion in all three attempts. The unchanged targeted case also failed once at that assertion on both `8b67477f` and main `623cb40c`, in isolated worktrees using real system Chromium 151, mocked daemon data and one worker. Matching source/dependency provenance was verified; static review found no path to the modified cleanup code. This establishes a main baseline reproduction in this local configuration. CI uses a different browser revision, and one local execution per commit does not identify the CI trigger or establish flake frequency. The event that closes the menu remains unconfirmed. That CI run is not green; the browser case was not rerun for this follow-up.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ runtime not tested; existing mocked cases passed |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Cloud Linux, Node 22.23.3, Corepack 0.34.6, pnpm 11.24.0. Isolated owned fixtures have six-second lifetime bounds, identity-guarded teardown and a dedicated Python subreaper. No model/provider calls.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: signaling assumes trusted kernel procfs in the caller's PID namespace. Enumeration and identity-check-to-signal remain non-atomic. Confirmation requires an ordinary unfiltered view; known restrictive modes and read failures prevent enumeration-based confirmation, not otherwise authenticated signals. The guard cannot certify unknown filters, PID submounts, namespace mismatches or concurrent mount changes; these remain unsupported and can silently omit live members. There is no universal fail-closed guarantee for restrictive `/proc`. [Linux visibility semantics](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man5/proc.5.html).
- Timer budgets are not hard wall-clock maxima: synchronous scans, scheduling and output draining can overrun them. Scan cost was not benchmarked. Timers remain referenced to retain pending settlement. Shared boot-id reading is reused; existing liveness helpers do not supply the strict single-read group/session identity required here. Parser consolidation and existing protocol/timeout diagnostic projection are deferred. Agent-tool operational failure text can still omit status/output; the user-shell history correction does not expand that contract.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS and other POSIX descendant cleanup remain unresolved; Windows behavior is unchanged. Descendants escaping their group/session and Managed runtime cleanup are outside this repair.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no configuration or public signature changes. Incomplete cleanup uses the existing error result independently of aborted status. Maintainer scope feedback on #13441 remains pending; no maintainer approval is claimed.

Design: [English](https://github.com/GoldArowana/qwen-code/blob/5eae918880771d6385599f95cd47475823ec3fa3/docs/design/posix-shell-cancellation.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/GoldArowana/qwen-code/blob/5eae918880771d6385599f95cd47475823ec3fa3/docs/design/posix-shell-cancellation.zh-CN.md).

AI disclosure: implementation, tests and review were assisted by OpenAI Codex.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13441. This Linux-only change does not close the broader POSIX issue.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 本 PR 的改动

普通 Linux Shell 取消时，在组长退出后继续保留所有权，并在自有进程组清理尝试后结算结果。child-process 和 PTY 共用 200 ms TERM 宽限期和 KILL 后确认的 timer 预算，KILL 最多升级一次。保留自然完成和后台提升。PTY 取消在既有 200 ms 输出排空 timer 预算内保留到达的原生退出信息；时限内未收到信息时相应字段仍为 null。

将发信号权限与清理确认分开：重新读取并匹配已记录的 boot/start、进程组及会话身份后，即使可见性不完整也可授权 TERM/KILL；不完整枚举不能确认成功。没有可读且未改变的已记录见证身份时拒绝信号；已知非 proc 来源也会拒绝信号。两种 TUI 处理器在显示和用户 shell 的 LLM history 文本中保留取消状态、取消标记、清理诊断及部分输出；诊断共存时也保留已知结果状态。PTY 输出排空预算独立于 TERM 宽限期；当前默认值均为 200 ms。

### 改动原因

响应 TERM 的组长可能退出，而忽略 TERM 的后代仍留在进程组中。此前组长退出会阻止升级并移除所有权。后续可见性保护也会阻止对已认证组发信号；两种 TUI 处理器随后又将清理诊断优先归类为错误而非取消。之后诊断分支仍遗漏取消标记及已知结果状态，且 PTY 清理确认可能早于延迟的原生退出状态，导致过早结算。

### 审查者测试计划

取消一个本次创建并拥有的 Linux 进程组，其中组长响应 TERM、后代忽略 TERM。后代应在一次组 KILL 后停止，随后结果才结算。没有存活成员时不需要 KILL；重复清理不得再次发出破坏性信号。自然完成和后台提升必须保留已转移的后代。

在真实自有进程上模拟受限挂载元数据：取消应发送一次 TERM/KILL；同步清理应发送一次 KILL。除非另有终止确认，可见性不确定必须保留为诊断。所有可读且未改变的已记录见证身份均丢失，以及明确的非 proc 来源（含有歧义的 proc/tmpfs 挂载）必须拒绝破坏性信号。ESRCH 永久结束清理；权限错误不证明终止。

将带有清理诊断的 aborted 结果传入实际 TUI 处理器。Ink 最终展示模型必须为 Canceled，并保留取消标记、诊断和输出，包括实际 LLM history 文本；OpenTUI 必须产生取消的 renderer 状态。未取消的错误仍为 Error。已知信号或退出码文本应与诊断共存，退出码为零也不能隐藏清理失败。abort 处理及 UI busy/queue 生命周期不变。

### 修改前后证据

本轮验证（2026-10-21，`5eae9188`）：复用既有依赖，完整 build、顺序执行的全仓 typecheck、bundle 及正常 hook 的暂存文件 ESLint/Prettier 均通过。9 个受影响测试集共 1,283 个用例通过（1,224 个 core，含 18 个真实自有进程及 1 个模拟 supervisor 判定用例；59 个实际 TUI 处理器用例）。另有 5 个独立 mock adapter 对照验证 sandbox 的 error 否决逻辑。串行反向对照恢复旧显示行为后，8 个状态用例失败；重新耦合 PTY 排空预算后，1 个边界用例失败。最终聚合检查前逐字节恢复全部原件。正常 hooks 保持已测试 tree 不变，独立审查无新增正确性发现。

修改前：main `69d060e2` 在两种真实传输上于 5–8 ms 内返回，但后代在超过 400 ms 和两次清理后仍运行。在 `96c1442`，模拟受限元数据的真实自有 fixture 在取消时记录到零次 TERM；同步清理在 fixture 的 2.5 秒超时内未结算。实际 Ink/OpenTUI 处理器测试将带诊断的 aborted 结果归为 Error。

修改后：两种传输的全部 18 个真实进程用例通过。已认证组在受限元数据下取消时恰好发送一次 TERM/KILL，同步清理发送一次 KILL。在已认证的清理用例中，进程在结算前停止，可见性不确定仍保留诊断；身份缺失或被复用的对照不发破坏性信号。专用 subreaper 验证 fixture 已回收。限制使用 mock；不是真实 hidepid 挂载验证。

历史验证（2026-10-05，`da819b8`）：14 个受影响测试集共 1,008 个用例——793 个 core 用例（含 201 个 service、79 个身份/竞态/可见性、18 个真实进程及 1 个模拟 supervisor 判定用例）和 215 个 CLI 用例（51 个实际处理器及 164 个既有 Ink renderer 用例）。Ink 处理器回归检查最终展示模型；renderer 测试集独立验证下游渲染。OpenTUI 检查实际事件折叠及 renderer 状态逻辑。聚合 build、bundle、全仓 typecheck、定向 lint/格式检查及正常 pre-commit hook 通过；hook 未改变已测试的 tree。独立审查在已披露的身份来源假设内未发现剩余必修正确性缺陷。

在 `08eba9a`，两种处理器在诊断共存时都从显示/history 中遗漏取消标记；定向测试对这些精确文本失败。对真实自有 PTY 模拟 100 ms callback 传递延迟时，保存的 service 已观测到原生退出 17/0，却以 null/null 结算。修正后在既有排空时限内保留 17/null 和最后输出。callback 延迟是模拟的，不是测得的自然后端延迟。22 个串行确定性 mutation 均使对应回归失败；最终检查前逐字节恢复了全部源码/测试原件。身份 parser 用例表示无效输入；同 PGID、不同 session 的表并非内核可产生状态。生产 boot-ID 缓存行为不变。

未运行完整 preflight、模型/CLI E2E、真实 hidepid 或非 Linux 实机验证。[当前 head 的 CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39520812667) 在 `5eae9188` 上已完成并成功：5 个 job 成功，包括 [web-shell E2E Smoke](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39520812667/job/118988140924)；3 个跳过（CLI integration、Windows、macOS）。在 `8b67477f`，[托管 CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39429508539) 的 lint/static、Ubuntu tests 和 no-AK integration 已通过，但浏览器 smoke 失败：340 个通过，1 个菜单 hover 用例在三次尝试中均停在同一断言。该原样定向用例也分别在 `8b67477f` 和 main `623cb40c` 上各失败一次，断言相同；两者采用独立 worktree、真实系统 Chromium 151、模拟 daemon 数据和单 worker。源码及依赖来源同一性已核验，静态审查未找到通向本次修改的清理代码的路径。这确认了该本地配置下的 main 基线复现。CI 的浏览器版本不同，每个提交一次本地运行也不足以确定 CI 的触发原因或 flake 频率。导致菜单关闭的具体事件仍未确认。该轮 CI 尚未全绿；本次跟进未重跑浏览器用例。

### 已测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试真实运行时；既有 mock 用例通过 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境

云端 Linux，Node 22.23.3、Corepack 0.34.6、pnpm 11.24.0。隔离的自有 fixture 具有六秒生存上限、身份检查的回收逻辑及专用 Python subreaper。未调用模型/provider。

### 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：发信号要求 procfs 是可信内核视图，且属于调用者 PID 命名空间。枚举及身份检查到发信号仍非原子。确认要求普通未过滤视图；已知受限模式及读取失败会阻止通过枚举确认，而非阻止已另行认证的信号。保护不能认证未知过滤、PID 子挂载、命名空间不匹配或并发挂载变化；这些配置仍不受支持，可能静默省略运行成员。不能保证受限 `/proc` 总会保守拒绝。[Linux 可见性语义](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man5/proc.5.html)。
- timer 预算不是严格实际耗时上限：同步扫描、调度和输出排空可能超时。未进行扫描性能基准测试。timer 保持引用以保留待完成的结算。已复用共享 boot-id 读取；既有存活 helper 不提供此处所需的单次读取的严格组/会话身份。parser 合并及既有协议/timeout 诊断投影另行处理。agent-tool 的操作失败文本仍可能遗漏状态／输出；用户 shell 的 history 修正不扩展该契约。
- 未验证或范围外：macOS 和其他 POSIX 后代清理仍未解决；Windows 行为不变。逃离进程组/会话的后代及 Managed runtime 清理不在本次修复范围内。
- 兼容性或迁移：无配置或公开签名变更。清理不完整使用既有 error 结果，与 aborted 状态独立。#13441 的维护者范围反馈仍待回复；不声称已有维护者批准。

设计：[English](https://github.com/GoldArowana/qwen-code/blob/5eae918880771d6385599f95cd47475823ec3fa3/docs/design/posix-shell-cancellation.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/GoldArowana/qwen-code/blob/5eae918880771d6385599f95cd47475823ec3fa3/docs/design/posix-shell-cancellation.zh-CN.md)。

AI 披露：实现、测试和审查得到 OpenAI Codex 辅助。

### 关联 issue

Refs #13441。此 Linux-only 变更不关闭更广的 POSIX issue。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): make the always-on context warning accurate for CJK and actionable
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The startup warning for always-loaded context now estimates its size with the same CJK-aware heuristic that `/context` and the usage snapshot already use, and it reports the token split between context files, the auto-memory policy, and the MEMORY.md catalog instead of one unattributed total. The advice now names both levers — trimming context files and pruning stale memories — instead of pointing only at QWEN.md/AGENTS.md.

## Why it's needed

Fixes findings 1 and 2 of #14976. The warning was the last context-reporting path still on a flat char/4 divisor, so CJK-heavy context files were undercounted while `/context` reported a larger number for the same bytes — the two disagreed on the same content. Its estimate also lumped three contributors into one figure and advised trimming "long always-loaded context", which reads as QWEN.md/AGENTS.md; in legacy recall mode the MEMORY.md catalog is the largest contributor and the one editing those files cannot move.

For the reporter's sample (24,689 chars, 2,513 CJK), the old formula reported 6,173 and the in-tree estimator reports about 9,314; the split then shows which part to act on. The thresholds and the 10,000-token ceiling are deliberately unchanged — finding 3 is out of scope.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In a workspace with a CJK-heavy AGENTS.md/QWEN.md and a large MEMORY.md index, start a session: the warning should report three contributor figures, not one.
2. Check the reported total against `/context detail` for the same content; both now use the CJK-aware estimator, so they should agree instead of differing by the old char/4 shortfall.
3. Check that the catalog is named as the largest contributor when it dominates, and that the advice mentions pruning memories as a lever.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Same content in both runs: 40,000 chars of context files (10,000 of them CJK), 4,000 chars of auto-memory policy, 120,000 chars of MEMORY.md catalog, on a 1,000,000-token window.

Before:

```
Warning: Loaded always-on context (QWEN.md context files + auto-memory) uses about 41,001 tokens, more than 10,000 tokens — the smaller of that and 15% of this model's 1,000,000 token context window. Consider trimming long always-loaded context or moving details into on-demand files.
```

After:

```
Warning: Loaded always-on context (QWEN.md context files + auto-memory) uses about 53,500 tokens, more than 10,000 tokens — the smaller of that and 15% of this model's 1,000,000 token context window. Of those, there are 22,500 tokens of context files, 1,000 tokens of auto-memory policy, and 30,000 tokens of auto-memory catalog. Consider trimming context files or pruning stale memories, or moving details into on-demand files.
```

The old estimate under-reports by 12,499 tokens because CJK characters were charged 0.25 token each instead of 1.5, and it leaves the catalog — here the largest contributor at 30,000 — unnamed.

### Tested on

|     OS     |           Status            |
| :--------: | :-------------------------: |
|  🍏 macOS  |    ⚠️ not tested locally    |
| 🪟 Windows |             ✅              |
|  🐧 Linux  |    ⚠️ not tested locally    |

Unit tests in `packages/core`: 941 passed, 1 failed. The failure is a pre-existing Windows-only path-separator assertion (forward-slash MEMORY.md paths compared with `path.join`) that fails on clean `main` as well; it is unrelated to this change and does not touch the warning code.

### Environment (optional)

No global CLI or TUI session was available here, so the rendered before/after messages above were produced by constructing the configuration directly and reading its warning output; behavior is covered end-to-end at that level by the regression tests.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: CJK-heavy sessions now see a larger estimate, so the warning can fire earlier. That is the intended correction; the 10,000-token bound and the percentage are unchanged, and ASCII-heavy content estimates are unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: finding 3 (raising or suppressing the bound) is untouched; no interactive TUI run.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: only the warning text changes; no API, setting, or threshold changes.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14976

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

常驻上下文的启动告警现在改用 `/context` 和用量快照已在使用的 CJK 感知估算方式，并分别报告上下文文件、auto-memory 策略与 MEMORY.md catalog 三部分的 token 数，而不是一个无法归因的合计值。建议措辞也同时点明两个可操作的方向——裁剪上下文文件与清理过期记忆——而不再只提 QWEN.md/AGENTS.md。

## 为什么需要

修复 #14976 的第 1、2 条。该告警是最后一个仍使用固定 char/4 除数的上下文上报路径，因此 CJK 较多的上下文文件会被低估，而 `/context` 对同一份内容给出更大的数字，两者不一致。它的估算还把三部分来源合并成一个数字，并建议裁剪“常驻上下文”，读起来指向 QWEN.md/AGENTS.md；但在 legacy recall 模式下，MEMORY.md catalog 往往是最大来源，而编辑这些文件并不能减少它。

以报告者的样本为例（24,689 字符，其中 2,513 个 CJK）：旧公式为 6,173，仓库内的估算方式约为 9,314；新的分项数字则能指出究竟该处理哪一部分。阈值与 10,000 token 上限有意保持不变——第 3 条不在本 PR 范围内。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在一个 AGENTS.md/QWEN.md 含大量 CJK、且 MEMORY.md 索引很大的工作区启动会话：告警应给出三个来源的数字，而不是一个。
2. 将告警给出的总数与同一内容的 `/context detail` 对比；两者现在都用 CJK 感知估算，应当一致，而不再相差旧 char/4 的低估量。
3. 当 catalog 占主导时，告警应点名 catalog 为最大来源，并且建议中应提到清理记忆这一手段。

### 证据（修改前与修改后）

两次运行使用相同内容：40,000 字符的上下文文件（其中 10,000 个 CJK 字符）、4,000 字符的 auto-memory 策略、120,000 字符的 MEMORY.md catalog，窗口为 1,000,000 token。

修改前：

```
Warning: Loaded always-on context (QWEN.md context files + auto-memory) uses about 41,001 tokens, more than 10,000 tokens — the smaller of that and 15% of this model's 1,000,000 token context window. Consider trimming long always-loaded context or moving details into on-demand files.
```

修改后：

```
Warning: Loaded always-on context (QWEN.md context files + auto-memory) uses about 53,500 tokens, more than 10,000 tokens — the smaller of that and 15% of this model's 1,000,000 token context window. Of those, there are 22,500 tokens of context files, 1,000 tokens of auto-memory policy, and 30,000 tokens of auto-memory catalog. Consider trimming context files or pruning stale memories, or moving details into on-demand files.
```

旧估算少报了 12,499 token，因为 CJK 字符每个只按 0.25 token 计，而不是 1.5；同时它没有点名 catalog——本例中 catalog 正是最大的来源（30,000）。

### 测试平台

|     OS     |           状态            |
| :--------: | :-----------------------: |
|  🍏 macOS  |      ⚠️ 本地未测试        |
| 🪟 Windows |             ✅             |
|  🐧 Linux  |      ⚠️ 本地未测试        |

`packages/core` 单元测试：941 通过、1 失败。失败项是一个既有的、仅 Windows 出现的路径分隔符断言（正斜杠的 MEMORY.md 路径与 `path.join` 的结果比较），在干净的 `main` 上同样失败，与本次改动无关，也不涉及告警代码。

### 环境（可选）

此环境没有全局 CLI，也没有交互式 TUI，因此上面的修改前后文本是直接构造配置并读取告警输出得到的；该行为已由回归测试在这一层覆盖。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：CJK 较多的会话现在会看到更大的估算值，告警可能更早触发。这是预期的修正；10,000 token 上限和百分比均未改动，ASCII 为主的内容估算也不变。
- 未验证 / 范围外：第 3 条（调高或关闭阈值）未改动；未做交互式 TUI 运行。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：仅告警文案变化；没有 API、设置或阈值变更。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #14976

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): keep review's gh reads machine-readable under forced colour
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes every `gh` child process the review command spawns immune to an operator's forced-colour settings, so its JSON, NDJSON and diff reads keep receiving machine-readable bytes. One env rule at the single spawn site replaces what would otherwise be a strip pass at each parse site.

## Why it's needed

Every `gh` read under `packages/cli/src/commands/review` treats the output as data: `JSON.parse` in the API helpers, one JSON value per line in the paginated nested read, and byte-exact text for PR diffs. When the operator's environment exports `CLICOLOR_FORCE=1` (or `GH_FORCE_TTY=1`), `gh` colourises and pretty-prints even though its stdout is a pipe, and those reads break: the API helpers throw a `SyntaxError`, the per-line NDJSON decode meets a bare `{` on a line of its own, and the diff path stores escape bytes as content.

This is the still-open item in #10241 ("gh JSON output is still not ANSI-stripped"), whose earlier fix PR #10249 was closed unmerged by its own author. That PR stripped escapes at the three parse sites. Measured against a real `gh`, stripping cannot work there, because forcing colour also changes the framing:

```
CLICOLOR_FORCE=1 GH_FORCE_TTY=1 gh api '…/commits?per_page=2' --jq '.[] | {sha: .sha[0:4]}'
  "\x1b[1;38m{\x1b[m\n  \x1b[1;34m\"sha\"\x1b[m\x1b[1;38m:\x1b[m \x1b[32m\"a49f\"\x1b[m\n\x1b[1;38m}\x1b[m\n…"
  per-line JSON.parse -> SyntaxError   (one value now spans three lines)

same call with the env this PR hands the child
  '{"sha":"a49f"}\n{"sha":"72ed"}\n'
  per-line JSON.parse -> ok
```

So the neutralising has to happen before `gh` formats its output, not after. Two further measurements fixed the exact shape of the fix: `NO_COLOR=1` does not win over an exported `CLICOLOR_FORCE=1` (escapes still present), and `GH_FORCE_TTY=0` still colourises, because `gh` reads any non-empty value as "pretend a TTY". Hence pinning one key to `'0'` and deleting the other.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/commands/review/lib/gh.test.ts` — 27 passed. The two new cells pin the contract: an inherited `CLICOLOR_FORCE=1` reaches the child as `'0'`, and an inherited `GH_FORCE_TTY` is absent from the child env. Restoring the previous one-line `ghEnv()` body turns both red with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'CLICOLOR_FORCE')` — that is the red/green witness this change was written against.
2. End to end with a real `gh` (2.97.0): export `CLICOLOR_FORCE=1 GH_FORCE_TTY=1`, then compare `gh api 'repos/<o>/<r>/commits?per_page=2' --jq '.[] | {sha: .sha[0:4]}'` under the inherited env against the same call with `{ ...process.env, CLICOLOR_FORCE: '0' }` and `GH_FORCE_TTY` deleted. The first is escape-wrapped and pretty-printed across three lines per value; the second is compact NDJSON that parses line by line.
3. Confirm the blast radius is only the child env: `ghEnv()` still inherits `PATH`/`HOME`/the auth vars and still sets `GH_HOST` when a host is configured, and the byte-fidelity diff path is untouched apart from no longer being handed escapes.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible output. The measured before/after is the byte-level comparison quoted above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment

Local unit run plus real `gh api` calls against github.com (gh 2.97.0) on Linux.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: `ghEnv()` now always returns an env object instead of using `undefined` to mean "inherit untouched", so a `gh` child can no longer see an operator's `CLICOLOR_FORCE`/`GH_FORCE_TTY`. That is the intent — no read on this path wants colour — but it is a contract change, so the two cells that pinned `undefined` were rewritten to pin the new contract rather than deleted.
- Not validated / out of scope: the other #10241 items (mutation-coverage cells in the review test suite) are untouched, and `packages/core`'s unrelated `ghEnv(env)` helper is a different function that was not changed.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for users. The TypeScript return type narrowed from `NodeJS.ProcessEnv | undefined` to `NodeJS.ProcessEnv`; all three call sites already passed the value straight to `execFileSync`.

## Linked Issues

Part of #10241 — no closing keyword, because that issue tracks further items this PR does not address.

prs.title: feat(cli): align OpenTUI input, editing and status lines with Ink
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR brings input, ordinary editing and status-line behavior together in OpenTUI. Text and images retain their draft owner through paste, submission, queuing and cancellation; editing, undo/redo and external-editor return preserve the current draft; `/statusline` supports live commands, preset selection, preview and persistence using the existing Ink contract.

It consolidates #14946 (input ownership) and #14966 (editing/cancellation) into #14964 for one code-review and audit cycle. Those source PRs remain open until the combined source and tests are published and validated. U1 #14933 has merged and the combined candidate integrates current main; it must be reviewed against that actual base. Final candidate: `186a71633b1f6e6844c8e397afaa1e719dff7407`; main base: `6e6598e35c3c56aa4d1db67040de18883cc44a8e`. All combined-candidate validation below is **NOT_RUN**.

The frozen integrated diff is **58 files, +7,946/−1,008 = 8,954 changed lines**. Tests and fixtures account for 5,226 lines, production/configuration for 2,797, bilingual documentation for 929 and CI for 2. This is an explicit exception to the usual 2–3k target, following the request to consolidate related UI PRs and avoid repeated reviews of the same interactions. Required recovery tests remain included. These counts are verified against the actual main base; production changes are byte-identical to the reviewed integration. Three product fixtures additionally isolate system/default settings, and the bilingual designs distinguish historical batches from this consolidated delivery.

## Why it's needed

The observed OpenTUI baseline could clear rejected input, attach late images to a successor draft, lose queued image bytes, ignore Ctrl+Q and leave selected attachments undeletable. Ordinary editing and cancellation also differed from Ink: a second Ctrl+C after cancelling a response did not exit, Ctrl+D cancelled a pending approval, and an eligible cancelled prompt did not return to the composer. The status line was a fixed string and `/statusline` could not apply or persist a configuration.

These changes share the same composer, queue, session, footer and terminal lifetime. Keeping their integration in one review makes it possible to test cancellation while status commands run, editor return after modal transitions, and late input across session changes. The implementation reuses the existing queues, native textarea/undo owner, history-acceptance callbacks and status executor. Runtime and renderer defaults, Bun/OpenTUI versions and media conversion policy remain unchanged. The CLI explicitly declares the already-resolved ANSI tokenizer needed for status-line conversion.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Paste two images with controlled delayed completion, submit the original draft, then type a successor. Completion order must not change image arrival order or attach either image to the successor. Reject or throw from admission and verify complete recovery once. Image-only Enter remains a no-op; adding a caption submits exactly once with the expected image bytes for that renderer's existing route.
2. Compare Enter steering and Ctrl+Q deferral during a real tool boundary, then pop queued input back for editing. Text, images and submitted provenance must survive. Select/delete chips with the keyboard; ordinary typing or Ctrl+Q must leave chip selection and process that same key. Explicit post-admission file-read/vision refusal must remain visible without creating an automatic retry loop.
3. Edit multiline CJK, emoji and punctuation using line/word movement, boundary deletion and undo/redo, then insert a marker and verify the exact submitted text. Ctrl+X must return changed external-editor text as one undoable replacement with the caret at the end; unchanged output adds no undo step. Success, nonzero exit and signal must restore the terminal, while late output cannot overwrite a cleared, submitted or switched draft.
4. Cancel a held response with an empty composer, confirm eligible text and queued attachments return after settlement, and keep a newer draft intact. No cancelled queue may resend automatically; explicit resubmission must send the complete successor once. Nonempty Ctrl+D keeps editing; streaming Ctrl+C cancels and arms the second-key exit window; Ctrl+D preserves a pending approval and D/D exits without executing it.
5. Run an owned status command that reads JSON from stdin and emits colored text. Check current session/model/usage, refresh, theme-color policy and the two-line limit. Use `/statusline` to filter, preview, save, cancel and restart; confirm configuration precedence and persistence. Resize narrow/short layouts and verify selectable choices remain reachable and exit hints retain priority.
6. Compare the same deterministic scenarios and bundle under Node+Ink, Bun+Ink and strict Bun+OpenTUI. Renderer fallback is a failure. Inspect visible frames, exact payload/count/MIME/hash, settings, command activity and cleanup rather than relying on process exit alone.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Area | Preserved baseline observation | Combined candidate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Draft/image ownership | Six component/hook failures with two passing controls; real product routes captured separately | NOT_RUN — retain draft ownership, order, complete bytes and exactly-once acceptance |
| Editing/cancellation | Real Ink controls established word/caret behavior, second-C exit, approval D handling and cancelled-input return | NOT_RUN — replay editing and complete cancellation transactions |
| Status lines | Strict OpenTUI never executed the configured command and exposed only a static list | NOT_RUN — command lifecycle, native styles, preset save/cancel/restart |
| Cross-feature interaction | Source branches were accepted separately | NOT_RUN — validate the combined owner/lifetime paths on the final main-based artifact |

Historical evidence remains linked to its original head: [input acceptance at 26960079](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14946#issuecomment-6298045607), [editor acceptance at 8c98b270](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14966#issuecomment-6304143001), [status-line acceptance at 5ce64f00](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14964#issuecomment-6304017625), and [U1/status-line integration at 68ce13e2](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14964#issuecomment-6305825151). Their PASS results and retained first failures are not relabelled as combined-candidate evidence. Independent-only probes are not claimed as committed CI cases.

| Final-head gate | Planned coverage | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Build, typecheck, lint, formatting and fresh bundle | Complete build/type/lint; supported changed-file formatting | NOT_RUN |
| Focused CLI and adjacent regressions | 23 test files, including asynchronous negative paths | NOT_RUN |
| Harness and workflow | 24 renderer/session/viewport cases and 40 local E2E-workflow cases; workflow-size is NOT_RUN locally and assigned to existing Linux full CI | NOT_RUN |
| Native renderer | All nine existing parity scripts | NOT_RUN |
| Real product matrix | Four suites: migration 1 + input 1 + editor 19 + status line 2; 23 per leg, 69 total | NOT_RUN |
| Independent integration audit, final source/artifact guards and exact-head CI/review | Bind final HEAD, base, runtime, fixture and complete dist identity | NOT_RUN |

Local product legs run serially with one worker, zero retries and fatal unhandled errors. The macOS Bash 3.x host does not execute the Bash 4-dependent workflow-size suite; existing Linux full CI includes it through the scripts suite, contingent on reaching that stage. Its actual execution and configured CI retry policy must be reported from the final run. Any expected platform skip in non-product checks must be named separately; it is not a passed case. New source/artifact changes require a new binding and affected validation. Preserve original failures and cleanup errors.

### Tested on

| OS | Combined-candidate status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS arm64 | NOT_RUN — earlier branch acceptance is historical only |
| 🪟 Windows | NOT_RUN — POSIX PTY coverage does not establish Windows acceptance |
| 🐧 Linux | NOT_RUN — prior branch TUI CI does not replace final-head CI |

### Environment

Planned local comparison uses Node 24.19.0, pinned Bun 1.3.14 and OpenTUI 0.5.10, isolated HOME/settings/workspace and a deterministic loopback model. Native clipboard/editor backends are explicitly injected; product external-editor tests launch a real owned process. Truecolor comparisons advertise the capability consistently. Fresh bundle identity and acceptance evidence will be added after validation.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: shared draft/session ownership, asynchronous cancellation, external-editor suspension and status-command lifetime now coexist. Late images/steering, pending or claimed input, reset/unmount, generated turns and tool-start exclusions need their focused negative cases as well as product tests. The shared status executor and editing helpers still serve Ink, so both Ink legs remain required.
- Declared Ink exceptions: reject image-bearing shell input and retain it instead of executing a prefixed image path; retain the whole original paste when any image-path copy fails instead of silently discarding a missing path. Image-only Enter and image-plus-slash retain the observed Ink contract. Ink's image overview and OpenTUI's structured route may encode differently; compare route-specific MIME/length/hash without changing media policy.
- Ownership limits: history acceptance is not HTTP success. Explicit post-admission file/vision refusal still reports and consumes input. Clearing a successor does not revoke an Enter-claimed pending draft. Only eligible current editable input returns after cancellation; that return does not rewind transcript/core/logger history. Observed exit-code differences remain recorded, and harness HUP 129 is cleanup evidence rather than graceful product exit.
- Remaining work: ordinary/shell history, Ctrl+R and Vim belong to the subsequent complete candidate; the status-line Vim value awaits its actual mode owner. Full live-output/transcript behavior, the retained intraword-underscore Markdown discrepancy, slash history eligibility, deletion purge, cancelled-record rollback, other footer/dialog/worktree contracts, OS clipboard/GUI editors, IME, accessibility and unsupported-platform acceptance remain open. OSC8 metadata alone does not prove emitted terminal hyperlinks.
- Migration notes: this PR does not switch defaults, remove Ink, upgrade Bun/OpenTUI or complete npm/standalone runtime distribution. It is one consolidated UI delivery and one review target, not a claim that the full migration is complete.

Designs: input ownership [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/186a71633b1f6e6844c8e397afaa1e719dff7407/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-input-ownership.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/186a71633b1f6e6844c8e397afaa1e719dff7407/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-input-ownership.zh-CN.md); editor/cancellation [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/186a71633b1f6e6844c8e397afaa1e719dff7407/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-editor-transaction.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/186a71633b1f6e6844c8e397afaa1e719dff7407/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-editor-transaction.zh-CN.md); status lines [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/186a71633b1f6e6844c8e397afaa1e719dff7407/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-statusline-parity.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/186a71633b1f6e6844c8e397afaa1e719dff7407/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-statusline-parity.zh-CN.md); delivery plan [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/186a71633b1f6e6844c8e397afaa1e719dff7407/docs/design/2026-10-20-opentui-migration-delivery.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/186a71633b1f6e6844c8e397afaa1e719dff7407/docs/design/2026-10-20-opentui-migration-delivery.zh-CN.md). Each pair retains the same decisions, constraints and acceptance boundaries; historical result paragraphs identify their original batch.

## Linked Issues

Related to #8662 and #12505. Consolidates #14946 and #14966 into this PR; integrates merged U1 #14933 through current main. These references do not auto-close the broader migration or platform-input issues.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

本 PR 将 OpenTUI 的输入、常规编辑和状态栏行为一起交付。文字与图片在粘贴、提交、排队和取消期间保留原草稿归属；编辑、undo/redo 和外部编辑器返回保护当前草稿；`/statusline` 按现有 Ink 合同支持实时命令、预设选择、预览和持久化。

本 PR 将 #14946（输入所有权）与 #14966（编辑/取消）归并到 #14964，进行一次统一代码审查和审计。合并后的源码与测试发布并验证前，原 PR 保持开放。U1 #14933 已合并，统一候选已整合最新 main，须针对该实际基线审阅。最终候选：`186a71633b1f6e6844c8e397afaa1e719dff7407`；main 基线：`6e6598e35c3c56aa4d1db67040de18883cc44a8e`。以下统一候选验证全部为 **NOT_RUN**。

冻结的统一差异实际为 **58 文件、+7,946/−1,008，共 8,954 改动行**：测试及夹具 5,226 行，产品/配置 2,797 行，双语文档 929 行，CI 2 行。这明确超过通常 2–3k 的目标，是遵照将相关 UI PR 收敛、避免重复审查同一交互的最新要求所作的例外；必要恢复测试完整保留。以上计数已针对实际 main 基线核准；产品改动与已审整合版本逐字节相同；三份产品夹具另补系统/defaults 设置隔离，双语设计明确区分历史分批与本次统一交付。

## 为什么需要

已观察的 OpenTUI 基线会清空被拒绝输入、把迟到图片附给后继草稿、丢失排队图片字节、忽略 Ctrl+Q，以及无法删除选中附件。常规编辑和取消也与 Ink 有差异：取消响应后第二下 Ctrl+C 不退出，Ctrl+D 取消了待审批项，符合条件的被取消提示没有返还输入框。状态栏只是固定文字，`/statusline` 无法应用或保存配置。

这些改动共用 composer、队列、会话、footer 和终端生命周期。统一审查能够覆盖状态命令运行期间取消、模态界面切换后的编辑器返回，以及跨会话的迟到输入。实现复用现有队列、唯一原生 textarea/undo 所有者、history 接收确认及状态栏执行器。运行时和 renderer 默认值、Bun/OpenTUI 版本及媒体转换政策保持不变；CLI 显式声明状态栏转换所需、已在依赖树中解析的 ANSI tokenizer。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 控制两张图片延迟完成，提交原草稿后继续输入后继文字。完成先后不能改变图片到达顺序，也不能把图片附给后继草稿。令 admission 拒绝或抛错，确认完整恢复一次。仅图片 Enter 保持 no-op；添加说明后恰好提交一次，并按当前 renderer 既有路径验证图片字节。
2. 在真实工具边界比较 Enter steering 与 Ctrl+Q 延后，再取回排队输入继续编辑。文字、图片和提交来源必须保留。用键盘选择/删除图片；普通输入或 Ctrl+Q 必须退出附件选择并处理当前键。接收后的明确文件读取/vision 拒绝必须可见，且不产生自动重试循环。
3. 对多行 CJK、emoji、标点执行行/词移动、边界删除、undo/redo，插入标记后核对准确提交文字。Ctrl+X 返回的外编变更应成为一次可撤销替换，光标位于末尾；未改文本不增加 undo。成功、非零退出、signal 均恢复终端；迟到结果不能覆盖已清空、已提交或已切换的草稿。
4. 在 held response 中从空 composer 取消，确认符合条件的文字和排队附件在收尾后返还，同时保留新草稿。被取消的队列不得自动重发，显式重发后完整后继输入恰好发送一次。非空 Ctrl+D 继续编辑；响应中 Ctrl+C 取消并打开第二下退出窗口；待审批时 Ctrl+D 保留审批，D/D 退出且不执行命令。
5. 运行一个从 stdin 读取 JSON、输出彩色文字的隔离状态命令。检查当前会话/模型/用量、刷新、主题颜色政策和两行限制。通过 `/statusline` 筛选、预览、保存、取消、重启，确认设置优先级与持久化。缩小终端后，可选项仍可达，退出提示保持优先。
6. 对同一 bundle 和确定性场景比较 Node+Ink、Bun+Ink、strict Bun+OpenTUI；renderer fallback 必须失败。核对可见 frame、准确载荷/次数/MIME/hash、设置、命令活动和清理，不能只依赖进程退出。

### 前后证据

| 范围 | 已保留的基线观察 | 统一候选 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 草稿/图片归属 | 六项组件/hook 失败及两个通过正控；真实产品路径另有记录 | NOT_RUN — 保留归属、顺序、完整字节和恰好一次接收 |
| 编辑/取消 | 真实 Ink 对照确定词/光标、第二下 C 退出、审批 D 处理和被取消输入返还 | NOT_RUN — 重放编辑与完整取消事务 |
| 状态栏 | strict OpenTUI 不执行已配置命令，仅显示静态列表 | NOT_RUN — 命令生命周期、原生样式、预设保存/取消/重启 |
| 跨功能交互 | 原分支分别验收 | NOT_RUN — 在最终 main 基线产物上验证整合后的归属/生命周期 |

历史证据仍绑定各自原 head：[26960079 输入验收](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14946#issuecomment-6298045607)、[8c98b270 编辑验收](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14966#issuecomment-6304143001)、[5ce64f00 状态栏验收](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14964#issuecomment-6304017625)、[68ce13e2 U1/状态栏整合](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14964#issuecomment-6305825151)。原 PASS 和首轮失败不改标为统一候选证据；仅独立脚本的场景不冒充已提交 CI 用例。

| 最终 head 门禁 | 计划覆盖 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Build、typecheck、lint、格式及新 bundle | 完整 build/type/lint；受支持变更文件格式 | NOT_RUN |
| CLI 定向及邻接回归 | 23 份测试文件，含异步负例 | NOT_RUN |
| Harness 与 workflow | 24 项 renderer/session/viewport 和本地 40 项 E2E-workflow；workflow-size 本机 NOT_RUN，交由现有 Linux full CI | NOT_RUN |
| 原生 renderer | 既有九份 parity 脚本全部保留 | NOT_RUN |
| 真实产品矩阵 | 四套：migration 1 + input 1 + editor 19 + status line 2；每腿 23，共 69 | NOT_RUN |
| 独立整合审计、最终源码/产物守卫、精确 head CI/review | 绑定最终 HEAD、基线、运行时、夹具和完整 dist 身份 | NOT_RUN |

本地产品腿串行、单 worker、零重试，unhandled errors 必须失败。macOS Bash 3.x 本机不执行依赖 Bash 4 的 workflow-size 套件；既有 Linux full CI 的 scripts 套件包含它，但必须实际执行到该阶段。最终运行须报告其真实执行情况及 CI 配置的重试政策。非产品检查中的预期平台跳过须逐项说明，不算通过。新的源码/产物变更需重新绑定和验证受影响范围；原始失败及清理错误完整保留。

### 已测平台

| 系统 | 统一候选状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS arm64 | NOT_RUN — 原分支验收仅为历史记录 |
| 🪟 Windows | NOT_RUN — POSIX PTY 覆盖不代表 Windows 验收 |
| 🐧 Linux | NOT_RUN — 原分支 TUI CI 不替代最终 head CI |

### 环境

计划使用 Node 24.19.0、固定 Bun 1.3.14、OpenTUI 0.5.10，隔离 HOME/设置/工作区及确定性 loopback 模型。Native 剪贴板/编辑器 backend 明确注入，产品外编场景启动真实隔离进程；truecolor 比较统一声明终端能力。新的 bundle 身份与验收证据将在验证完成后补充。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：共享草稿/会话归属、异步取消、外编挂起、状态命令生命周期现在共同存在。迟到图片/steering、pending/claimed 输入、reset/unmount、generated turn 和工具已开始的排除仍需要定向负例及产品测试。共享状态执行器和编辑辅助仍供 Ink 使用，因此两条 Ink 腿必须保留。
- 已声明 Ink 例外：带图 shell 输入拒绝并保留，避免执行前缀图片路径；任一图片路径复制失败时保留整段原文，避免静默丢失缺失路径。仅图片 Enter、图片加 slash 保持已观察的 Ink 合同。Ink overview 与 OpenTUI 结构化路径允许不同编码，按各自 MIME/长度/hash 检查，不改变媒体政策。
- 所有权边界：history 接收不等于 HTTP 成功。接收后明确的文件/vision 拒绝仍提示后消费。清空后继输入不撤销 Enter 已占有的 pending 草稿。取消后仅返还符合条件的当前可编辑输入，不回退 transcript/core/logger 记录。保留真实退出码差异；harness HUP129 只是清理证据，不等于产品正常退出。
- 剩余工作：普通/shell 历史、Ctrl+R 与 Vim 留后续完整候选，状态栏 Vim 值等待实际 mode owner。完整 live-output/transcript、已保留的词内下划线 Markdown 差异、slash 历史资格、删除 purge、取消记录回退、其他 footer/dialog/worktree 合同、系统剪贴板/GUI 编辑器、IME、无障碍及未覆盖平台验收仍开放。OSC8 元数据不能单独证明终端实际输出超链接。
- 迁移说明：本 PR 不切换默认值、不移除 Ink、不升级 Bun/OpenTUI，也不完成 npm/standalone 运行时分发。它是一份统一 UI 交付和一个审查目标，不宣称整体迁移完成。

关联 #8662、#12505，将 #14946、#14966 收敛到本 PR，并通过最新 main 整合已合并的 U1 #14933。这些引用不自动关闭整体迁移或平台输入议题。

prs.title: fix(ci): skip the duplicate prepare build in the daemon E2E lane
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Sets `QWEN_SKIP_PREPARE=1` on the daemon E2E lane's dependency-install step, so `corepack pnpm install` no longer runs the repository `prepare` hook's full workspace build and bundle before the lane's own explicit Build and Bundle steps repeat both. It also adds a focused workflow test that pins the skip and the explicit steps that replace it.

## Why it's needed

The tracked main-CI failure died in `Build Qwen Code` on the shared ECS pool, in the heap-exhaustion class documented in #14823: the `packages/cli` TypeScript compile crosses the old 4 GiB V8 ceiling. The ceiling itself was already raised to 6144 MB on main, so this PR closes the other half of that issue that remained unimplemented — the daemon E2E lane compiling the whole workspace twice. The redundant prepare-time build is the compile that first OOM'd in #14823, and on a contended pool it also lengthens the setup that this lane's timeout is sized against. The lane now compiles once per job, with its explicit Build and Bundle steps as the single source of truth.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Inspect the daemon E2E lane in the SDK Java workflow and confirm its `Install Node.js dependencies` step sets `QWEN_SKIP_PREPARE: '1'`, while the following `Build Qwen Code` and `Bundle Qwen Code` steps remain. Run the workflow meta-test suite and confirm the new case passes; removing the env entry from the workflow must make it fail.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CI workflow configuration change, no user-visible output.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Node 22.23.2, npm 10.9.8, pnpm 11.24.0 via corepack.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the lane now relies on its explicit Build and Bundle steps for generated and bundled artifacts; both are already present and are pinned by the new test. No other workflow job is touched.
- Not validated / out of scope: the exact ECS-hosted run could not be reproduced locally, so repository CI remains the final gate. The heap-ceiling raise itself landed earlier on main and is not part of this diff.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14870

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

在 daemon E2E 任务的依赖安装步骤上设置 `QWEN_SKIP_PREPARE=1`，使 `corepack pnpm install` 不再运行仓库 `prepare` 钩子的完整工作区构建与打包，避免随后该任务自己的 Build 和 Bundle 步骤再重复一次。同时新增一个聚焦的工作流测试，固定该跳过开关以及替代它的显式步骤。

## 为什么需要

被跟踪的主分支 CI 失败发生在共享 ECS 池上的 `Build Qwen Code` 步骤，属于 #14823 记录的堆耗尽类别：`packages/cli` 的 TypeScript 编译超过了旧的 4 GiB V8 上限。上限本身已在主分支上提高到 6144 MB，因此本 PR 补齐该问题中仍未实现的另一半——daemon E2E 任务把整个工作区编译了两次。多余的 prepare 期构建正是 #14823 中最先 OOM 的编译，在资源争用的池上它还会拉长该任务超时所依据的准备时间。现在该任务每个作业只编译一次，显式的 Build 和 Bundle 步骤成为唯一来源。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

检查 SDK Java 工作流中的 daemon E2E 任务，确认其 `Install Node.js dependencies` 步骤设置了 `QWEN_SKIP_PREPARE: '1'`，同时保留随后的 `Build Qwen Code` 和 `Bundle Qwen Code` 步骤。运行工作流元测试套件，确认新增用例通过；从工作流中移除该环境变量后，该用例必须失败。

### 证据（修改前与修改后）

不适用——这是 CI 工作流配置改动，没有用户可见输出。

### 测试环境

| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

本地 Node 22.23.2、npm 10.9.8、通过 corepack 使用的 pnpm 11.24.0。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：该任务现在依赖其显式的 Build 和 Bundle 步骤生成构建与打包产物；这两个步骤已经存在，并由新测试固定。没有改动其他工作流任务。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：无法在本地复现 ECS 托管运行，因此仓库 CI 仍是最终关口。上限提高本身已在主分支更早落地，不属于本 diff。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

prs.title: test(managed-agent): run the MariaDB lane's fixtures on MariaDB
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the non-Hosted integration classes that the MariaDB lane runs read the database they are actually connected to, instead of assuming MySQL 8 only. Row-lock waits come from `information_schema.INNODB_LOCK_WAITS` on MariaDB and from `performance_schema.data_lock_waits` on MySQL; the column-alteration helper rebuilds a default clause MariaDB accepts (it reports an absent default as the string `NULL`, and a bare `MODIFY` resets the default); and the check-constraint assertion accepts MariaDB's SQLSTATE/error-code pair. The lane's server packet budget also moves above the encoded size of the 32 MiB LONGBLOB fixture, so the application's byte-limit gate is what refuses it rather than the server's `max_allowed_packet`.

## Why it's needed

Since the V12 generated-column fix (#14853) the MariaDB lane finally initializes its schema and runs its 1019 tests, and it fails eight of them — every one in a fixture that encodes a MySQL-only assumption. Four are in `WorkspaceCsiApplicationInventoryMySqlIT` (`ALTER … MODIFY … DEFAULT 'NULL'` rejected twice, a MySQL-only SQLSTATE assertion, and the packet budget sitting exactly at the hex-encoded fixture size), two are in `WorkspaceCsiSqlWorkerMySqlIT` (the lock-wait probe queries `performance_schema` tables MariaDB 10.11 does not have), and two are the schema-upgrade expectations handled separately in #14893. Until these are fixed the lane stays red on every full-suite run, which is the signal we need to trust main.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the two classes against a disposable MariaDB 10.11 with a database the test may create schemas in:

```
mvn -Pmysql-integration -Dmysql.url="jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/managed_agent_test?allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false" -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password= -Dit.test=WorkspaceCsiApplicationInventoryMySqlIT failsafe:integration-test failsafe:verify
mvn -Pmysql-integration -Dmysql.url="jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/managed_agent_test?allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false" -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password= -Dit.test=WorkspaceCsiSqlWorkerMySqlIT failsafe:integration-test failsafe:verify
```

Expect `Tests run: 63, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` and `Tests run: 8, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`. On the same server with `max_allowed_packet` left at 64 MiB the inventory run still fails its oversized-binary case, which is what the workflow change addresses.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, on the lane's MariaDB 10.11 (run 39389333815): `WorkspaceCsiApplicationInventoryMySqlIT` 63 tests / 1 failure / 3 errors, `WorkspaceCsiSqlWorkerMySqlIT` 8 tests / 2 failures. After, on local MariaDB 10.11.19 with the same fixture code: 63/63 and 8/8 pass. The MySQL branch of the lock-wait query and the MySQL SQLSTATE/code pair are unchanged, so an 8.4 lane keeps its existing path.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Disposable MariaDB 10.11.19 (Homebrew, `--no-defaults`, empty datadir), JDK 21.0.12.1, Maven 3.10.0, module checkstyle green.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the MariaDB lock-wait observation is a second query path. It returns the same four aliases and is selected only when `VERSION()` contains `MariaDB`; the contention assertions still check the same requester/blocker/table/sql-text facts.
- Not validated / out of scope: the MySQL 8 branch of the query was not re-run here, and the two schema-upgrade expectations in `WorkspaceCreationSchemaMySqlIT` stay with #14893. The workflow change only raises the disposable MariaDB service's packet budget.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no production code or contract changes.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14872.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的作用

让 MariaDB lane 实际执行的这两个非 Hosted 集成测试类，按它们真正连的数据库读取状态，而不是默认按 MySQL 8 写死。行锁等待在 MariaDB 上走 `information_schema.INNODB_LOCK_WAITS`，在 MySQL 上仍走 `performance_schema.data_lock_waits`；改列辅助方法会重建 MariaDB 能接受的默认值子句（MariaDB 把“无默认值”报成字符串 `NULL`，且不带默认值的 `MODIFY` 会清掉原默认值）；CHECK 约束断言接受 MariaDB 的 SQLSTATE/错误码组合。同时把该 lane 的服务端 packet 预算抬到 32 MiB LONGBLOB 夹具 hex 编码后的大小之上，让应用层的字节上限门禁（而不是服务端 `max_allowed_packet`）来拒绝它。

## 为什么需要

V12 生成列修复（#14853）之后，MariaDB lane 终于能初始化 schema 并跑完 1019 个测试，其中 8 个失败——全部来自只按 MySQL 写的夹具：`WorkspaceCsiApplicationInventoryMySqlIT` 4 个（`ALTER … MODIFY … DEFAULT 'NULL'` 被拒两次、只认 MySQL 的 SQLSTATE 断言、packet 预算恰好卡在 hex 编码后的大小）、`WorkspaceCsiSqlWorkerMySqlIT` 2 个（锁等待探针查询 MariaDB 10.11 没有的 `performance_schema` 表），另外 2 个是 schema 升级预期，由 #14893 单独处理。不修这些，每次 full 套件该 lane 都会红，而它正是判断 main 是否可信的信号。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

准备一个可创建 schema 的 MariaDB 10.11，用上面的两条命令分别跑这两个类，期望 `Tests run: 63` 与 `Tests run: 8` 全绿。若把该服务的 `max_allowed_packet` 留在 64 MiB，inventory 的超大二进制用例仍会失败——这正是 workflow 改动要解决的。

### 证据（修复前后）

修复前（run 39389333815 的 MariaDB lane）：`WorkspaceCsiApplicationInventoryMySqlIT` 63 个测试 1 失败 3 错误，`WorkspaceCsiSqlWorkerMySqlIT` 8 个测试 2 失败。修复后在本地 MariaDB 10.11.19 上用同一套夹具：63/63 与 8/8 全部通过。MySQL 分支的查询与 SQLSTATE 组合未改动。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境

一次性 MariaDB 10.11.19（Homebrew，`--no-defaults`，空数据目录）、JDK 21.0.12.1、Maven 3.10.0，模块 checkstyle 通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：MariaDB 的锁等待观测是第二条查询路径；四个别名保持一致，且仅在 `VERSION()` 含 `MariaDB` 时选用，争用断言仍校验同一组 requester/blocker/表名/SQL 文本事实。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：这里没有重跑 MySQL 8 分支，`WorkspaceCreationSchemaMySqlIT` 的两条 schema 升级预期仍由 #14893 负责；workflow 改动只抬高一次性 MariaDB 服务的 packet 预算。
- 破坏性变更：无；不涉及产品代码或契约。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #14872。

</details>
