prs.title: fix(runtime): deliver bounded provider images and PDFs
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Enables bounded image and PDF delivery through the existing managed runtime provider protocol. Each prepared file read uses its own image/PDF capability snapshot for both the tool description and actual content delivery. Supported images use the existing safe image handling; PDFs can return native bytes, extracted text, or rendered pages as appropriate. Execution workers remain independent of model initialization and do not inherit Omni media uploads. Audio and video remain disabled for this provider profile.

Media reads enforce an aggregate 768 KiB base64 ceiling and a 896 KiB complete tool-result ceiling within the existing 1 MiB response envelope. Oversized reads settle as explicit `FILE_TOO_LARGE` tool errors. Accepted media-bearing results retain their content, captions, and display across execution and settled status/cancel observations; response fitting may remove progress or auxiliary Hook details while preserving Hook stop decisions. PDF cancellation propagates through page counting, extraction, and rendering, and waits for child-process exit and renderer cleanup.

Adds regression coverage and integration fixtures for capability isolation, byte boundaries, media validation, chunked Java transport, lost replies, and Broker restart recovery. Updates the provider-control design and dependency notices. The public Hosted raw file loop remains outside this change.

## Why it's needed

The provider worker has no content generator. Previously, its declared media capabilities influenced the tool description, but actual file reads consulted content-generator modalities, so supported images and native PDF bytes could remain unavailable. Oversized responses could also replace inline media with a generic text stub after the Runtime had already retained the original result, producing inconsistent observations of the same invocation.

Using the prepared capability snapshot for delivery and applying media limits before settlement allows provider integrations to receive actual workspace media or an explicit bounded error while retaining consistent execution evidence.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Prepare reads of real PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF files with image support enabled, disabled, and omitted, including concurrent invocations and Sessions. Enabled reads should return decodable image content with the expected MIME and dimensions; disabled or omitted support should return the existing unsupported-image response without inline bytes. An inherited Omni opt-in must not cause uploads.
2. Read a small PDF with native PDF support enabled and no page range: its decoded bytes should match the workspace document. With a page range or native PDF support disabled, confirm text-first behavior and image rendering when extraction fails and image support is enabled. Explicit ranges must not silently lose pages; an implicit rendered prefix must announce omitted pages.
3. Exercise exact media boundaries and one-byte-over cases. A native PDF of 576 KiB can meet the 768 KiB base64 ceiling if the complete result also fits; one decoded byte over must return a settled `FILE_TOO_LARGE` error. Include escaped and multibyte metadata in the 896 KiB result calculation. Text, SVG, notebook content, and text-only PDF results should retain their existing handling.
4. Compare accepted tool results across execution and settled status/cancel responses, including large progress and Hook payloads. Media, captions, and display must remain identical, Hook stop decisions must survive fitting, and malformed MIME/base64 or unadmitted media must fail explicitly. Change the source file after settlement and confirm observations do not reread it.
5. With functioning Poppler tools, cancel page counting, text extraction, and rendering after the child starts. Cancellation must propagate without starting another fallback, and the owned child and rendering directory must be cleaned up.
6. After obtaining a successful build and bundle, run the added Java/MySQL provider-media integration scenario with an isolated MySQL instance. Verify the original seven-field provider reference, correct outbound media bytes and tool-call correlation at the deterministic Chat Completions fixture, exactly one physical execution after lost start/execute replies, unchanged persisted results after Broker restart, and released ownership. Treat native PDF handling through Responses as the documented unsupported case. These are proposed checks; the Java/MySQL scenario has not been run in this session.

### Evidence (Before & After)

No before/after screenshots, recordings, or end-to-end media-delivery logs were provided. The implementation and added assertions describe the expected behavior; they do not establish deployment acceptance. The following local validation ran during the immediately preceding commit workflow on 2026-10-07; no tests were rerun while drafting this description:

- From `packages/core`: `npx vitest run src/tools/managed-tool-runtime.test.ts src/tools/read-file.test.ts src/utils/fileUtils.test.ts src/utils/inline-media.test.ts src/utils/pdf.test.ts src/utils/pdf.poppler.test.ts` — 6 test files passed, with 455 tests passed and 4 real-Poppler tests skipped.
- From `packages/cli`: `npx vitest run src/serve/managed-runtime-provider-protocol.test.ts src/serve/managed-runtime-provider-worker.test.ts` — 2 test files passed, with 141 tests passed.
- From the repository root: `node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='cleanup|promisify|image fixtures' integration-tests/helpers/provider-media-fixtures.node-test.ts` — the selected 4 fixture tests passed. The PDF fixture case was not selected.
- The commit's Prettier/ESLint hook passed. `npm run build` failed in the unchanged email channel with missing `imapflow`, `mailparser`, `nodemailer`, and `html-to-text` dependencies and related type errors. `npm run typecheck` failed with workspace errors, including `TS2540` for assigning to the readonly `text` property in the newly added protocol test at line 942.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested — targeted tests only; build/typecheck failed and real-Poppler tests skipped |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS with Node.js v22.18.0 and Vitest v3.2.7; direct package tests against the local workspace. No packaged deployment or Java/MySQL integration environment was exercised in the observed validation. Reviewed source: commit `205dd4b282c9936b228e79960fe7b7268e520407`, compared with its single parent `9a02f40567237ea3003becac4e6fb3b64c893d45`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the shared effective-modality read path also affects local CLI and local managed tools. Provider media is intentionally a smaller bounded subset of local CLI media; PDF rendering and retained invocations can consume more memory and disk than the response size, and this change introduces no global quota.
- Not validated / out of scope: build and typecheck are not green; the new protocol-test readonly assignment needs attention. Real-Poppler tests were skipped, and no Java transport/Checkstyle, MySQL recovery, packaged worker-to-model, real-model, or production deployment result is available from this session. Public Hosted raw-file media delivery, its separate 64 KiB persistence limits, audio/video, object-storage transport, zoom, and native PDF support through Responses are outside scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no protocol-version, public API, or database-schema migration is introduced by this diff. Invalid or over-budget provider media now produces an explicit protocol fault instead of a successful stub; normal oversized reads are settled tool errors. Existing [English provider-control design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/205dd4b282c9936b228e79960fe7b7268e520407/docs/design/2026-09-27-broker-provider-control.md) and [Chinese provider-control design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/205dd4b282c9936b228e79960fe7b7268e520407/docs/design/2026-09-27-broker-provider-control.zh-CN.md) are updated. The new [Chinese media design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/205dd4b282c9936b228e79960fe7b7268e520407/docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-runtime-provider-media.zh-CN.md) links to `docs/design/2026-10-07-managed-runtime-provider-media.md`, but that English counterpart is absent from the reviewed commit, so bilingual completeness cannot be claimed.

## Linked Issues

Related to [#13039](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13039) and its [root-cause comment](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13039#issuecomment-5895577269). No closing keyword is asserted because the documented end-to-end acceptance has not been established by the available validation.

---

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

通过现有 managed runtime provider 协议提供有界的图片和 PDF 交付。每次准备的文件读取使用独立的图片/PDF 能力快照，同时决定工具描述和实际内容交付。支持的图片复用既有安全处理；PDF 按条件返回原生字节、提取的文本或渲染页面。执行 worker 保持独立于模型初始化，也不会继承 Omni 媒体上传行为。该 provider profile 仍禁用音频和视频。

媒体读取在既有 1 MiB 响应包装内，限制聚合 base64 为 768 KiB、完整工具结果为 896 KiB。超限读取以明确的 `FILE_TOO_LARGE` 工具错误结算。已接受的含媒体结果在执行和已结算的 status/cancel 观察中保持内容、说明文本和展示不变；响应适配可以删除进度或 Hook 辅助内容，但保留 Hook 停止决定。PDF 取消会传递到页数查询、文本提取和渲染，并等待子进程退出及渲染清理完成。

增加回归覆盖和集成 fixture，覆盖能力隔离、字节边界、媒体校验、Java 分块传输、应答丢失和 Broker 重启恢复。更新 provider-control 设计及依赖声明。公开 Hosted raw 文件循环不属于本次改动范围。

## Why it's needed

provider worker 没有 content generator。此前，声明的媒体能力影响工具描述，但实际读取依赖 content-generator 模态，导致支持的图片和原生 PDF 字节仍可能无法交付。超限响应还可能在 Runtime 已保留原始结果后，把内联媒体替换为通用文本占位，从而让同一 invocation 的观察结果不一致。

使用准备时的能力快照决定交付，并在结算前应用媒体上限，使 provider 集成能够获得真实 Workspace 媒体或明确的有界错误，同时保留一致的执行证据。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. 使用真实 PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 文件，分别在图片能力开启、关闭和省略时准备读取，包括并发 invocation 和 Session。开启时应返回可解码、MIME 和尺寸正确的图片内容；关闭或省略时应返回既有的不支持图片提示，不含内联字节。继承的 Omni 开关不能触发上传。
2. 开启原生 PDF 能力、不指定页范围，读取小型 PDF：解码字节应与 Workspace 文档一致。指定页范围或关闭原生 PDF 能力时，确认文本优先行为，以及提取失败且图片能力开启时的页面渲染。显式范围不能静默丢页；隐式渲染前缀必须说明省略的页面。
3. 检查精确媒体边界和超出一字节的情况。576 KiB 原生 PDF 在完整结果也可容纳时，可以满足 768 KiB base64 上限；多一个解码字节必须返回已结算的 `FILE_TOO_LARGE` 错误。896 KiB 结果大小计算应包含转义和多字节元数据。文本、SVG、notebook 内容和纯文本 PDF 结果应保留既有处理方式。
4. 比较执行和已结算 status/cancel 响应中的已接受工具结果，包括较大的进度及 Hook 负载。媒体、说明文本和展示必须相同，Hook 停止决定必须保留，畸形 MIME/base64 或未经准入的媒体必须明确失败。结算后修改源文件，确认观察不会重新读取文件。
5. 在 Poppler 工具可用时，等待子进程启动后取消页数查询、文本提取和渲染。取消必须向上传递，不能启动另一条回退，所属子进程及渲染目录必须完成清理。
6. 构建和打包成功后，使用隔离的 MySQL 实例运行新增的 Java/MySQL provider-media 集成场景。验证原始七字段 provider 引用、确定性 Chat Completions fixture 收到的媒体字节及工具调用关联、start/execute 应答丢失后只发生一次物理执行、Broker 重启后持久结果不变，以及所有权已释放。Responses 的原生 PDF 处理应被视为文档说明的不支持情形。这些是建议检查，本会话尚未运行 Java/MySQL 场景。

### Evidence (Before & After)

未提供前后对比截图、录屏或端到端媒体交付日志。实现与新增断言描述了预期行为，不能据此认定部署验收完成。以下本地验证在紧接此前的提交流程中于 2026-10-07 执行；撰写本说明时未重新运行测试：

- 在 `packages/core`：`npx vitest run src/tools/managed-tool-runtime.test.ts src/tools/read-file.test.ts src/utils/fileUtils.test.ts src/utils/inline-media.test.ts src/utils/pdf.test.ts src/utils/pdf.poppler.test.ts` — 6 个测试文件通过，455 项测试通过，4 项真实 Poppler 测试跳过。
- 在 `packages/cli`：`npx vitest run src/serve/managed-runtime-provider-protocol.test.ts src/serve/managed-runtime-provider-worker.test.ts` — 2 个测试文件通过，141 项测试通过。
- 在仓库根目录：`node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='cleanup|promisify|image fixtures' integration-tests/helpers/provider-media-fixtures.node-test.ts` — 选中的 4 项 fixture 测试通过。未选择 PDF fixture 用例。
- 提交的 Prettier/ESLint 钩子通过。`npm run build` 在未修改的 email channel 中失败，包含缺少 `imapflow`、`mailparser`、`nodemailer`、`html-to-text` 依赖及相关类型错误。`npm run typecheck` 因 Workspace 错误失败，其中新增 protocol 测试第 942 行给只读 `text` 属性赋值，报 `TS2540`。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested — 仅相关测试；构建/类型检查失败，真实 Poppler 测试跳过 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS，Node.js v22.18.0，Vitest v3.2.7；直接在本地 Workspace 中运行按包测试。已观察到的验证未使用打包部署或 Java/MySQL 集成环境。审阅来源：commit `205dd4b282c9936b228e79960fe7b7268e520407`，与唯一父提交 `9a02f40567237ea3003becac4e6fb3b64c893d45` 比较。

## Risk & Scope

- 主要风险或取舍：共享的有效模态读取路径也影响本地 CLI 和本地 managed 工具。provider 媒体有意只支持本地 CLI 媒体的较小有界子集；PDF 渲染和保留的 invocation 可能消耗比响应大小更多的内存及磁盘，本次改动不增加全局配额。

prs.title: fix(test): keep E2E CI runs off the pool host's auth state
prs.body:
## What this PR does

On CI, the integration harness now leaves its hermetic global config directory empty instead of seeding it from the runner host's live `~/.qwen` settings. Local runs still carry the host configuration so a developer's ambient auth and model routing keep working.

## Why it's needed

The main-branch E2E Docker sandbox leg failed the same 75 tests at `b1cf76a4a4b4` and again at `4b136b527f96`, while the `sandbox:none` leg passed both times. The failing tests were the ones that ran the CLI with the ambient global config directory; the tests that isolated `QWEN_HOME` passed. That directory is seeded from the pool host's `settings.json` and `oauth_creds.json`, which are live mutable state on a persistent runner. A host whose settings select or enforce an auth type that conflicts with the workflow's credentials makes every spawned CLI fail before it can call the model — including cases that pass `--auth-type openai`, because a host `enforcedType` is rejected as a mismatch. CI already supplies auth through `OPENAI_*`, so importing the host's auth state only makes the suite depend on which pool host picked up the job.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `cd integration-tests && npx vitest run globalSetup.test.ts -t 'host config carry-over'`. The first case sets `CI=true` and asserts the hermetic home has no `settings.json` or `oauth_creds.json`; the second leaves `CI` unset and asserts the host files are carried over. Both should pass.

With Docker, run the E2E Docker sandbox leg on a persistent pool host and confirm the previously failing tests — the cron, edit, file-system, JSON output, JSON schema, MCP cyclic schema, and `qwen-serve-client-mcp` cases — no longer fail because of the host's auth selection.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — this changes test-harness setup, not user-visible behavior.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22 in the autofix checkout. Docker/Podman is unavailable here, so the full Docker E2E leg was not run locally; the focused harness test, build, typecheck, and lint were run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: CI runs no longer inherit a pool host's live config for auth. The E2E workflow already supplies `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_BASE_URL`, and `OPENAI_MODEL`, so the supported path is unchanged; a CI workflow that relied solely on the host's `~/.qwen` for auth would need to set env credentials.
- Not validated / out of scope: The full Docker E2E leg could not run in this sandbox; the main CI E2E run verifies it. The fix does not change the sandbox image, CLI runtime, or test assertions.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None for users. Local integration runs keep the previous carry-over behavior.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14968

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 CI 上，集成测试框架不再用 runner 主机上真实的 `~/.qwen` 配置初始化每次运行的独立全局配置目录，而是保持该目录为空。本地运行仍会复制主机配置，以便开发者沿用环境中的认证和模型路由。

## 为什么需要这个改动

主分支 E2E 的 Docker 沙箱任务在 `b1cf76a4a4b4` 和再次在 `4b136b527f96` 上失败同样的 75 个测试，而 `sandbox:none` 任务两次都通过。失败的都是使用环境默认全局配置目录运行 CLI 的测试；隔离了 `QWEN_HOME` 的测试则通过。该目录由池主机的 `settings.json` 和 `oauth_creds.json` 填充，而这些在持久化 runner 上是会变化的实时状态。如果主机的设置选择或强制了与工作流凭据不匹配的认证类型，每个被拉起的 CLI 都会在调用模型前失败——包括传入 `--auth-type openai` 的用例，因为主机的 `enforcedType` 会被判定为不匹配。CI 已经通过 `OPENAI_*` 提供认证，因此导入主机的认证状态只会让测试套件依赖任务落在哪台池主机上。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

运行 `cd integration-tests && npx vitest run globalSetup.test.ts -t 'host config carry-over'`。第一个用例设置 `CI=true`，断言独立配置目录中没有 `settings.json` 或 `oauth_creds.json`；第二个用例不设置 `CI`，断言主机的这两个文件会被复制。两者都应通过。

在有 Docker 的环境中，在持久化池主机上运行 E2E Docker 沙箱任务，确认此前失败的测试——cron、edit、file-system、JSON output、JSON schema、MCP cyclic schema 以及 `qwen-serve-client-mcp` 用例——不再因主机认证选择而失败。

### 证据（修改前 / 修改后）

N/A — 本改动调整测试框架的初始化，不改变用户可见行为。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

autofix 检出目录中的 Node 22。此处没有 Docker/Podman，因此未在本地运行完整的 Docker E2E 任务；已运行聚焦的测试框架测试、build、typecheck 和 lint。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：CI 运行不再继承池主机上实时配置的认证。E2E 工作流已经提供 `OPENAI_API_KEY`、`OPENAI_BASE_URL` 和 `OPENAI_MODEL`，因此受支持的路径不变；如果某个 CI 工作流只依赖主机的 `~/.qwen` 进行认证，则需要自行设置环境变量凭据。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：当前沙箱无法运行完整的 Docker E2E 任务；由主 CI 的 E2E 运行进行验证。本修复不改变沙箱镜像、CLI 运行时或测试断言。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：对用户无影响。本地集成测试运行仍保留此前的复制行为。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #14968

prs.title: feat(memory): add scoped external import jobs for CLI and HTTP
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Qwen-owned external memory import service for CLI and cloud integrations, starting with Codex. Clients submit relative Markdown paths and contents, inspect a deterministic preview, explicitly select sections and destination scope, then start durable background consolidation using the selected workspace's configured model. Results enter native memory search, fetch, recall and forget. Main checkouts and registered linked worktrees share the imported project layer while ordinary memory isolation remains unchanged.

The service exposes `memory_import_v1`, workspace-qualified HTTP preview/submit/status/source/cancel/retry endpoints, and offline `memory import codex --dry-run --json`. Unknown source scope stays unassigned. The server owns destination paths and validates active workspace trust; it never falls back to the primary runtime. Only selected source snapshots are retained. Journaled publication, idempotency, cancellation and retry protect existing, edited and forgotten memories.

Consolidation uses bounded batches per source project and confirmed scope, a compact same-scope metadata index with relevant evidence, and durable aggregate call/token reservations. Preview exposes usage estimates without reading native memories or invoking a model. Failure, cancellation and retry do not replenish the budget. Saved batch proposals preserve per-source recovery and edit/forget protection; imported repository identity lookups are cached and skipped entirely when no imported layer exists.

## Why it's needed

A cloud runtime cannot read a user's laptop filesystem. Direct per-bullet conversion also loses historical context and does not reconcile old knowledge with existing native memory. This replaces #14149 with shared backend capabilities and model-backed consolidation. No external product UI, independent collector, dependency installation requirement or unrelated CI repair is included.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Submit a synthetic Codex source set containing two projects and a referenced distilled Markdown resource. Preview should return grouped sections, references and assignment reasons without model calls or memory/task writes. An ambiguous section should stay unassigned.
- Select only one project and submit to a trusted non-primary workspace. Observe queued/running/completed results, then fetch its retained source and search the native result. The other project's text must never reach the model or retained snapshot; unknown/untrusted/draining destinations must not fall back to primary.
- Repeat the same request/key and then try another key with the same selected content. Native documents should not multiply. Edit or forget an imported document; another import must return conflict rather than restore it.
- Cancel during consolidation, retry a failed item, and restart after a forced process kill before/after publication. Recovery should wait out a dead worker's lease, preserve accurate counts/refs and publish each document only once.
- Verify the imported project result through a linked worktree, and verify an independent clone remains isolated. Ordinary per-worktree memory must retain its existing behavior.

- Verify a 12-section selected project is processed in two bounded calls, while excluded groups never reach the model. Preview should show group and aggregate usage estimates; retrying a budget-exhausted task must not reset the allowance. Interrupt between publications and verify saved proposals resume without another paid call or restoring edited/forgotten knowledge.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the installed baseline CLI rejected `memory import codex`, and the base daemon did not advertise the capability. After: synthetic shipped-CLI dry-runs (bare, leading debug and safe mode) returned versioned pure JSON with zero network attempts and zero filesystem changes. Confirmed CLI import and the real bundled daemon → real ACP child → loopback OpenAI-compatible model produced native searchable memory without unselected input. Bare/safe confirmed import rejected before source access or authentication.

Initial implementation tests passed: 559 CLI cases, 31 core cases, and the focused cold-workspace ACP bridge case. Full workspace build and typecheck passed; affected packages were rebuilt after final edits, with a final bundle and CLI typecheck. ESLint and formatting passed. Real SIGKILL probes left stale lock directories and recovered automatically after approximately 120 seconds, without manual lock deletion; both interruption points produced one document and correct original-batch counts. Two self-audit passes and a local medium review found no remaining issue; these are not formal approval.

Latest cost update after merging main: 55 focused CLI and 126 core tests passed, along with full build, bundle, typecheck, lint and format. Real bundled CLI/HTTP each processed 12 selected sources as [8, 4], with two requests and no extra request on repetition. Synthetic existing-context payload fell from 199,080 to 2,170 bytes. Interrupted-batch, budget-recovery and cross-group ordering probes passed. Production billing savings are not asserted.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Synthetic CLI, real daemon/ACP/model transport, native memory and process recovery |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Awaiting CI |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Awaiting CI |

### Environment (optional)

Isolated synthetic HOME, runtime, source and repository directories; deterministic loopback provider only. The full build used an 8 GiB Node heap. No actual user memory or production provider was accessed.

## Risk & Scope

- Budget limits: 32 logical invocations and 512,000 conservative reserved token units per task, with 8,192 output tokens per request. These are not guaranteed provider-billed-token or currency caps; oversized metadata/relevant evidence fails closed.
- Main risk or tradeoff: this is a cross-package feature with native memory reader and ACP integration; maintainer architectural review is requested. Model output is schema/native-format checked and cannot overwrite existing documents, but production-model semantic quality still requires evaluation.
- Not validated / out of scope: external product UI, standalone collectors, continuous sync, cross-instance sync and production deployment. SSH workspaces and legacy memory base/local path overrides are rejected in v1. Resource/context limits are documented; oversized context fails instead of silently truncating.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: additive capability and endpoints; ordinary writable memory roots remain unchanged. This does not migrate experimental state from #14149.

Design and API contracts are complete and synchronized in both languages: [Design (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/external-memory-import/docs/design/external-memory-import.md), [设计（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/external-memory-import/docs/design/external-memory-import.zh-CN.md), [API (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/external-memory-import/docs/design/external-memory-import-api.md), [接口（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/external-memory-import/docs/design/external-memory-import-api.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Supersedes #14149 following the requested backend redesign.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 本 PR 的变更

提供由 Qwen 自身负责的外部记忆导入服务，供 CLI 和云端系统接入，首版支持 Codex。客户端提交相对 Markdown 路径和内容，查看确定性预览，明确选择章节和目标范围后，启动使用目标工作区模型的持久化后台整理任务。结果进入原生记忆搜索、全文、召回和遗忘流程。主检出与已注册 linked worktree 共享导入项目层，普通记忆的既有隔离语义保持不变。

提供 `memory_import_v1`、限定工作区的 HTTP 预览/提交/状态/来源/取消/重试接口，以及离线 `memory import codex --dry-run --json`。未知归属保持待分配。目标路径由服务端管理，检查活动工作区信任状态，不回退主运行时。只保留选中来源快照，通过提交日志、幂等、取消和重试保护已有、已编辑和已遗忘的记忆。

整理按来源项目和确认范围分成有界批次，发送紧凑的同范围元数据索引及相关证据，并持久化总调用/token预留预算。预览展示估算，不读取原生记忆、不调用模型；失败、取消、重试不会重置预算。整批提案持久化后支持逐来源恢复，继续保护编辑和遗忘。仓库身份采用有界缓存，没有导入层时跳过遍历。

### 为什么需要

云端运行时无法直接读取用户电脑的文件系统；逐条转换 Markdown 列表还会丢失历史上下文，无法协调历史知识和已有原生记忆。本 PR 以共享底层能力和模型整理替代 #14149。不包含外部产品界面、独立收集器、额外安装要求或无关 CI 修补。

### 评审测试计划

使用含两个项目和一个引用 Markdown 资源的合成来源，验证预览返回分组、引用和归属原因，不调用模型，不写记忆或任务；歧义章节保持待分配。只选择一个项目并提交到可信次工作区，观察任务状态、查看保留来源并搜索原生结果；未选内容不得进入模型或快照，未知、不可信和退出中的目标不得回退主工作区。

重复同一请求/幂等键，再用新键提交相同内容，文档数量不应增加。编辑或遗忘导入文档后再次导入应返回冲突，不恢复内容。验证取消、失败重试，以及发布前后强制结束进程后的重启恢复：等待旧锁租约后自动继续，计数和引用正确且只发布一次。验证 linked worktree 共享结果、独立 clone 隔离及普通记忆原有行为。

### 前后证据

基线已安装 CLI 不支持该命令，基线 daemon 无此能力标识。实现后，成品 CLI 的普通、前置 debug 和 safe 模式预览均输出版本化纯 JSON，零网络尝试和零文件变化。确认后的 CLI 导入，以及真实 daemon → 真实 ACP 子进程 → 本地 OpenAI 兼容模拟模型的链路，均生成可搜索原生记忆且不包含未选来源。bare/safe 模式确认导入在读取来源或认证前被拒绝。

本地通过 559 项 CLI、31 项 core 测试及冷启动工作区 ACP 专项测试。全工作区构建和类型检查通过；最后修改后重新构建受影响包，完成最终 bundle 和 CLI 类型检查。ESLint、格式检查通过。真实 SIGKILL 遗留锁目录，约 120 秒后自动恢复，无需手工删锁；两个中断点均只生成一个文档，原批次计数正确。两轮自审和本地 medium 审查无剩余问题，不等同正式批准。

最新成本更新同步主线后，55 项 CLI、126 项 core 定向测试及全构建、bundle、typecheck、lint/format 通过。真实 CLI/HTTP 均将 12 条选中来源分成 8＋4，只调用两次，重复提交不增加调用；预览展示每组和总用量估算。合成已有上下文从 199,080 降至 2,170 字节，中断恢复、预算不重置与交错项目顺序验证通过。这不是生产账单节省率。

### 平台与环境

macOS 已完成合成 CLI、真实 daemon/ACP/模型传输、原生记忆和进程恢复验证；Windows、Linux 等待 CI。使用隔离的合成 HOME、运行目录、来源和仓库，以及确定性本地模拟模型；全量构建使用 8 GiB Node 堆。未访问真实用户记忆或生产模型。

每任务上限为 32 次逻辑调用及 512,000 个保守预留 token 单位，每次输出最多 8,192 token；不保证供应商实际计费 token 或金额硬上限。元数据或相关证据超限时明确失败。

### 风险、范围与迁移

本功能跨包并接入原生记忆读取和 ACP，需要维护者架构评审。模型输出经过结构化和原生格式校验且不能覆盖现有文档，但生产模型语义质量仍需评估。不包含外部产品界面、独立收集器、持续同步、跨实例同步或生产部署。v1 拒绝 SSH 工作区及旧式记忆 base/local 路径覆盖；资源和上下文限制已说明，超限失败而不静默截断。

新增能力和接口，普通记忆写入根目录不变。不迁移 #14149 的实验状态。双语设计与接口文档内容完整同步，链接见上方。本 PR 按重新设计要求替代 #14149。

</details>

prs.title: fix(qqbot)!: restore per-group session isolation under thread scope
prs.body:
> **Update (round 5)** — head is now `87a6b5ff76fcb521ab8026b33c5c67aadf4d0281`: **2 commits** on top of `bc534b3adf` (`f8dff632bb`, `87a6b5ff76`), touching only `packages/channels/qqbot/src/QQChannel.ts` (+59/−17), `cron.test.ts` (+306/−0) and `stream.test.ts` (+39/−0). The failure-exit P2 raised by @wenshao and independently confirmed by @qqqys is fixed there, with 9 new regression cases; see the [review reply](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13882#issuecomment-6220957169) for the per-exit behaviour, the mutation evidence, and the residuals that are disclosed rather than fixed. `Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)` shows as failing only because the job was **cancelled at 29m07s** (fork lane cap), not because a test failed.

---

> **Migrated from #13250 on 2026-10-11 — identical code, identical head SHA.**
>
> `#13250` was stuck on a GitHub-side artifact, not a code problem: an invisible `CHANGES_REQUESTED` left behind by the now-deleted `qwen-code-ci-bot` account. That PR reports `reviews: 0`, `reviewThreads: 0` and zero review comments, its timeline contains no `reviewed` / `review_dismissed` event, and the account itself returns 404 — yet `reviewDecision` stayed `CHANGES_REQUESTED`, and because the `main` ruleset sets `dismiss_stale_reviews_on_push: false`, 90+ pushes never cleared it. A review that no longer exists cannot be dismissed by the author.
>
> Everything else on `#13250` was healthy: content CI was green (25 pass / 7 skipped; the only three failures were `CI_BOT_PAT` 403s from that suspended account), the branch was conflict-free against `main`, and the `main` ruleset declares no required status checks.
>
> This PR carries the **same commit** — `0851c08947d57c9323da7f518cbaafe3723ac5a3` — re-pointed through a new fork branch so it can start from a clean review state. Nothing was rebased, squashed or changed in the move, so the maintainer round-4 verification (`merge-ready` on correctness, 2554/2554 scripted assertions, head `0851c08947` against base `43a6e1e5e4`) still refers to exactly this code.

## What this PR does

Restores per-group session isolation for the QQ Bot channel. Removes the forced `sessionScope: 'single'` override that the constructor applied to its own copy of the config whenever `groupAllPolicy` was `keyword` or `all` (introduced during PR #6457 review); the channel now respects the configured scope and warns when a non-shared scope is combined with full-message group mode. Reply streaming keeps a per-session anchor and carries it across seal and cancel boundaries, so a cancelled or superseded turn still flushes against its own `msg_id` (per-message wire anchoring itself landed on `main` in #10145; what this change owns is the boundary machinery around it). Orphaned persisted routing entries from the old single-scope layout are purged on startup, and the QQ channel now declares `thread` as its default session scope so zero-config deployments get per-group shared context by default.

## Supersedes #8241

This is the same change as #8241, carried to a fresh PR after 22 review rounds and 83 blocker-signalling threads. The pipeline's own reports said each round re-read the entire diff (its incremental anchor was lost), so rounds spent their budget re-deriving earlier findings and the thread never converged; the newest round posted zero new findings, and every Critical posted across all rounds is fixed here with a pinning test and a mutation proof. No code changed in the move.

The branch is merged up to `main` at `1a933f7b5e`, which includes the QQ Bot inbound-media PR (#12850) that landed while #8241 was open. The only conflict was an additive stub in a test double in `events.test.ts` (`getResponseMessageId` from this change, `prepareThenHandleInbound` from the media work); both were kept. The package's suite is 692 tests green at this head — the merge base `543f03e5b1` runs 357, so this change adds 335 tests to that baseline (the 41 the inbound-media PR brought are included in those 357). On the previous head, `Qwen Code CI` was fully green, including `Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)`, which had been red for every head since round 18 over `packages/core/src/memory/recall-scan-latency.test.ts` (#10490), a host-gate flake that `main` fixed in #13094 and that merging `main` cleared.

## Why it's needed

The forced scope never reached the router. `start.ts` and `daemon-worker.ts` call `router.setChannelScope(name, config.sessionScope)` with the *parsed* config, before `QQChannel`'s constructor rewrites its own copy — so the override changed what `QQChannel` believed, not how sessions were actually routed. That split brain produced two defects on `main`:

1. **Full-message group mode never actually got shared group context.** Routing stayed `user`-scoped, so group traffic was fragmented into one session per sender — the opposite of what the override existed to guarantee.
2. **`QQChannel` still believed it was `single`**, so every `sessionScope === 'single'` gate inside it fired against user-scoped routing — for example, a DM was treated as a shared session and `/clear` demanded an extra `confirm`.

The "everything collapsed into one `__single__` session, with context leaking across groups and into DMs" symptom is real, but it requires `sessionScope: "single"` to be set explicitly — which is what the docs recommended for `groupAllPolicy` users. The `replyMsgId` concurrency issue that motivated the override was never actually resolved by it, only hidden.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run the unit suite: `cd packages/channels/qqbot && npx vitest run` — 8 files, 692 tests pass (357 at the merge base `543f03e5b1`, so this change adds 335; the inbound-media work's 41 are already inside those 357).
- Config-level behavior: with `groupAllPolicy: "all"` and no explicit `sessionScope`, the channel must not emit the scope-forcing WARNING and must route group messages per group (`<channel>:<group_openid>`) and DMs per user (`<channel>:<user_openid>`).
- Concurrent streaming: two users messaging in the same group while the bot is mid-stream must keep their replies anchored to their own `msg_id` (no cross-threading) — covered by the new stream tests.
- Cancel behavior: interrupting a turn (`/cancel` or steer) must flush the buffered partial reply before tearing down stream state — partial output is not dropped (regression test pins this).
- The streaming-ownership invariants the review rounds converged on have their own acceptance block: a settling flush chain must not write shared per-session state once the session was torn down or the turn was superseded (`R21 acceptance: ownership gates for a settling flush chain`).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — internal routing/session behavior, no user-visible UI change. Before: with `groupAllPolicy: "all"`, group traffic was fragmented per sender while `QQChannel` believed it was running one shared session. After: per-group shared sessions with cross-group isolation, and the channel's belief matches the router.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only: `cd packages/channels/qqbot && npx vitest run` — 692 passed; `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=3072 npx tsc --build` (in the package) — clean; `eslint` on changed source — clean; `prettier --check` — clean.

## Risk & Scope

- Beyond the QQ channel this diff also touches two shared surfaces, both of which were needed to make the scope default usable: `parseChannelConfig` and the daemon's channel-settings store now share one `effectiveSessionScope(rawConfig, multiSession, plugin)` helper, so saving a `multiSession` channel without a stored scope resolves `"user"` instead of tripping `ChannelBase`'s construction-time invariant; and the Web Shell channel editor no longer pre-fills a plugin's non-`user` default for a `multiSession` instance, which otherwise made that save fail (`requires sessionScope "user" when multiSession is enabled`). An explicitly stored or submitted non-`user` scope on a `multiSession` channel is still rejected.
- Main risk or tradeoff: the effective session scope for any QQ deployment that omitted `sessionScope` changes from the global `user` default to this plugin's `thread` default (`config-utils.ts` fills `rawConfig.sessionScope || plugin.defaultSessionScope || 'user'`). This applies to **every** such config — not just `groupAllPolicy: keyword/all` users — including plain `groupPolicy: "allowlist"` + `requireMention` deployments, which go from per-sender contexts to per-group shared context. The tradeoff is deliberate (per-group context is what full-message group mode was always supposed to mean), and `sessionScope: "user"` restores the old behaviour per deployment.
- Not validated / out of scope: live end-to-end verification needs real QQ credentials and was not run in CI; macOS and Windows were not exercised in CI (Linux lanes only).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no config-format change. A group thread session is a shared session, so the commands that act on it (`/clear`, `/who`, `/status`, `/loop`, `/btw`) and the permission answers (`/approve`, `/approve-always`, `/deny`) are restricted to the members listed in the channel's `operators` (`ChannelBase.isSharedSessionOperator` reads only `operators`; `allowedUsers` and `senderPolicy` do not grant them). `operators` is unset by default, so a zero-config QQ group has no member who can run those commands and no one who can answer a permission request raised in it; set `operators` to the QQ user ids that should steer the group's session — the channel now warns at startup when group access is enabled on a shared scope with `operators` empty. Measured consequence of leaving it unset: a tool call that needs approval has no one who can answer it, so the requester and every other member are refused, the tool never runs, and the group's session is held by that pending prompt until `AcpBridge` times it out (300 s) — `/cancel` queues behind it too. Deployments that never show a permission prompt (for example `yolo`) are unaffected. (`!` host-shell stays disabled in every QQ group chat regardless of scope.) On startup the channel reports unroutable persisted routes: the `<channel>:__single__` entries left over from the forced single-scope era, and — whenever the effective scope is not `user` — this channel's own three-part `<channel>:<sender>:<chat>` keys, which under `thread`/`chat_thread` can never resolve again and count against the bridge's per-workspace session cap on every restart. Deleting them is opt-in: with `purgeLegacySessions` unset (its default, `false`) the channel logs the count and removes nothing; with `purgeLegacySessions: true` it writes a rescue copy of the routes about to be removed (`qq-sessions-purged.json`) before the first deletion, so a legacy conversation can be rebuilt by hand. History behind them is not migrated in either mode (it cannot be split per group). Ownership is decided by each entry's recorded target channel, never by key prefix, so a sibling channel's routes are untouched, and the purge runs after restore so the first boot still re-attaches the entries once before releasing them. Cancelled turns now flush their buffered partial reply before the stream state is torn down, so partial output is no longer lost. Release note: the effective default session scope for QQ deployments that omit `sessionScope` changes from `user` to `thread`; group sessions are shared sessions, so `operators` must be configured for members to answer permission prompts or run session-control commands; the legacy-route purge is opt-in and removes nothing by default.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #8238

## 本 PR 做了什么

修复 QQ Bot channel 的会话隔离：删除 `groupAllPolicy=keyword/all` 时构造器对自己那份配置强制写入 `sessionScope='single'` 的逻辑（PR #6457 review 期间引入），改为尊重配置，并在"非共享 scope + 全量群消息模式"组合下发出 WARNING。流式回复按 session 锚定 `msg_id`，同群并发用户不再互相串线。启动时清理旧的 single-scope 布局遗留的、已无法解析的持久化路由条目；QQ channel 声明默认 `sessionScope` 为 `thread`，零配置部署默认获得"每群共享上下文"。

## 承接 #8241

与 #8241 是同一份改动，迁移到新 PR：原线程已经历 22 轮评审、累计 83 个未决阻塞线程，而流水线自己的报告说明每轮都在重读整个 diff（增量锚点丢失），预算被用于反复重推既有发现，始终没有收敛；最新一轮已零新发现，而历轮提出的所有 Critical 在本树中均已修复，每一条都有固定行为的测试与变异证明。迁移过程未改动任何代码。

分支已与 `main`（`1a933f7b5e`）合并，其中包含 #8241 还开着时合入的 QQ Bot 入站媒体 PR（#12850）。唯一的冲突是 `events.test.ts` 里测试替身上的一处新增（本改动的 `getResponseMessageId` 与媒体改动的 `prepareThenHandleInbound`），两侧都保留。合并后该包 692 个测试全绿 —— merge base `543f03e5b1` 为 357，故本改动相对该基线新增 335 个（媒体 PR 带入的 41 个已含在这 357 内）。上一个 head 上 `Qwen Code CI` 已全绿，包括 `Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)`：它自第 18 轮起一直红，原因是 `packages/core/src/memory/recall-scan-latency.test.ts`（#10490）的 runner 门禁，`main` 已在 #13094 修复，合并 `main` 后即转绿。

## 为什么需要它

强制 scope 从未真正传到 router。`start.ts` 与 `daemon-worker.ts` 用**解析后的**配置调用 `router.setChannelScope(name, config.sessionScope)`，而 `QQChannel` 的构造器只是改写了自己那份副本 —— 于是这个强制改变的是 `QQChannel` 的认知，而不是真实路由。这一"两个真相"在 `main` 上产生两个缺陷：

1. **全量群消息模式从未真正获得共享群上下文。** 路由仍是 `user` scope，群消息按发送者碎片化 —— 与该强制想要保证的完全相反。
2. **`QQChannel` 自认为 `single`**，于是它内部所有 `sessionScope === 'single'` 判定都作用在 user 路由上 —— 例如私聊被当成共享会话，`/clear` 会多要一次 `confirm`。

"所有群/私聊折叠进一个 `__single__` 会话、上下文互相泄漏"这个现象确实存在，但前提是显式设置 `sessionScope: "single"`（文档当时正是这样向 `groupAllPolicy` 用户推荐的）。当年为掩盖 `replyMsgId` 并发问题而引入的强制从未真正解决该问题，只是把它藏了起来。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

- 跑单元测试：`cd packages/channels/qqbot && npx vitest run` —— 8 个文件、692 个测试通过（merge base `543f03e5b1` 为 357，故相对该基线新增 335 个）。
- 配置层行为：`groupAllPolicy: "all"` 且未显式设置 `sessionScope` 时，不得出现"强制 scope"的 WARNING，且群消息按群路由（`<channel>:<group_openid>`）、私聊按用户路由（`<channel>:<user_openid>`）。
- 并发流式：同群两个用户在 bot 流式输出期间发消息，各自回复必须锚定到自己的 `msg_id`（不串线）—— 由新增 stream 测试覆盖。
- 取消行为：中断一个 turn（`/cancel` 或 steer）必须先 flush 已缓冲的部分回复再清理流状态 —— 部分输出不丢（有回归测试固定）。
- 各轮评审收敛出的流式归属不变量有独立验收块：会话已被拆除或 turn 已被后继取代后，正在收尾的 flush 链不得再写共享的 per-session 状态（`R21 acceptance: ownership gates for a settling flush chain`）。

### 证据（改动前后）

N/A —— 属内部路由/会话行为，无用户可见的 TUI 变化。改动前：`groupAllPolicy: "all"` 下群消息按发送者碎片化，而 `QQChannel` 自认为在跑一个共享会话。改动后：每群共享会话且跨群隔离，channel 的认知与 router 一致。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

仅单元测试：`cd packages/channels/qqbot && npx vitest run` —— 692 通过；包内 `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=3072 npx tsc --build` —— clean；改动源码 `eslint` —— clean；`prettier --check` —— clean。

## 风险与范围

- 除 QQ channel 外，本 diff 还触及两个共享面，都是让新的 scope 默认值可用所必需的：`parseChannelConfig` 与 daemon 的 channel-settings store 现共用同一个 `effectiveSessionScope(rawConfig, multiSession, plugin)`，因此保存一个未存 `sessionScope` 的 `multiSession` channel 会解析为 `"user"`，不再触发 `ChannelBase` 的构造期不变量；Web Shell 的 channel 编辑器也不再为 `multiSession` 实例预填插件的非 `user` 默认值（此前会使保存失败：`requires sessionScope "user" when multiSession is enabled`）。显式存储或提交的非 `user` scope 在 `multiSession` channel 上仍会被拒绝。
- 主要风险或取舍：任何省略 `sessionScope` 的 QQ 部署，其生效 scope 会从全局默认 `user` 变为本插件的 `thread` 默认（`config-utils.ts` 按 `rawConfig.sessionScope || plugin.defaultSessionScope || 'user'` 填充）。这适用于**所有**这类配置 —— 不只是 `groupAllPolicy: keyword/all` 用户 —— 也包括普通的 `groupPolicy: "allowlist"` + `requireMention` 部署，它们会从"按发送者独立上下文"变为"按群共享上下文"。这个取舍是有意的（全量群消息模式本就应当意味着每群上下文），需要旧行为时按部署设置 `sessionScope: "user"` 即可。
- 未验证或超出范围：真实端到端验证需要真实 QQ 凭据，CI 未跑；CI 只在 Linux 通道跑，macOS 与 Windows 未覆盖。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：配置格式无变化。群聊线程是共享会话，因此作用于该会话的命令（`/clear`、`/who`、`/status`、`/loop`、`/btw`）与权限应答（`/approve`、`/approve-always`、`/deny`）仅限 `operators` 中列出的成员（`ChannelBase.isSharedSessionOperator` 只读 `operators`；`allowedUsers` 与 `senderPolicy` 不授予这些权限）。`operators` 默认未设置，因此零配置 QQ 群里没有任何成员可执行这些命令，群内发起的权限请求也无人可应答；需要时请把应当操作该群会话的 QQ 用户 id 填入 `operators` —— 群访问开启而共享 scope 下 `operators` 为空时，channel 现会在启动时告警。实测后果：一旦有工具调用需要审批，群里没有人能应答该请求（提问者本人与所有成员都会被拒），工具不会执行，且该待审批提示会占住群的会话，直到 `AcpBridge` 超时（300 秒）才释放 —— `/cancel` 同样会被排队。从不弹出权限提示的部署（例如 `yolo`）不受影响。（`!` 主机 shell 在所有 QQ 群聊中一律禁用，与 scope 无关。）启动时会检查无法解析的持久化路由：强制 single-scope 时代遗留的 `<channel>:__single__` 条目，以及生效 scope 非 `user` 时本 channel 自己的三段式 `<channel>:<sender>:<chat>` 键 —— 在 `thread`/`chat_thread` 下它们永远无法再解析，且每次重启都会占用 bridge 的 per-workspace 会话上限。删除是可选开启的：`purgeLegacySessions` 未设置（默认 `false`）时只打印计数、不删除任何内容；设为 `true` 时会在首次删除前先把待删路由写入救援副本（`qq-sessions-purged.json`），以便手工恢复。无论哪种模式，其历史都不做迁移（无法按群拆分）。归属按条目记录的 target channel 判定，不按键前缀，因此不会误伤兄弟 channel 的路由；清理发生在 restore 之后，首次启动仍会先重新挂载一次再释放。取消的 turn 现在会先 flush 缓冲的部分回复再拆流状态，部分输出不再丢失。发布说明：省略 `sessionScope` 的 QQ 部署，其生效默认 scope 从 `user` 变为 `thread`；群会话即共享会话，成员需被列入 `operators` 才能应答权限请求或执行会话控制命令。

Fixes #8238

prs.title: fix(cli): Make interactive questions answerable from standard ACP hosts
prs.body:
## What this PR does The interactive question tool (`ask_user_question`) is projected onto the Agent Client Protocol as a permission request, but the real per-question choices only ever travelled in a Qwen-specific metadata field that the protocol tells conforming clients to ignore. A standard ACP host therefore rendered a raw JSON payload, and the user could not actually answer: the single visible button submitted an empty answer. This PR makes the question answerable everywhere by projecting the question text and every choice into the standard tool-call content, and — for clients that do not opt in to the Qwen question payload — by offering real per-choice options in the permission request, exactly like an ordinary approval prompt, with the answer recovered from the option the user picks. Clients that do understand the Qwen payload keep their existing rich flow unchanged. ## Why it's needed Today the question tool is unusable through any ACP host that does not implement Qwen's private contract: the user sees "Raw Input", and even pressing the one available button returns nothing, because the answer was read from a response field the protocol does not define. This is the bug reported in the linked issue. The fix also has to avoid regressing the Qwen-owned surfaces — the VS Code companion, the web shell, channel cards, the daemon bridge, and the voice client — all of which consume the rich payload today. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify A reviewer can confirm the behavior with the focused test suites; no IDE is required: ```bash cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/permissionUtils.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/SubAgentTracker.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.worktree.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.review-lease.test.ts src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false cd packages/qwen-live && npx vitest run src/adaptor/acp-adaptor.test.ts src/adaptor/acp-permission-mode.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false ``` Expected outcomes to check in the tests: - With the capability absent, a single question produces one option per choice, followed by `Other…` and `Cancel`; picking one returns the matching label. - With the capability advertised (as the in-repo Qwen clients do), the generic `Submit`/`Cancel` pair is preserved. - A multi-question request is not flattened — the questions and choices still appear as readable content. - The question text and every choice are present in the standard tool-call content regardless of capability. ### Evidence (Before & After) Zed end-to-end, same prompt (one question, two options: `Day.js` / `date-fns`). **Before** — the question arrives as a raw JSON payload and the only actions are `Submit` and `Cancel`; submitting returns nothing, so the tool reports "No valid answers were provided.". **After** — the question is readable and every choice is a real selectable option, alongside `Other…` and `Cancel`. **After, round-trip** — picking `Day.js` is delivered to the model as the answer, and the agent continues with it. Focused suites and checks: ``` packages/cli : 6 files, 2122 passed packages/qwen-live: 2 files, 26 passed typecheck (core, cli, acp-bridge, channels/base, vscode-ide-companion, qwen-live): exit 0 build (packages/cli, tsc --build): exit 0 corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile: lockfile unchanged eslint + prettier on all changed files: clean ``` ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ | | 🪟 Windows | N/A | | 🐧 Linux | N/A | ### Environment (optional) Unit tests and type checks, plus a Zed end-to-end run against a local build of this branch (Zed custom agent launching `--acp`). No sandbox was used. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: the new flat option list only applies when a client does not advertise the Qwen question capability, so the blast radius is limited to non-Qwen ACP hosts. The content projection is additive and ignored by clients that render their own question card. - Not validated / out of scope: a multi-question request (2–4 questions) is intentionally not flattened, because the protocol has no multi-form primitive and interleaving choices from different questions would be ambiguous; those questions are shown as text and remain fully answerable only from the Qwen-compatible surfaces. `multiSelect` questions degrade to a single choice. Sequential per-question permission requests are not implemented. The Zed run above covers a single, single-select question; the multi-question and `multiSelect` cases were not exercised in Zed. - Breaking changes / migration notes: none for the Qwen-owned clients, which keep the same option set. One behaviour change for third-party ACP hosts and external harnesses that auto-approve by selecting the first `allow_once` option: on a flattened question that is now the first choice, where it previously hit `proceed_once` and produced a visible "No valid answers were provided." — worth a release note. ## Linked Issues Fixes #11361 Design document (both language versions): - [English](docs/design/2026-10-10-acp-structured-question-projection.md) - [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-10-acp-structured-question-projection.zh-CN.md)
中文说明 ## What this PR does（本 PR 做了什么） 交互式提问工具（`ask_user_question`）目前被投影为 Agent Client Protocol 的一次权限请求，但真正的逐题选项只通过 Qwen 专有的元数据字段传递，而协议要求符合规范的客户端忽略该字段。因此标准 ACP 宿主只能渲染原始 JSON，用户实际上无法作答：唯一可见的按钮提交的是空答案。本 PR 让问题在所有宿主上都能作答：始终把问题文本与每个选项投影进标准工具调用内容；对于未声明支持 Qwen 问题载荷的客户端，直接在权限请求中给出真实的逐选项选项（与普通审批提示完全一致），并从用户所选的选项恢复答案。理解 Qwen 载荷的客户端保持原有丰富流程不变。 ## Why it's needed（为什么需要） 目前，任何未实现 Qwen 私有契约的 ACP 宿主都无法使用该提问工具：用户看到的是 "Raw Input"，而且即使按下唯一可用的按钮也不会返回任何内容，因为答案是从协议未定义的响应字段读取的。这正是所链接 issue 报告的问题。该修复还必须避免回退 Qwen 自有界面——VS Code 伴侣、Web Shell、渠道卡片、daemon bridge 以及语音客户端——它们目前消费的是丰富载荷。 ## Reviewer Test Plan（评审测试计划） ### How to verify（如何验证） 评审者可用聚焦测试套件确认行为，无需 IDE： ```bash cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/permissionUtils.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/SubAgentTracker.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.worktree.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.review-lease.test.ts src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false cd packages/qwen-live && npx vitest run src/adaptor/acp-adaptor.test.ts src/adaptor/acp-permission-mode.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false ``` 测试中应确认的结果： - 未声明能力时，单个问题为每个选项给出一个选项，其后是 `Other…` 与 `Cancel`；选择其一即返回对应标签。 - 声明能力时（仓库内 Qwen 客户端即如此），保留通用的 `Submit`/`Cancel` 按钮对。 - 多问题请求不会被扁平化——问题与选项仍以可读内容呈现。 - 无论能力如何，问题文本与每个选项都出现在标准工具调用内容中。 ### Evidence (Before & After)（证据） Zed 端到端，同一提示词（一个问题，两个选项：`Day.js` / `date-fns`）。 **Before**——问题以原始 JSON 形式到达，仅有的操作是 `Submit` 与 `Cancel`；提交后不会返回任何内容，因此工具报告 "No valid answers were provided."。 **After**——问题可读，每个选项都是真正可选的选项，另有 `Other…` 与 `Cancel`。 **After，往返**——选择 `Day.js` 会作为答案传回模型，agent 随之继续。 聚焦测试套件与检查： ``` packages/cli : 6 files, 2122 passed packages/qwen-live: 2 files, 26 passed typecheck (core, cli, acp-bridge, channels/base, vscode-ide-companion, qwen-live): exit 0 build (packages/cli, tsc --build): exit 0 corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile: lockfile unchanged eslint + prettier on all changed files: clean ``` ### Tested on（测试平台） | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ | | 🪟 Windows | N/A | | 🐧 Linux | N/A | ### Environment（环境） 单元测试与类型检查，外加使用本分支本地构建的 Zed 端到端运行（Zed 自定义 agent 启动 `--acp`）。未使用 sandbox。 ## Risk & Scope（风险与范围） - 主要风险或取舍：新的扁平选项列表仅在客户端未声明 Qwen 问题能力时生效，影响范围限于非 Qwen 的 ACP 宿主。内容投影为增量改动，会渲染自有问题卡片的客户端会忽略它。 - 未验证 / 范围之外：多问题请求（2–4 个问题）有意不扁平化，因为协议没有多表单原语，把不同问题的选项交错会产生歧义；这些问题以文本呈现，且仅在 Qwen 兼容界面中可完整作答。`multiSelect` 问题降级为单选。未实现逐题顺序权限请求。上文的 Zed 运行仅覆盖单个单选问题；多问题与 `multiSelect` 情形未在 Zed 中验证。 - 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：对 Qwen 自有客户端无破坏性，选项集合保持不变。对通过「选择第一个 `allow_once` 选项」自动批准的第三方 ACP 宿主与外部测试框架：扁平化问题现在会把该第一个选项记录为答案，而此前会命中 `proceed_once` 并产生可见的 "No valid answers were provided."——建议在 release notes 中说明。 ## Linked Issues（关联 Issue） Fixes #11361 设计文档（中英双版本）： - prs.title: fix(ci): keep the daemon E2E install from recompiling the workspace
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The daemon E2E setup no longer compiles the workspace twice. Its dependency install skips the `prepare` hook's build and bundle, and the job's existing explicit build and bundle steps remain the single compile.

## Why it's needed

Run [39356021243](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39356021243) failed in `Install Node.js dependencies` before any Java test result was reported; the gate then failed in `Report the tier result` because the suite never completed. The install ran `prepare`, which built and bundled the whole tree, and the same job built and bundled it again immediately after. A failure in that duplicate compile ends the job inside the install step. Skipping the redundant compile keeps the install an install and preserves the explicit build and bundle steps the E2E needs. The install retry loop is unchanged.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm the daemon E2E job's `Install Node.js dependencies` step sets `QWEN_SKIP_PREPARE: '1'` and is followed by `Build Qwen Code` and `Bundle Qwen Code`. Then run `npx vitest run scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js`; the new meta-test parses the workflow and fails if the skip is removed or if the explicit build and bundle steps stop following the install. On the PR head, the Managed Agent gate's fast tier should reach `Run Java daemon E2E` instead of dying in the install.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CI workflow change with no user-visible output.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Linux sandbox. The exact self-hosted ECS lane was not available; verification used the workflow meta-test plus build, typecheck, and lint.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: The install no longer produces a build, so the job's explicit build and bundle steps become load-bearing; removing either would leave the E2E without runtime artifacts. The new meta-test pins their ordering.
- Not validated / out of scope: The other SDK Java jobs still rely on prepare during install because they have no explicit build steps; this change is scoped to the daemon E2E lane. The exact ECS lane was not run locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14891

prs.title: feat(web-shell): quote selected message text into the composer
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a "Quote to composer" action to the text-selection popover in the Web Shell transcript: selecting a fragment of an assistant reply or a user message now offers, alongside the existing "Copy plain text" and "Copy Markdown" actions, a way to quote the fragment into the active composer. Clicking it inserts the fragment as an inline chip at the end of the composer; when the prompt is sent, the chip serializes to a Markdown blockquote line (`> quoted text`) inside the prompt and is carried through the existing reference-annotation machinery (`inputAnnotations` with `reference.kind === 'quote'`), so the quote survives send and session reload.

The quoted fragment is normalized before insertion: all whitespace runs (including newlines) are collapsed to single spaces — the chip is a single inline editor range — bidirectional embedding/isolation control characters are stripped, and the length is capped at 4000 characters. Each chip is identified by a deterministic hash of its text, so the same quoted fragment always produces the same tag id.

The action is available wherever a composer exists (the main chat and split-view panes). Read-only and embedded transcript views do not provide the action, so the button is hidden there. UI strings are localized in English and Chinese.

## Why it's needed

Follow-up prompts often need to reference a specific part of an earlier reply. Today the only options are copying the selection to the clipboard ("Copy plain text" / "Copy Markdown") and pasting it manually, which loses the signal that the fragment is a quote of earlier context. Requested in #12682.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start the dev server (`cd packages/web-shell && npm run dev`) and open a chat session with at least one assistant reply.
2. Drag-select a fragment of the reply text — the selection popover appears. Before this PR it offers only "Copy plain text" and "Copy Markdown"; after, it additionally offers "Quote to composer".
3. Click "Quote to composer" — an inline chip with the selected fragment appears at the end of the composer and the menu closes.
4. Press Enter to send. The user bubble renders the chip, and the POST to `/session/:id/prompt` carries the fragment as a `> quoted text` line in a `type: 'text'` prompt block plus an `inputAnnotations` entry with `reference.kind === 'quote'`, `reference.value` = the normalized fragment, `reference.serialized` = `> fragment`.
5. The same flow works when selecting a fragment of a user message; the button is absent in read-only/embedded transcript views.

Automated coverage: `packages/web-shell/client/utils/quoteReference.test.ts` (normalization: whitespace collapsing, bidi stripping, 4000-character cap, tag shape) and three new cases in `SelectionCopyMenu.test.tsx` (button hidden without a quote action, shown with one, and the click passes the selected text and closes the menu), plus the Playwright before/after scenario from the evidence below.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Playwright run against `npm run dev` with the mock-daemon e2e harness (Chromium, 1280x720), selecting the word **bold** from an assistant reply:

Before — the selection popover offers only the copy actions:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4ekuct25/qwen-code/evidence/pr-12682/assets/web-shell-quote-2026-10-14/1-before-popover.png

After — the popover additionally offers "Quote to composer":

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4ekuct25/qwen-code/evidence/pr-12682/assets/web-shell-quote-2026-10-14/2-after-popover.png

After clicking — the fragment is an inline chip in the composer:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4ekuct25/qwen-code/evidence/pr-12682/assets/web-shell-quote-2026-10-14/3-after-composer-chip.png

After sending — the chip survives in the user bubble:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4ekuct25/qwen-code/evidence/pr-12682/assets/web-shell-quote-2026-10-14/4-after-user-bubble-chip.png

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

macOS: not verified live in this pass (dev runs and tests are in Docker/Chromium). Windows: pending — the Windows VM is not available in this pass (by decision).

### Environment (optional)

Docker `node:22-bookworm`: full web-shell vitest suite (440 files, 11809 tests — all passing), `tsc --noEmit`, `prettier --check` on the changed files; Playwright (Chromium) against the `npm run dev` server with the mock-daemon harness.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: quoted fragments are appended to the prompt as visible text, which increases context size for long selections; the 4000-character cap bounds the token cost of a single quote.
- Not validated / out of scope: live runs on macOS and Windows; provenance (source message id) on the quote reference is intentionally not carried in this version.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12682

在 Web Shell 对话记录的文字选择浮层中新增"引用到输入框"操作：选中助手回复或用户消息中的文字片段后，浮层除现有的"复制纯文本"和"复制 Markdown"之外，现在还提供将该片段引用到当前输入框的方式。点击后，片段会以内联芯片（chip）形式插入输入框末尾；发送提示词时，芯片会序列化为 Markdown 引用行（`> 引用文本`）进入提示词，并随现有的引用注解机制（`inputAnnotations` 中 `reference.kind === 'quote'`）一并提交，因此引用在发送后会话重载后依然保留。

引用片段在插入前会做归一化：所有空白（含换行）折叠为单个空格——芯片是编辑器中单一的内联范围——去除双向嵌入/隔离控制字符，长度上限 4000 个字符。每个芯片由文本的确定性哈希标识，因此引用同一片段总是产生相同的标签 id。

prs.title: test(managed-agent): pin the close refusal while a turn is active (FG11d)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Pins the boundary the FG11d close arm actually has: a Session refuses a close while a turn is in flight. `POST /v1/agents/sessions/{id}/close` answers `409 turn_active` (`The Session has an active Turn.`) instead of queueing the close, so an automation input waiting behind that turn is decided by the turn rather than by the close attempt.

The cell parks the wake turn on the model stub, then attempts the close and asserts the refusal by status and code. It also corrects both design records: the `close-queued-input` row and the Limits bullet now say the queued-input arm is bounded by this refusal rather than left "to a later cell", because no close ever reaches the queue.

## Why it's needed

The record promised that a close would settle an automation input queued behind a held turn. The first attempt at that cell showed the premise is wrong — the close never gets that far, and a reader of the record would have designed for a state the API refuses. Pinning the refusal is the honest version of that arm: it is a real lifecycle property (a turn is not cut by a close), and it is the reason the queued-input expectation cannot be constructed.

Without the cell, nothing holds the refusal: a future change that let a close race an active turn would pass silently.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the cell against real MySQL 8 and confirm it passes; then confirm the refusal is the turn's, not a workspace problem — the response body is `{"error":{"code":"turn_active","message":"The Session has an active Turn."}}` with no `workspace_unavailable`.

Deleting the parked turn before the close (or letting the model answer first) makes the case red, because the close would then be admitted.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the record's `close-queued-input` row expected a completed close that settles a queued input; the Limits bullet deferred that arm.

After: `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0 -- in HostedAutomationFaultGatesIT` (4.537 s) on JDK 21 + MySQL 8, asserting `409` / `turn_active`; both language versions of the record now state the bound.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A  |

JDK 21 (`Zulu 21.0.11`) and MySQL 8.0.46 on `127.0.0.1:3401`, selected with `-Phosted-automation-gates`.

### Environment (optional)

N/A.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the cell pins a refusal, not a repair. If the product later decides a close should cancel an in-flight turn, this case must change with it — which is the point, but it means the case records today's contract rather than an aspiration.
- Not validated / out of scope: the rest of the cancellation matrix (future slots, siblings, retry reuse, redelivery) stays unimplemented.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — one test and two design records.

Design records: [English](docs/design/2026-10-19-automation-lifecycle-fault-gates.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-19-automation-lifecycle-fault-gates.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Part of the FG11 tracker in #14446.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

钉住 FG11d 关闭格真正的边界：turn 在飞时，Session 拒绝关闭。`POST /v1/agents/sessions/{id}/close` 返回 `409 turn_active`（`The Session has an active Turn.`），而不是把关闭排队，因此排在该 turn 之后的 automation input 由 turn 决定，而不由关闭决定。

用例把 wake turn 停在模型桩上，然后发起关闭，按状态码与错误码断言这次拒绝。同时改正两份设计记录：`close-queued-input` 行与「边界」条目现在写明排队输入这一支被该拒绝卡住，而不是「留给后续格子」——因为关闭根本到不了队列。

## 为什么需要

记录原先承诺：关闭会结算排在 held turn 之后的 automation input。这一格的首次尝试表明前提不成立——关闭根本走不到那一步，照记录设计的读者会为一个 API 明确拒绝的状态写代码。把拒绝钉住才是这一支的诚实版本：它本身就是一条真实的生命周期性质（关闭不会切断 turn），也正是排队输入预期无法构造的原因。

没有这一格，这个拒绝没有任何门禁：将来若有改动让关闭与活跃 turn 竞争，会静默通过。

## 评审验证

在真实 MySQL 8 上单跑该用例确认通过；再确认拒绝来自 turn 而不是工作区问题——响应正文是 `{"error":{"code":"turn_active","message":"The Session has an active Turn."}}`，不含 `workspace_unavailable`。

若在关闭前释放或让模型先回答，用例会变红——那时关闭会被受理。

## 证据

改动前：记录里 `close-queued-input` 行预期「关闭完成并结算排队输入」，边界条目把这一支延期。

改动后：`Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0 -- in HostedAutomationFaultGatesIT`（4.537 s），JDK 21 + MySQL 8，断言 `409` / `turn_active`；中英两版记录同步写明该边界。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：这一格钉的是拒绝，不是修复。若产品后续决定「关闭应取消在飞的 turn」，用例必须随之修改——这正是它的意义，但也意味着它记录的是今天的契约而非愿景。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：取消矩阵其余部分（未来 slot、兄弟、重试复用、重投）仍未实现。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无——一个测试加两份设计记录。

</details>

prs.title: docs(board): clarify suggested task owner semantics
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Documents how a suggested task owner works in Agent Board, with an example of setting the suggestion when creating a task. It explains that the task remains pending and available for any actor to claim, and that an in-progress task cannot be claimed by a different actor.

## Why it's needed

The existing guide explains that an owner label does not start an agent, but does not describe the creation option or its non-binding nature. A reader can otherwise mistake the suggested owner for a reservation and be surprised when another actor claims the task. This addresses only item 2 of #11755 by documenting the existing behavior.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Create a task with a suggested owner and inspect it: it should still be pending. Claim it using a different actor name and confirm that the owner changes and the task becomes in progress. Attempt to claim that in-progress task with a third actor name and confirm that it is refused. Check that the guide describes these existing transitions without implying that actor labels authenticate a participant or wake an agent.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — documentation-only change. Before, the guide did not describe the suggested-owner option or explain that it does not reserve a pending task. After, it includes an example and distinguishes the pending suggestion from an in-progress claim. Runtime behavior is unchanged.

Windows / Node.js 22.18.0: repository-configured Prettier check and whitespace checks passed. An isolated offline smoke test against the checked-out Board implementation confirmed pending owner `web`, successful claim by `worker` with persisted `in_progress` ownership, and refusal of a later claim by `third`. No model call, external service or runtime source change was involved. Full application preflight was not run for this documentation-only patch. Codex assisted preparation and verification.

- Not validated / out of scope: the other follow-ups in #11755, including actor-scoped filtering, command help, decline output, case folding, and read-concurrency coverage.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no runtime code or persisted format changes.

prs.title: fix(cli): strip UTF-8 BOM before parsing settings.json to avoid false corruption reset
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A `~/.qwen/settings.json` that starts with a UTF-8 BOM was parsed with the BOM still attached, so `JSON.parse` failed and the file entered the corruption-recovery path — the user's settings were reset to `{}` (with a `.corrupted` backup) on the next start. This strips the leading U+FEFF before parsing in the two settings-file read paths (`loadAndMigrate` and `LoadedSettings.reloadScopeFromDisk`) by exporting the `stripBom()` helper that already exists in `jsonc-editor.ts`. Only the parse expression changes: the raw content string (and therefore `rawJson` and the BOM-preserving write path from #1680) is untouched, and genuinely corrupted files still take the recovery path exactly as before.

## Why it's needed

Windows editors such as old Notepad versions and PowerShell 5.1 (`Set-Content -Encoding UTF8`) write a BOM by default, and many editors offer "UTF-8 with BOM". The read path treated that harmless prefix as corruption and wiped all user settings, while the write path deliberately preserves a BOM when editing files (#1680) — so a settings file the tool itself had just edited could be reset on the next read. BOM tolerance already has precedent in the repo (`jsonc-editor.ts` `stripBom()`, and `normalizeContent()` in core `textUtils.ts` used by skill loading).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Reproduction (before) and verification (after) on Windows 11, Node v24.19.0, importing the built `packages/cli/dist/src/config/settings.js` with `QWEN_HOME` redirected to a temp dir containing a BOM-prefixed `settings.json` (`\uFEFF{"model":{"name":"qwen3-coder-plus"},"ui":{"theme":"dark"}}`):

- Before: `loaded.user.settings` is `{}`, `corruptedPath` is `...settings.json.corrupted`, and the file on disk is overwritten to `{}`.
- After: `loaded.user.settings` contains the full settings object, no `.corrupted` file is created, no reset write happens, and the on-disk file keeps its leading BOM after the normal write-back — i.e. it now behaves exactly like a file without a BOM.

Focused suites: `npx vitest run src/config/settings.test.ts src/utils/jsonc-editor.test.ts` — 233 tests, all passing, including two new cases (a BOM file loads instead of entering corruption recovery; only the leading BOM is stripped, a BOM inside a JSON string value is preserved). `npx eslint` on the three touched files is clean.

### Evidence (Before & After)

No UI change — live-module reproduction output, same script against the unfixed and fixed build (Windows 11, Node v24.19.0):

```
BEFORE (unfixed build)
loaded.user.settings = {}
loaded.corruptedPath = ...\qwenhome\settings.json.corrupted
settings.json on disk NOW = "{}"          <- wiped
.corrupted file created  = true

AFTER (this change)
loaded.user.settings = {"model":{"name":"qwen3-coder-plus"},"ui":{"theme":"dark"},"$version":4}
loaded.corruptedPath = undefined
.corrupted file created  = false
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️ not tested locally — platform-neutral parse fix, covered by CI  |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅ tested — Windows 11, Node v24.19.0   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️ not tested locally — platform-neutral parse fix, covered by CI  |

### Environment (optional)

Local verification used the built CLI dist module with `QWEN_HOME` redirected to a temp directory; unit tests only, no production services involved.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: minimal — `stripBom()` is an identity function for files without a BOM, and genuinely corrupted files still reset as before. A BOM-prefixed file whose JSON is also broken now fails at the next parse error instead of the BOM, still landing in the recovery path.
- Not validated / out of scope: the same missing-BOM pattern exists in `.mcp.json` loading (`packages/cli/src/config/mcpJson.ts`) and a few warn-only config readers; left out to keep this change atomic (happy to follow up separately).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #11803

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

以 UTF-8 BOM 开头的 `~/.qwen/settings.json`（Windows 记事本旧版本、PowerShell 5.1 等编辑器的默认产物）此前会带着 BOM 进入 `JSON.parse`，解析失败后文件进入损坏恢复路径——用户设置在下次启动时被重置为 `{}`（仅留 `.corrupted` 备份）。本 PR 通过导出 `jsonc-editor.ts` 中已有的 `stripBom()` 辅助函数，在两处设置文件读取路径（`loadAndMigrate` 与 `LoadedSettings.reloadScopeFromDisk`）的解析前剥除行首 U+FEFF。仅解析表达式发生变化：原始内容字符串（因此 `rawJson` 与 #1680 引入的"BOM 保留"写路径）完全不受影响；真正损坏的文件仍按原样走恢复路径。

## 为什么需要

Windows 上的记事本旧版本与 PowerShell 5.1（`Set-Content -Encoding UTF8`）默认写出带 BOM 的文件，许多编辑器也提供"UTF-8 with BOM"选项。读路径把这一无害前缀当作损坏并清空全部用户设置，而写路径在编辑文件时却刻意保留 BOM（#1680）——工具自己刚编辑过的设置文件可能在下一次读取时被重置。仓库中已有 BOM 容错的先例（`jsonc-editor.ts` 的 `stripBom()`，以及 core `textUtils.ts` 中供 skill 加载使用的 `normalizeContent()`）。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

在 Windows 11（Node v24.19.0）上，导入构建产物 `packages/cli/dist/src/config/settings.js`，将 `QWEN_HOME` 重定向到包含带 BOM 的 `settings.json`（`\uFEFF{"model":{"name":"qwen3-coder-plus"},"ui":{"theme":"dark"}}`）的临时目录：

- 修复前：`loaded.user.settings` 为 `{}`，`corruptedPath` 为 `...settings.json.corrupted`，磁盘上的文件被覆写为 `{}`。
- 修复后：`loaded.user.settings` 包含完整设置对象，不创建 `.corrupted` 文件，没有重置写入，且磁盘文件在正常写回后仍保留行首 BOM——行为与无 BOM 文件完全一致。

聚焦测试：`npx vitest run src/config/settings.test.ts src/utils/jsonc-editor.test.ts`——共 233 个用例全部通过，含两个新增用例（带 BOM 的文件正常加载而非进入损坏恢复；仅剥除行首 BOM，JSON 字符串值内部的 BOM 原样保留）。三个改动文件的 `npx eslint` 检查干净。

### 证据（Before & After）

无 UI 变更——同一复现脚本分别对未修复构建与本修复构建的输出（Windows 11，Node v24.19.0）：

```
修复前（未修复构建）
loaded.user.settings = {}
loaded.corruptedPath = ...\qwenhome\settings.json.corrupted
settings.json on disk NOW = "{}"          <- 设置被清空
.corrupted file created  = true

修复后（本变更）
loaded.user.settings = {"model":{"name":"qwen3-coder-plus"},"ui":{"theme":"dark"},"$version":4}
loaded.corruptedPath = undefined
.corrupted file created  = false
```

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️ 本地未测——平台无关的解析修复，由 CI 覆盖  |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅ 已测——Windows 11，Node v24.19.0   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️ 本地未测——平台无关的解析修复，由 CI 覆盖  |

### 环境（可选）

本地验证使用构建产物 CLI dist 模块并将 `QWEN_HOME` 重定向到临时目录；仅单元测试，不涉及生产服务。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：极小——对不带 BOM 的文件 `stripBom()` 是恒等函数，真正损坏的文件仍按原样重置。带 BOM 但 JSON 本身也损坏的文件现在会在下一个解析错误处失败（而非 BOM 处），仍会进入恢复路径。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：`.mcp.json` 加载（`packages/cli/src/config/mcpJson.ts`）及少数仅告警的配置读取器存在同样的 BOM 缺口；为保持本变更原子性而未纳入（可另行跟进）。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #11803

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): forfeit the analyzer HOME for a bare `cd` after HOME is reassigned
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A bare `cd` goes to bash's `$HOME`, and the analyzer read that from its own process environment. When the command reassigns `HOME` first, bash expands the value the command just set — which the analyzer never sees — so it certified the write against its own `HOME` and reported no uncertainty on a path it cannot know. This change tracks `HOME` reassignment across the compound segments (the same way it already tracks `cd`) and resolves a bare `cd` as dynamic once one has happened, so the following relative operations keep the last known cwd but are marked `cwdUnknown`.

Only forms that change the value count: `HOME=…` (a leading assignment, or after `export` / `declare` / `local`) and `unset HOME`, so a bare `export HOME` and a read of the variable still resolve as before.

## Why it's needed

`export HOME=/tmp/attacker && cd && echo {} > settings.json` certified `settings.json` against the analyzer's `HOME` and reported no uncertainty, even though the resulting path is unknown. Every other non-static `cd` target already resolves as dynamic; this closes the one case that read the analyzer's own environment instead of the command's.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

From `packages/core`, run `npx vitest run src/permissions/`. The three reassignment cases — `export HOME=… && cd && …`, `HOME=… ; cd ; …` and `unset HOME && cd && …` — yield `uncertainWrite('/repo/settings.json')`; all three fail before the change and pass after. The guard case keeps `cd && echo {} > settings.json` resolving to `write('/home/tester/settings.json')` when nothing reassigns `HOME`, and a bare `export HOME` still resolves as before. The full `src/permissions/` suite passes with 1226 tests.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible surface; the tests are the evidence.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a bare `cd` after any `HOME` reassignment is now dynamic, so the following relative write is uncertain rather than statically known. That is the conservative direction — it can only add a confirmation prompt, never suppress one.
- Not validated / out of scope: reassignment through indirection (`eval`, `read HOME`, `HOME=$(…)`) is not detected; the pre-existing dynamic-target handling still applies to those.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Addresses the R3-7 item of #14095.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

裸 `cd` 会前往 bash 的 `$HOME`，而分析器是从自身进程环境读取该值的。当命令先重赋值了 `HOME`，bash 展开的是命令刚刚设置的值——分析器永远看不到——于是它把写入判定落在分析器自己的 `HOME` 上，并对一条它无法知道的路径报告「无不确定性」。本改动像已有的 `cd` 跟踪一样，在复合命令的各段之间从左到右跟踪 `HOME` 的重赋值，一旦发生过就把裸 `cd` 解析为 dynamic，使后续相对操作保留最后已知 cwd 但被标记为 `cwdUnknown`。

只有真正改变取值的形态才算数：`HOME=…`（前导赋值，或位于 `export` / `declare` / `local` 之后）以及 `unset HOME`；因此裸 `export HOME` 与对该变量的读取，行为与之前一致。

`export HOME=/tmp/attacker && cd && echo {} > settings.json` 会把 `settings.json` 对分析器自己的 `HOME` 完成判定并报告无不确定性，而实际路径是未知的。其他所有非静态 `cd` 目标本就解析为 dynamic；本改动补上了唯一一处读取分析器自身环境而非命令环境的情况。

验证方式：在 `packages/core` 下运行 `npx vitest run src/permissions/`。三条重赋值用例——`export HOME=… && cd && …`、`HOME=… ; cd ; …`、`unset HOME && cd && …`——均得到 `uncertainWrite('/repo/settings.json')`；三者在改动前全部失败、改动后通过。对照用例在无重赋值时仍把 `cd && echo {} > settings.json` 解析为 `write('/home/tester/settings.json')`，裸 `export HOME` 行为不变。`src/permissions/` 全量测试 1226 项通过。

主要风险：任何 `HOME` 重赋值之后的裸 `cd` 现在都是 dynamic，后续相对写入由静态已知变为不确定。这是更保守的方向——只会增加一次确认提示，绝不会抑制提示。

破坏性变更：无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(sdk-typescript): clamp an overflowing session-spawn deadline to the timer ceiling
prs.body:
## What this PR does

`resolveSessionOperationTimeoutMs` returns `0` for two unrelated reasons: an explicit `fetchTimeoutMs: 0`, meaning the operator asked for no deadline; and `derived > MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS`, meaning the advertised session budget plus `SESSION_RESTORE_TIMEOUT_HEADROOM_MS` overflowed the timer ceiling. `--session-restore-timeout-ms` accepts up to `MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS`, so a legal maximum reaches the second case (`2_147_483_647 + 10_000`).

`resolveSessionSpawnTimeoutMs` treated both as "no deadline", and `fetchWithTimeout` agrees, so the create / worktree-reset spawn armed no timer and attached no `AbortSignal` — a stalled daemon retained the call for the process lifetime. This change separates the two: an explicit deadline is returned verbatim (`0` included), while a derived `0` is clamped to `MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS`, the largest delay a timer can express, so a derived deadline is always bounded.

## Why it's needed

The two spawn routes had a hard 30s bound before the restore knob was threaded through them, and the linked issue asks for an overflowing derived value to be clamped to the ceiling rather than dropped. Without the clamp, `--session-restore-timeout-ms` set to its documented maximum silently removed the deadline from every create and worktree reset, so a wedged daemon could hang the client indefinitely.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

From `packages/sdk-typescript`, run `npx vitest run test/unit/DaemonClient.test.ts`. The cases 'bounds a create whose advertised budget overflows the timer ceiling' and 'bounds a worktree reset ...' fail on the parent commit — `signal` is never assigned, so no abort is ever armed — and pass here, aborting at the ceiling. 'keeps an explicit fetchTimeoutMs: 0 unbounded on the spawn routes' pins the override that an explicit deadline still bypasses the clamp.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible surface; the tests are the evidence.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a derived overflow now waits up to `MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS` (~24.8 days) rather than 30s. That is the ceiling a timer can express and matches the clamp the issue asks for; flooring to the generic 30s deadline instead would report a value the overflow does not mean.
- Not validated / out of scope: an explicit `fetchTimeoutMs` above `MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS` still reaches `fetchWithTimeout` as `0`, i.e. unbounded. That is pre-existing, unaffected by this change, and now called out in the doc comment.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14622.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

`resolveSessionOperationTimeoutMs` 会把 `0` 用于两个互不相关的含义：一是显式传入 `fetchTimeoutMs: 0`，表示操作者要求「不设超时」；二是 `derived > MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS`，即会话预算加上 `SESSION_RESTORE_TIMEOUT_HEADROOM_MS` 后溢出了定时器上限。由于 `--session-restore-timeout-ms` 允许取到 `MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS`，一个合法的最大值必然会落到第二种情况（`2_147_483_647 + 10_000`）。

`resolveSessionSpawnTimeoutMs` 把两者都当成「不设超时」，而 `fetchWithTimeout` 对 `0` 的理解一致，于是 create / worktree reset 的 spawn 既不设定时器、也不挂 `AbortSignal`——守护进程一旦卡住，该调用会一直挂到进程结束。本改动把两者区分开：显式截止时间原样返回（包括 `0`），而派生的 `0` 则夹取到 `MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS`（定时器能表达的最大延迟），从而保证派生截止时间始终有界。

在 restore 旋钮接入之前，这两条 spawn 路径本有 30 秒硬上限；而关联 issue 要求把溢出的派生值夹取到上限，而不是丢弃它。若不加夹取，把 `--session-restore-timeout-ms` 设为文档允许的最大值，会静默地移除每次 create 与 worktree reset 的超时，使卡死的守护进程可以把客户端无限挂住。

验证方式：在 `packages/sdk-typescript` 下运行 `npx vitest run test/unit/DaemonClient.test.ts`。`bounds a create whose advertised budget overflows the timer ceiling` 与对应 worktree reset 用例在父提交上失败（`signal` 始终未被赋值，从未挂上中止逻辑），在本分支通过，并在上限处中止；`keeps an explicit fetchTimeoutMs: 0 unbounded on the spawn routes` 则锁定「显式截止时间绕过夹取」这一覆盖行为。

主要风险：派生的溢出值现在最长等待 `MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS`（约 24.8 天）而非 30 秒。这是定时器能表达的上限，也符合 issue 要求的夹取；若改为夹到通用 30 秒截止时间，则会给出溢出本身并不表示的含义。

破坏性变更：无。

</details>
